 16210                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16211                                  ; Proc Name : Check_If_Net:
 16212                                  ;
 16213                                  ;
 16214                                  ; Checks if the device is over the net or not. Returns result in ZERO flag.
 16215                                  ; If no device is found, the return address is popped off the stack, and a
 16216                                  ; jump is made to ioctl_drv_err.
 16217                                  ;
 16218                                  ; On Entry:
 16219                                  ; Registers same as those for Get_Driver_BL
 16220                                  ;
 16221                                  ; On Exit:
 16222                                  ; ZERO flag	- set if not a net device
 16223                                  ;		- reset if net device
 16224                                  ; ES:DI -> the device
 16225                                  ;
 16226                                  ;
 16227                                  ; BUGBUG: This function assumes the following stack setup on entry
 16228                                  ;
 16229                                  ;	  SP+2 -> Error return address
 16230                                  ;	  SP   -> Normal return address
 16231                                  ;
 16232                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16233                                  
 16234                                  	; 30/01/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 16235                                  	; MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:639Ch
 16236                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:6A91h
 16237                                  	; Windows ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:68E1h
 16238                                  
 16239                                  Check_If_Net:
 16240                                  	; MSDOS 3.3 (& MSDOS 6.0)
 16241 0000244C E8D0FF                  	CALL	Get_Driver_BL
 16242 0000244F 7201                    	JC	short ioctl_drv_err_pop	; invalid drive letter
 16243                                  
 16244                                  ; 30/01/2024 ('Get_Driver_BL' returns with
 16245                                  ;	      'curdir_isnet' condition/ZF, no need to a second test)
 16246                                  %if 0
 16247                                  	;;;
 16248                                  	; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM, Windows ME IO.SYS)
 16249                                  	PUSH	ES
 16250                                  	PUSH	DI
 16251                                  	LES	DI,[THISCDS]
 16252                                  	;test	word [es:di+43h],8000h
 16253                                  	;TEST	word [ES:DI+curdir.flags],curdir_isnet
 16254                                  	;test	byte [es:di+44h],80h
 16255                                  	TEST	byte [ES:DI+curdir.flags+1],(curdir_isnet>>8)
 16256                                  	POP	DI
 16257                                  	POP	ES
 16258                                  	;;;
 16259                                  %endif
 16260 00002451 C3                      	retn

 16382                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16383                                  ;
 16384                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_DELETE
 16385                                  ;
 16386                                  ; Inputs:
 16387                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 16388                                  ;		terminated)
 16389                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 16390                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 16391                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 16392                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 16393                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 16394                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 16395                                  ; Function:
 16396                                  ;	Delete the specified file(s)
 16397                                  ; Outputs:
 16398                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 16399                                  ;		OK
 16400                                  ;	CARRY SET
 16401                                  ;	    AX is error code
 16402                                  ;		error_file_not_found
 16403                                  ;			Last element of path not found
 16404                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 16405                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 16406                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 16407                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 16408                                  ;		error_access_denied
 16409                                  ;			Attempt to delete device or directory
 16410                                  ;		***error_sharing_violation***
 16411                                  ;			Deny both access required, generates an INT 24.
 16412                                  ;			This error is NOT returned. The INT 24H is generated,
 16413                                  ;			  and the file is ignored (not deleted). Delete will
 16414                                  ;			  simply continue on looking for more files.
 16415                                  ;			  Carry will NOT be set in this case.
 16416                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 16417                                  ;
 16418                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16419                                  
 16420                                  FILEFOUND   equ 01h
 16421                                  FILEDELETED equ 10h
 16422                                  
 16423                                  
 16424                                  	; 12/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)

 16427                                  	; 30/01/2024

 16446                                  			; SS = DS = DOS CS, SDA first filename pointer -> 
 16447                                  			;		fully-qualified filename in DOS CS
 16448                                  			; SDA CDS pointer -> current directory structure for drive with file

 16906                                  ;	TITLE	DOS_RENAME - Internal RENAME call for MS-DOS
 16907                                  ;	NAME	DOS_RENAME
 16908                                  
 16909                                  ;**	Low level routine for renaming files
 16910                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16911                                  ;	DOS_RENAME
 16912                                  ;
 16913                                  ;	Modification history:
 16914                                  ;
 16915                                  ;	    Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 16916                                  
 16917                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16918                                  ;
 16919                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_RENAME
 16920                                  ;
 16921                                  ; Inputs:
 16922                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to SOURCE WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3
 16923                                  ;		chars, NUL terminated)
 16924                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string [SOURCE]
 16925                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 16926                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 16927                                  ;	[REN_WFP] Points to DEST WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3
 16928                                  ;		chars, NUL terminated)
 16929                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 16930                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 16931                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 16932                                  ; Function:
 16933                                  ;	Rename the specified file(s)
 16934                                  ;	NOTE: This routine uses most of AUXSTACK as a temp buffer.
 16935                                  ; Outputs:
 16936                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 16937                                  ;	    OK
 16938                                  ;	CARRY SET
 16939                                  ;	    AX is error code
 16940                                  ;		error_file_not_found
 16941                                  ;			No match for source, or dest path invalid
 16942                                  ;		error_not_same_device
 16943                                  ;			Source and dest are on different devices
 16944                                  ;		error_access_denied
 16945                                  ;			Directory specified (not simple rename),
 16946                                  ;			Device name given, Destination exists.
 16947                                  ;			NOTE: In third case some renames may have
 16948                                  ;			 been done if metas.
 16949                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 16950                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 16951                                  ;			SOURCE ONLY
 16952                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 16953                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 16954                                  ;			SOURCE ONLY
 16955                                  ;		error_sharing_violation
 16956                                  ;			Deny both access required, generates an INT 24.
 16957                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 16958                                  ;
 16959                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16960                                  
 16961                                  	; 14/11/2022 Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 16962                                  
 16963                                  	; 31/01/2024
 16964                                  
 16965                                  DOS_RENAME:
 16966                                  
 16967                                  ;hkn; DOS_RENAME is called from file.asm and fcbio.asm. DS has been set up
 16968                                  ;hkn; at this point to DOSDATA.
 16969                                  
 16970 00002674 E8B2EB                  	call	TestNet
 16971 00002677 7306                    	JNC	short LOCAL_RENAME
 16972                                  
 16973                                  ;IF NOT Installed
 16974                                  ;	transfer NET_RENAME
 16975                                  ;ELSE
 16976                                  	;MOV	AX,(MultNET SHL 8) OR 17
 16977                                  	;INT	2FH
 16978                                  	;return
 16979                                  
 16980 00002679 B81111                  	mov     ax, 1111h
 16981 0000267C CD2F                    	int     2Fh 	; Multiplex - NETWORK REDIRECTOR - RENAME REMOTE FILE
 16982                                  			; SS = DS = DOS CS, 
 16983                                  			; SDA first filename pointer = offset of fully-qualified old name
 16984                                  			; SDA CDS pointer -> current directory
 16985                                  			; Return: CF set on error
 16986 0000267E C3                      	retn
 16987                                  ;ENDIF
 16988

 17806                                  ;** 	Low level DUP routine for use by EXEC when creating a new process.
 17807                                  ;   	Exports the DUP to the server machine and increments the SFT ref count
 17808                                  ;
 17809                                  ;	DOS_DUP
 17810                                  ;
 17811                                  ;	Modification history:
 17812                                  ;
 17813                                  ;	  Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 17814                                  
 17815                                  ;BREAK <DOS_DUP -- DUP SFT across network>
 17816                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17817                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_DUP
 17818                                  ;
 17819                                  ; Inputs:
 17820                                  ;	[THISSFT] set to the SFT for the file being DUPed
 17821                                  ;		(a non net SFT is OK, in this case the ref
 17822                                  ;		 count is simply incremented)
 17823                                  ; Function:
 17824                                  ;	Signal to the devices that a logical open is occurring
 17825                                  ; Returns:
 17826                                  ;	ES:DI point to SFT
 17827                                  ;    Carry clear
 17828                                  ;	SFT ref_count is incremented
 17829                                  ; Registers modified: None.
 17830                                  ; NOTE:
 17831                                  ;	This routine is called from $CREATE_PROCESS_DATA_BLOCK at DOSINIT
 17832                                  ;	time with SS NOT DOSGROUP. There will be no Network handles at
 17833                                  ;	that time.
 17834                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17835                                  
 17836                                  DOS_DUP:
 17837                                  	;LES	DI,[CS:THISSFT]  ; MSDOS 3.3
 17838                                  
 17839                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 17840 00002979 2E8E06[0700]            	mov	es,[cs:DosDSeg]
 17841 0000297E 26C43E[9E05]            	les	di,[es:THISSFT]
 17842                                  
 17843                                  	;Entry	Dos_Dup_Direct
 17844                                  DOS_Dup_Direct:
 17845 00002983 E8BCE8                  	call	IsSFTNet
 17846 00002986 7503                    	JNZ	short DO_INC
 17847 00002988 E8F91A                  	call	DEV_OPEN_SFT
 17848                                  DO_INC:
 17849                                  	;INC	word [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count]
 17850 0000298B 26FF05                  	inc	word [ES:DI]		; Clears carry (if this ever wraps
 17851                                  					;   we're in big trouble anyway)
 17852 0000298E C3                      	retn

 17860                                  ;TITLE	DOS_CREATE/DOS_CREATE_NEW - Internal CREATE calls for MS-DOS
 17861                                  ;NAME	DOS_CREATE
 17862                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17863                                  ;**	Internal Create and Create new to create a local or NET file and SFT.
 17864                                  ;
 17865                                  ;	DOS_CREATE
 17866                                  ;	DOS_CREATE_NEW
 17867                                  ;	SET_MKND_ERR
 17868                                  ;	SET_Media_ID
 17869                                  ;	SET_EXT_Mode
 17870                                  ;
 17871                                  ;	Revision history:
 17872                                  ;
 17873                                  ;	    A000 version 4.00	  Jan. 1988
 17874                                  ;	    A001  D490 -- Change IOCTL subfunctios from 63h,43h to 66h, 46h
 17875                                  
 17876                                  ;Installed = TRUE
 17877                                  
 17878                                  ;	i_need	THISSFT,DWORD
 17879                                  ;	i_need	THISCDS,DWORD
 17880                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR,WORD
 17881                                  ;	I_Need	ExtErr_locus,BYTE
 17882                                  ;	I_need	JShare,DWORD
 17883                                  ;	I_need	VOLCHNG_FLAG,BYTE
 17884                                  ;	I_need	SATTRIB,BYTE
 17885                                  ;	I_need	CALLVIDM,DWORD
 17886                                  ;	I_need	EXTOPEN_ON,BYTE 		  ;AN000; extended open
 17887                                  ;	I_need	NAME1,BYTE			  ;AN000;
 17888                                  ;	I_need	NO_NAME_ID,BYTE 		  ;AN000;
 17889                                  ;	I_need	Packet_Temp,WORD		  ;AN000;
 17890                                  ;	I_need	DOS34_FLAG,WORD 		  ;AN000;
 17891                                  ;	I_need	SAVE_BX,WORD			  ;AN000;
 17892                                  
 17893                                  ;***	DOS_CREATE - Create a File
 17894                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17895                                  ;	DOS_Create is called to create the specified file, truncating
 17896                                  ;	the old one if it exists.
 17897                                  ;
 17898                                  ;	ENTRY	AX is Attribute to create
 17899                                  ;		(ds) = DOSDATA
 17900                                  ;		[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 17901                                  ;			terminated)
 17902                                  ;		[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 17903                                  ;			( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 17904                                  ;			 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 17905                                  ;		[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 17906                                  ;			(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 17907                                  ;		[THISSFT] Points to SFT to fill in if file created
 17908                                  ;			(sf_mode field set so that FCB may be detected)
 17909                                  ;		[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 17910                                  ;
 17911                                  ;	EXIT	sf_ref_count is NOT altered
 17912                                  ;		CARRY CLEAR
 17913                                  ;		    THISSFT filled in.
 17914                                  ;			sf_mode = unchanged for FCB, sharing_compat + open_for_both
 17915                                  ;		CARRY SET
 17916                                  ;		    AX is error code
 17917                                  ;			error_path_not_found
 17918                                  ;				Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 17919                                  ;			error_bad_curr_dir
 17920                                  ;				Bad path in current directory part of path
 17921                                  ;			error_access_denied
 17922                                  ;				Attempt to re-create read only file , or
 17923                                  ;				create a second volume id or create a dir
 17924                                  ;			error_sharing_violation
 17925                                  ;				The sharing mode was correct but not allowed
 17926                                  ;				generates an INT 24
 17927                                  ;	USES	all but DS

 18177                                  ; Inputs:
 18178                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 18179                                  ;		terminated)
 18180                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 18181                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 18182                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)

 18184                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))

 18186                                  ;		(sf_mode field set so that FCB may be detected)
 18187                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 18188                                  ;	AX is Attribute to create

 18190                                  ;	Try to create the specified file truncating an old one that exists
 18191                                  ; Outputs:

 18194                                  ;	    THISSFT filled in.
 18195                                  ;		sf_mode = sharing_compat + open_for_both for Non-FCB SFT
 18196                                  ;	CARRY SET
 18197                                  ;	    AX is error code
 18198                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 18199                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 18200                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 18201                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 18202                                  ;		error_access_denied
 18203                                  ;			Create a second volume id or create a dir
 18204                                  ;		error_file_exists

 18206                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed

 18338                                  
 18339                                  ;	TITLE	DOS_OPEN - Internal OPEN call for MS-DOS
 18340                                  ;	NAME	DOS_OPEN
 18341                                  
 18342                                  ;**	OPEN.ASM - File Open
 18343                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18344                                  ;	Low level routines for openning a file from a file spec.
 18345                                  ;	Also misc routines for sharing errors
 18346                                  ;
 18347                                  ;	DOS_Open
 18348                                  ;	Check_Access_AX
 18349                                  ;	SHARE_ERROR
 18350                                  ;	SET_SFT_MODE
 18351                                  ;	Code_Page_Mismatched_Error		   ; DOS 4.00
 18352                                  ;
 18353                                  ;	Revision history:
 18354                                  ;
 18355                                  ;	    Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 18356                                  ;	    A000	version 4.00   Jan. 1988
 18357                                  ;
 18358                                  ;	M034 - The value in save_bx must be pushed on to the stack for
 18359                                  ; 	       remote extended opens and not save_cx.
 18360                                  ;
 18361                                  ;	M035 - if open made from exec then we must set the appropriate bits
 18362                                  ;	       on the stack before calling off to the redir.
 18363                                  ;	M042 - Bit 11 of DOS34_FLAG set indicates that the redir knows how 
 18364                                  ;	       to handle open from exec. In this case set the appropriate bit
 18365                                  ;	       else do not.
 18366                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------	
 18367                                  
 18368                                  ;Installed = TRUE
 18369                                  
 18370                                  ;	i_need	NoSetDir,BYTE
 18371                                  ;	i_need	THISSFT,DWORD
 18372                                  ;	i_need	THISCDS,DWORD
 18373                                  ;	i_need	CURBUF,DWORD
 18374                                  ;	i_need	CurrentPDB,WORD
 18375                                  ;	i_need	CURR_DIR_END,WORD
 18376                                  ;	I_need	RetryCount,WORD
 18377                                  ;	I_need	Open_Access,BYTE
 18378                                  ;	I_need	fSharing,BYTE
 18379                                  ;	i_need	JShare,DWORD
 18380                                  ;	I_need	FastOpenFlg,byte
 18381                                  ;	I_need	EXTOPEN_ON,BYTE 		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18382                                  ;	I_need	ALLOWED,BYTE			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18383                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR,WORD			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18384                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR_LOCUS,BYTE		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18385                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR_ACTION,BYTE		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18386                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR_CLASS,BYTE		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18387                                  ;	I_need	CPSWFLAG,BYTE			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00

 18396                                  ;Break	<DOS_Open - internal file access>
 18397                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18398                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_Open
 18399                                  ;
 18400                                  ; Inputs:
 18401                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 18402                                  ;		terminated)
 18403                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 18404                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 18405                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 18406                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 18407                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 18408                                  ;	[THISSFT] Points to SFT to fill in if file found
 18409                                  ;		(sf_mode field set so that FCB may be detected)
 18410                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 18411                                  ;	AX is Access and Sharing mode
 18412                                  ;	  High NIBBLE of AL (Sharing Mode)
 18413                                  ;		sharing_compat	   file is opened in compatibility mode
 18414                                  ;		sharing_deny_none  file is opened Multi reader, Multi writer
 18415                                  ;		sharing_deny_read  file is opened Only reader, Multi writer
 18416                                  ;		sharing_deny_write file is opened Multi reader, Only writer
 18417                                  ;		sharing_deny_both  file is opened Only reader, Only writer
 18418                                  ;	  Low NIBBLE of AL (Access Mode)
 18419                                  ;		open_for_read	file is opened for reading
 18420                                  ;		open_for_write	file is opened for writing
 18421                                  ;		open_for_both	file is opened for both reading and writing.
 18422                                  ;
 18423                                  ;	  For FCB SFTs AL should = sharing_compat + open_for_both
 18424                                  ;		(not checked)
 18425                                  ; Function:
 18426                                  ;	Try to open the specified file
 18427                                  ; Outputs:
 18428                                  ;	sf_ref_count is NOT altered
 18429                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 18430                                  ;	    THISSFT filled in.
 18431                                  ;	CARRY SET
 18432                                  ;	    AX is error code
 18433                                  ;		error_file_not_found
 18434                                  ;			Last element of path not found
 18435                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 18436                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 18437                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 18438                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 18439                                  ;		error_invalid_access
 18440                                  ;			Bad sharing mode or bad access mode or bad combination
 18441                                  ;		error_access_denied
 18442                                  ;			Attempt to open read only file for writting, or
 18443                                  ;			open a directory
 18444                                  ;		error_sharing_violation
 18445                                  ;			The sharing mode was correct but not allowed
 18446                                  ;			generates an INT 24 on compatibility mode SFTs
 18447                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 18448                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18449                                  
 18450                                  ; 18/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0

 18816                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18817                                  ; Procedure Name : Check_Access
 18818                                  ;
 18819                                  ; Inputs:
 18820                                  ;	AX is mode
 18821                                  ;	  High NIBBLE of AL (Sharing Mode)
 18822                                  ;		sharing_compat	   file is opened in compatibility mode
 18823                                  ;		sharing_deny_none  file is opened Multi reader, Multi writer
 18824                                  ;		sharing_deny_read  file is opened Only reader, Multi writer
 18825                                  ;		sharing_deny_write file is opened Multi reader, Only writer
 18826                                  ;		sharing_deny_both  file is opened Only reader, Only writer
 18827                                  ;	  Low NIBBLE of AL (Access Mode)
 18828                                  ;		open_for_read	file is opened for reading
 18829                                  ;		open_for_write	file is opened for writing
 18830                                  ;		open_for_both	file is opened for both reading and writing.
 18831                                  ; Function:
 18832                                  ;	Check this access mode for correctness
 18833                                  ; Outputs:
 18834                                  ;	[open_access] = AL input
 18835                                  ;	Carry Clear
 18836                                  ;		Mode is correct
 18837                                  ;		AX unchanged
 18838                                  ;	Carry Set
 18839                                  ;		Mode is bad
 18840                                  ;		AX = error_invalid_access
 18841                                  ; No other registers effected
 18842                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18843                                  
 18844                                  Check_Access_AX:

 18890                                  ;**	Low level routine for returning disk drive information from a local
 18891                                  ;	  or NET device
 18892                                  ;
 18893                                  ;	DISK_INFO
 18894                                  ;
 18895                                  ;	  Modification history:
 18896                                  ;
 18897                                  ;		Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 18898                                  
 18899                                  ;	Break	<DISK_INFO -- Get Disk Drive Information>
 18900                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18901                                  ; Procedure Name : DISK_INFO
 18902                                  ;
 18903                                  ; Inputs:
 18904                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to the Macro List Structure of interest
 18905                                  ;		(It MAY NOT be NUL, error not detected)
 18906                                  ; Function:
 18907                                  ;	Get Interesting Drive Information
 18908                                  ; Returns:
 18909                                  ;	DX = Number of free allocation units
 18910                                  ;	BX = Total Number of allocation units on disk
 18911                                  ;	CX = Sector size
 18912                                  ;	AL = Sectors per allocation unit
 18913                                  ;	AH = FAT ID BYTE
 18914                                  ;	Carry set if error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 18915                                  ; Segs except ES preserved, others destroyed
 18916                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18917                                  
 18918                                  ;hkn; called from getset.asm and misc.asm. DS has already been set up to 
 18919                                  ;hkn; DOSDATA. 
 18920                                  
 18921                                  DISK_INFO:
 18922                                  	; 08/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 18923                                  	; IBMDOS.COM (MSDOS 3.3, 1987) - Offset 37C5h
 18924

 18929                                  ;	transfer NET_DISK_INFO
 18930                                  ;ELSE
 18931                                  	;MOV	AX,(MultNET SHL 8) OR 12
 18932                                  	;INT	2FH
 18933                                  	;return
 18934                                  
 18935 00002C1F B80C11                  	mov     ax,110Ch
 18936 00002C22 CD2F                    	int     2Fh	; Multiplex - NETWORK REDIRECTOR - GET DISK SPACE
 18937                                  			; ES:DI -> current directory
 18938                                  			; Return: AL = sectors per cluster, BX = total clusters
 18939                                  			; CX = bytes per sector, DX = number of available clusters
 18940 00002C24 C3                      	retn
 18941                                  ;ENDIF

 18950 00002C38 7239                    	JC	short CRIT_LEAVE

 18952                                  	;mov	ah,[si+20]

 18954

 18956 00002C41 16                      	push	ss
 18957 00002C42 1F                      	pop	ds
 18958                                  	;mov	cx,[es:bp+0Dh]
 18959 00002C43 268B4E0D                	MOV	CX,[ES:BP+DPB.MAX_CLUSTER]
 18960                                  
 18961                                  ; Examine the current free count. If it indicates that we have an invalid
 18962                                  ; count, do the expensive calculation.
 18963                                  
 18964                                  	;mov	dx,[es:bp+1Fh]
 18965 00002C47 268B561F                	MOV	DX,[ES:BP+DPB.FREE_CNT] ; get free count
 18966 00002C4B 83FAFF                  	CMP	DX,-1			; is it valid?

 18968                                  
 18969                                  ; Check to see if it is in a reasonable range. If so, trust it and return.
 18970                                  ; Otherwise, we need to blast out an internal error message and then recompute
 18971                                  ; the count.
 18972                                  
 18973 00002C50 39CA                    	CMP	DX,CX			; is it in a reasonable range?
 18974 00002C52 7222                    	JB	short GotVal		; yes, trust it.
 18975                                  DoScan:
 18976 00002C54 31D2                    	XOR	DX,DX
 18977 00002C56 49                      	DEC	CX
 18978                                  SCANFREE:

 18983                                  NOTFREECLUS:

 18985 00002C60 E2F5                    	LOOP	SCANFREE
 18986 00002C62 4B                      	DEC	BX			; BX was next cluster. Convert to
 18987                                  ReturnVals:

 18989                                  	;mov	al,[es:bp+4]
 18990 00002C64 268A4604                	MOV	AL,[ES:BP+DPB.CLUSTER_MASK]
 18991 00002C68 FEC0                    	INC	AL			; Sectors/cluster
 18992                                  	;mov	cx,[es:bp+2]
 18993 00002C6A 268B4E02                	MOV	CX,[ES:BP+DPB.SECTOR_SIZE] ; Bytes/sector
 18994                                  	;mov	[es:bp+1Fh],dx
 18995 00002C6E 2689561F                	MOV	[ES:BP+DPB.FREE_CNT],DX
 18996 00002C72 F8                      	CLC
 18997                                  CRIT_LEAVE:
 18998                                  	;call	LCritDisk
 18999                                  	;retn

 19001 00002C73 E987E6                  	jmp	LCritDisk

 19003                                  ; We have correctly computed everything previously. Load up registers for
 19004                                  ; return.

 19008 00002C78 EBE9                    	JMP	short ReturnVals

 19015                                  ;	TITLE	DOS_SEARCH - Internal SEARCH calls for MS-DOS
 19016                                  ;	NAME	DOS_SEARCH
 19017                                  
 19018                                  ;**	Low level routines for doing local and NET directory searches
 19019                                  ;
 19020                                  ;	DOS_SEARCH_FIRST
 19021                                  ;	DOS_SEARCH_NEXT
 19022                                  ;	RENAME_NEXT
 19023                                  ;
 19024                                  ;	Revision history:
 19025                                  ;
 19026                                  ;	    Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 19027                                  ;	    A000	version 4.00  Jan. 1988
 19028                                  ;	    A001	PTM 3564 -- search for fastopen
 19029                                  
 19030                                  ;Installed = TRUE
 19031                                  
 19032                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19033                                  ;
 19034                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_SEARCH_FIRST
 19035                                  ;
 19036                                  ; Inputs:
 19037                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 19038                                  ;		terminated)
 19039                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 19040                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 19041                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 19042                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 19043                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 19044                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 19045                                  ;	[DMAADD] Points to 53 byte buffer
 19046                                  ; Function:
 19047                                  ;	Initiate a search for the given file spec
 19048                                  ; Outputs:
 19049                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 19050                                  ;	    The 53 bytes ot DMAADD are filled in as follows:
 19051                                  ;
 19052                                  ;	LOCAL
 19053                                  ;	    Drive Byte (A=1, B=2, ...) High bit clear
 19054                                  ;		NEVER STORE DRIVE BYTE AFTER  found_it
 19055                                  ;	    11 byte search name with Meta chars in it
 19056                                  ;	    Search Attribute Byte, attribute of search
 19057                                  ;	    WORD LastEnt value
 19058                                  ;	    WORD DirStart
 19059                                  ;	    4 byte pad
 19060                                  ;	    32 bytes of the directory entry found
 19061                                  ;	NET
 19062                                  ;	    21 bytes First byte has high bit set
 19063                                  ;	    32 bytes of the directory entry found
 19064                                  ;
 19065                                  ;	CARRY SET
 19066                                  ;	    AX = error code
 19067                                  ;		error_no_more_files
 19068                                  ;			No match for this file
 19069                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 19070                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 19071                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 19072                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 19073                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 19074                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19075                                  
 19076                                  ; 24/01/2024

 19312                                  ;BREAK <DOS_SEARCH_NEXT - scan for subsequent matches>
 19313                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19314                                  ;
 19315                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_SEARCH_NEXT
 19316                                  ;
 19317                                  ; Inputs:
 19318                                  ;	[DMAADD] Points to 53 byte buffer returned by DOS_SEARCH_FIRST
 19319                                  ;	    (only first 21 bytes must have valid information)
 19320                                  ; Function:
 19321                                  ;	Look for subsequent matches
 19322                                  ; Outputs:
 19323                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 19324                                  ;	    The 53 bytes at DMAADD are updated for next call
 19325                                  ;		(see DOS_SEARCH_FIRST)
 19326                                  ;	CARRY SET
 19327                                  ;	    AX = error code
 19328                                  ;		error_no_more_files
 19329                                  ;			No more files to find
 19330                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed

 19478                                  ;**
 19479                                  ;
 19480                                  ; Internal Abort call closes all handles and FCBs associated with a process.
 19481                                  ;  If process has NET resources a close all is sent out over the net.
 19482                                  ;
 19483                                  ;   DOS_ABORT
 19484                                  ;
 19485                                  ;   Modification history:
 19486                                  ;
 19487                                  ;       Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 19488                                  ;
 19489                                  ;	M038	SR	10/16/90	Free SFT with the PSP of the process
 19490                                  ;				being terminated only if it is busy.
 19491                                  ;
 19492                                  
 19493                                  ;Break   <DOS_ABORT -- CLOSE all files for process>
 19494                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19495                                  ;
 19496                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_ABORT
 19497                                  ;
 19498                                  ; Inputs:
 19499                                  ;       [CurrentPDB] set to PID of process aborting
 19500                                  ; Function:
 19501                                  ;       Close all files and free all SFTs for this PID
 19502                                  ; Returns:
 19503                                  ;       None
 19504                                  ; All destroyed except stack
 19505                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19506                                  
 19507                                  DOS_ABORT:
 19508 00002DFB 368E06[3003]            	MOV     ES,[SS:CurrentPDB]	; SS override
 19509 00002E00 268B0E3200              	MOV     CX,[ES:PDB.JFN_Length]  ; Number of JFNs
 19510                                  reset_free_jfn:
 19511 00002E05 89CB                    	MOV     BX,CX
 19512 00002E07 51                      	PUSH    CX
 19513 00002E08 4B                      	DEC     BX                      ; get jfn (start with last one)
 19514                                  
 19515 00002E09 E84A37                  	CALL	_$CLOSE
 19516 00002E0C 59                      	POP     CX
 19517 00002E0D E2F6                    	LOOP    reset_free_jfn          ; and do 'em all
 19518                                  
 19519                                  ; Note: We do need to explicitly close FCBs. Reasons are as follows: If we
 19520                                  ; are running in the no-sharing no-network environment, we are simulating the
 19521                                  ; 2.0 world and thus if the user doesn't close the file, that is his problem
 19522                                  ; BUT... the cache remains in a state with garbage that may be reused by the
 19523                                  ; next process. We scan the set and blast the ref counts of the FCBs we own.
 19524                                  ;
 19525                                  ; If sharing is loaded, then the following call to close process will
 19526                                  ; correctly close all FCBs. We will then need to walk the list AFTER here.
 19527                                  ;
 19528                                  ; Finally, the following call to NET_Abort will cause an EOP to be sent to all
 19529                                  ; known network resources. These resources are then responsible for cleaning
 19530                                  ; up after this process.
 19531                                  ;
 19532                                  ; Sleazy, eh?
 19533                                  
 19534                                  	;context DS			; SS is DOSDATA
 19535 00002E0F 16                      	push	ss
 19536 00002E10 1F                      	pop	ds  ; 09/09/2018
 19537                                  
 19538                                  	;CallInstall Net_Abort, MultNET, 29
 19539 00002E11 B81D11                  	mov	ax,111Dh
 19540 00002E14 CD2F                    	int     2Fh 	; Multiplex - NETWORK REDIRECTOR 
 19541                                  			;	    - CLOSE ALL REMOTE FILES FOR PROCESS
 19542                                  			; DS???, SS = DOS CS
 19543                                  ;if installed
 19544 00002E16 FF1E[A000]              	call	far [JShare+(4*4)]	; 4 = MFTCloseP
 19545                                  ;else
 19546                                  ;	call 	MFTCloseP
 19547                                  ;endif
 19548                                  
 19549                                  ; Scan the FCB cache for guys that belong to this process and zap their ref
 19550                                  ; counts.
 19551                                  					; SS override
 19552 00002E1A 36C43E[4000]            	les     di,[ss:SFTFCB]		; grab the pointer to the table
 19553                                  	;mov	cx,[es:di+4]
 19554 00002E1F 268B4D04                	mov     cx,[es:di+SFT.SFCount]
 19555 00002E23 E317                    	jcxz    FCBScanDone

 19557 00002E25 8D7D06                  	LEA     DI,[DI+SFT.SFTable]	; point at table
 19558 00002E28 36A1[3C03]              	mov     ax,[SS:PROC_ID]		; SS override
 19559                                  FCBTest:
 19560                                  	;cmp	[es:di+31h],ax
 19561 00002E2C 26394531                	cmp	[es:di+SF_ENTRY.sf_PID],ax ; is this one of ours
 19562 00002E30 7505                    	jnz	short FCBNext		; no, skip it
 19563 00002E32 26C7050000              	mov	word [es:di],0
 19564                                  	;mov	word [es:di+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count],0  ; yes, blast ref count
 19565                                  FCBNext:
 19566 00002E37 83C73B                  	add     di,SF_ENTRY.size ; 59 (for MSDOS 6.0)
 19567 00002E3A E2F0                    	loop    FCBTest
 19568                                  FCBScanDone:
 19569                                  
 19570                                  ; Walk the SFT to eliminate all busy SFT's for this process.
 19571                                  
 19572 00002E3C 31DB                    	XOR     BX,BX
 19573                                  Scan:
 19574 00002E3E 53                      	push    bx
 19575 00002E3F E89036                  	call	SFFromSFN
 19576 00002E42 5B                      	pop     bx
 19577                                  	;jnc	short Scan1
 19578                                  	;retn
 19579                                  
 19580                                  	; 18/12/2022
 19581                                  	;jc	short NO_Question ; retn
 19582                                  	; 03/02/2024
 19583 00002E43 7234                    	jc	short RET2
 19584                                  
 19585                                  ;M038
 19586                                  ; Do what the comment above says, check for busy state
 19587                                  
 19588                                  Scan1:
 19589                                  	;cmp	word [es:di],0
 19590                                  	;jz	short scan_next  ; MSDOS 3.3
 19591                                  	; MSDOS 6.0

 19593                                  	;cmp	word [es:di+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count],sf_busy
 19594                                  				; Is Sft busy? ;M038
 19595 00002E49 7519                    	jnz	short scan_next
 19596                                  ;
 19597                                  ; we have a SFT that is busy. See if it is for the current process
 19598                                  ;
 19599 00002E4B 36A1[3C03]              	mov     ax,[SS:PROC_ID]		; SS override
 19600                                  	;cmp	[es:di+31h],ax
 19601 00002E4F 26394531                	cmp	[es:di+SF_ENTRY.sf_PID],ax
 19602 00002E53 750F                    	jnz	short scan_next

 19609                                  
 19610 00002E5F 26C7050000              	mov	word [es:di],0

 20103                                  ; Perform local commit operation by doing a close but not releaseing the SFT.

 20106                                  ; the close decrementing.

 20109                                  ; be done. We do this by providing another entry into close after the
 20110                                  ; decrement and after the share information release.

 20780                                  ;		error happens, DOS retries the entire block assuming that

 21403                                  ;Break	<DOS_WRITE -- MAIN WRITE ROUTINE AND DEVICE OUT ROUTINES>
 21404                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21405                                  ;
 21406                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_WRITE
 21407                                  ;
 21408                                  ; Inputs:
 21409                                  ;	ThisSFT set to the SFT for the file being used
 21410                                  ;	[DMAADD] contains transfer address
 21411                                  ;	CX = No. of bytes to write
 21412                                  ; Function:
 21413                                  ;	Perform write operation
 21414                                  ;	NOTE: If CX = 0 on input, file is truncated or grown
 21415                                  ;		to current sf_position
 21416                                  ; Outputs:
 21417                                  ;    Carry clear
 21418                                  ;	SFT Position and cluster pointers updated
 21419                                  ;	CX = No. of bytes written
 21420                                  ;	ES:DI point to SFT
 21421                                  ;    Carry set
 21422                                  ;	AX is error code
 21423                                  ;	CX = 0
 21424                                  ;	ES:DI point to SFT
 21425                                  ; DS preserved, all other registers destroyed
 21426                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21427                                  
 21428                                  ;hkn; called from fcbio2.asm, handle.asm and dev.asm. DS is set up at this 
 21429                                  ;hkn; point to DOSDATA.
 21430                                  
 21431                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 21432                                  ; DOSCODE:742Ch (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 21433                                  
 21434                                  ; 17/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 21435                                  ; DOSCODE:7418h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)

 21437                                  DOS_WRITE:

 21448                                  
 21449                                  ; NOTE: The following check for writting to a Read Only File is performed
 21450                                  ;	    ONLY on FCBs!!!!
 21451                                  ;	We ALLOW writes to Read Only files via handles to allow a CREATE
 21452                                  ;	    of a read only file which can then be written to.
 21453                                  ;	This is OK because we are NOT ALLOWED to OPEN a RO file via handles
 21454                                  ;	    for writting, or RE-CREATE an EXISTING RO file via handles. Thus,
 21455                                  ;	    CREATing a NEW RO file, or RE-CREATing an existing file which
 21456                                  ;	    is NOT RO to be RO, via handles are the only times we can write
 21457                                  ;	    to a read-only file.
 21458                                  
 21459                                  Check_FCB_RO:
 21460                                  	;;test	word [es:di+2],8000h

 21767                                  ;Break	<DIRREAD -- READ A DIRECTORY SECTOR>
 21768                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21769                                  ;
 21770                                  ; Procedure Name : DIRREAD
 21771                                  ;
 21772                                  ; Inputs:
 21773                                  ;	AX = Directory block number (relative to first block of directory)
 21774                                  ;	ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 21775                                  ;	[DIRSEC] = First sector of first cluster of directory
 21776                                  ;	[CLUSNUM] = Next cluster
 21777                                  ;	[CLUSFAC] = Sectors/Cluster
 21778                                  ; Function:
 21779                                  ;	Read the directory block into [CURBUF].
 21780                                  ; Outputs:
 21781                                  ;	[NXTCLUSNUM] = Next cluster (after the one skipped to)
 21782                                  ;	[SECCLUSPOS] Set

 21784                                  ;	[CURBUF] Points to Buffer with dir sector
 21785                                  ;	Carry set if error (user said FAIL to I 24)
 21786                                  ; DS preserved, all other registers destroyed.
 21787                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21788                                  
 21789                                  ;hkn; called from dir.asm. DS already set up to DOSDATA.
 21790                                  
 21791                                  DIRREAD:
 21792                                  
 21793                                  ; Note that ClusFac is the sectors per cluster. This is NOT necessarily
 21794                                  ; the same as what is in the DPB! In the case of the root directory, we have
 21795                                  ; ClusFac = # sectors in the root directory. The root directory is detected
 21796                                  ; by DIRStart = 0.
 21797                                  
 21798 00003564 31D2                    	XOR	DX,DX
 21799                                  	;CMP	word [DIRSTART],0
 21800                                  	; 21/09/2023
 21801 00003566 3916[C205]              	cmp	[DIRSTART],dx ; 0
 21802 0000356A 7503                    	jnz	short SubDir
 21803 0000356C 92                      	XCHG	AX,DX
 21804 0000356D EB0C                    	JMP	short DoRead
 21805                                  
 21806                                  ; Convert the sector number in AX into cluster and sector-within-cluster pair
 21807                                  
 21808                                  SubDir:
 21809 0000356F 88C2                    	MOV	DL,AL
 21810                                  	;and	dl,[es:bp+4]
 21811 00003571 26225604                	AND	DL,[ES:BP+DPB.CLUSTER_MASK]
 21812                                  
 21813                                  ;	(DX) = sector-in-cluster
 21814                                  
 21815                                  	;mov	cl,[es:bp+5]

 21817 00003579 D3E8                    	SHR	AX,CL
 21818                                  
 21819                                  ;	(DX) = position in cluster
 21820                                  ;	(AX) = number of clusters to skip
 21821                                  
 21822                                  DoRead:

 21824 0000357F 89C1                    	MOV	CX,AX
 21825 00003581 88D4                    	MOV	AH,DL
 21826                                  
 21827                                  ;	(CX) = number of clusters to skip.
 21828                                  ;	(AH) = remainder
 21829                                  
 21830                                  	; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 21831                                  	 
 21832                                  	; MSDOS 6.0

 21834                                  	;MOV	[HIGH_SECTOR],DX	  ;>32mb
 21835                                  	;MOV	DX,[DIRSEC]
 21836                                  	;ADD	DL,AH
 21837                                  	;ADC	DH,0

 21841 00003585 8B16[BE05]              	mov	dx,[DIRSEC]

 21846

 21849 0000359D E319                    	JCXZ	FIRSTCLUSTER
 21850                                  SKPCLLP:

 22972                                  ;
 22973                                  ; Procedure Name : DskRdBufScan
 22974                                  ;
 22975                                  ; Inputs:
 22976                                  ;       CX = # of contiguous sectors read. (These constitute a block of
 22977                                  ;            sectors, also termed an "Extent".)
 22978                                  ;       [HIGH_SECTOR]:DX = physical sector # of first sector in extent.
 22979                                  ;       [TEMP_VAR2]:[TEMP_VAR] = Transfer address (destination data address).
 22980                                  ;       ES:BP -> Drive Parameter Block (DPB).
 22981                                  ;
 22982                                  ; Function:
 22983                                  ;	The Buffer Queue is scanned: the contents of any dirty buffers are
 22984                                  ;	"read" into the transfer memory block, so that the transfer memory
 22985                                  ;	reflects the most recent data.
 22986                                  ;
 22987                                  ; Outputs:
 22988                                  ;       Transfer memory updated as required.
 22989                                  ;
 22990                                  ; Uses:
 22991                                  ;       DS,AX,BX,CX,SI,DI destroyed.
 22992                                  ;       SS override for all global variables.
 22993                                  ;
 22994                                  ; Notes:
 22995                                  ;       FIRST_BUFF_ADDR is set-up to contain the LAST buffer to check, rather
 22996                                  ;	than the FIRST.
 22997                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 22998                                  ;M039: Created
 22999                                  
 23000                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 23001                                  ; DOSCODE:78F0h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 23002                                  
 23003                                  ; 18/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 23004                                  ; DOSCODE:78DCh (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS) 
 23005                                  
 23006                                  ;procedure DskRdBufScan,NEAR
 23007                                  ;
 23008                                  ;ASSUME  DS:NOTHING
 23009                                  
 23010                                  DskRdBufScan:
 23011 0000388A 36833E[7100]00          	cmp	word [ss:DirtyBufferCount],0 ; Any dirty buffers?

 23013

 23015 00003897 89DE                    	mov     si,bx
 23016 00003899 01D1                    	add     cx,dx

 23020                                  	;mov	ax,[di+2]

 23035                                  
 23036                                  bufq:	
 23037                                  	;cmp	al,[di+4]

 23067                                  bufx:
 23068 000038CE C3                      	retn				;Exit.
 23069                                  
 23070                                  ;       Buffer's sector is in Extent: if it is dirty, copy its contents to
 23071                                  ;	transfer memory; otherwise, just re-position it in the buffer queue
 23072                                  ;       as MRU (Most Recently Used).
 23073

 23075 000038CF 50                      	push	ax
 23076                                  	;test	byte [di+5],40h

 23091

 23093                                  ;            block. (Note: the upper word of the sector # may be ignored
 23094                                  ;	     since no more than 64k bytes will ever be read. This 64k limit

 23125                                  bufq03:
 23126                                  	;RestoreReg <es,di,si,dx,cx>
 23127 000038F9 07                      	pop	es
 23128 000038FA 5F                      	pop	di
