 23880                                  ;Break   <DskWrtBufPurge -- Disk Write Buffer Purge>
 23881                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 23882                                  ;
 23883                                  ; Procedure Name : DskWrtBufPurge
 23884                                  ;
 23885                                  ; Inputs:
 23886                                  ;       CX = # of contiguous sectors to write. (These constitute a block of
 23887                                  ;	     sectors, also termed an "Extent".)
 23888                                  ;       [HIGH_SECTOR]:DX = physical sector # of first sector in extent.
 23889                                  ;       ES:BP -> Drive Parameter Block (DPB).
 23890                                  ;
 23891                                  ; Function:
 23892                                  ;       Purge the Buffer Queue and the Secondary Cache of any buffers which
 23893                                  ;	are in Extent; they are being over-written.
 23894                                  ;
 23895                                  ; Outputs:
 23896                                  ;       (Same as Input.)
 23897                                  ; Uses:
 23898                                  ;       All registers except DS,AX,SI,DI preserved.
 23899                                  ;       SS override for all global variables.
 23900                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 23901                                  ;M039: Created
 23902                                  
 23903                                  ;procedure   DskWrtBufPurge,NEAR
 23904                                  ;
 23905                                  ;ASSUME  DS:NOTHING
 23906                                  
 23907                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 23908                                  ; DOSCODE:7C0Eh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 23909                                  
 23910                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 23911                                  ; DOSCODE:7BD4h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS) 
 23912                                  
 23913                                  DskWrtBufPurge:
 23914                                  	;SaveReg <bx,cx>
 23915 00003B8E 53                      	push	bx
 23916 00003B8F 51                      	push	cx
 23917                                  
 23918 00003B90 368B1E[0706]            	mov	bx,[ss:HIGH_SECTOR]	;BX:DX = Extent start (sector #).
 23919 00003B95 89DE                    	mov	si,bx
 23920 00003B97 01D1                    	add	cx,dx
 23921 00003B99 83D600                  	adc	si,0                    ;SI:CX = Extent end + 1.
 23922                                  
 23923                                  	; 21/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 23924                                  	;;mov	al,[es:bp+0]
 23925                                  	;mov	al,[es:bp+DPB.DRIVE]
 23926                                  	; 15/12/2022
 23927 00003B9C 268A4600                	mov	al,[es:bp]
 23928                                  
 23929                                  ;	BX:DX = Extent start.
 23930                                  ;	SI:CX = Extent end + 1.
 23931                                  ;	AL = Drive #
 23932                                  
 23933 00003BA0 36833E[7700]00          	cmp	word [ss:SC_CACHE_COUNT],0 ;Secondary cache in-use?
 23934 00003BA6 7431                    	je	short nosc		; -no, jump.
 23935                                  
 23936                                  ;	If any of the sectors to be written are in the secondary cache (SC),
 23937                                  ;	invalidate the entire SC. (This is an optimization; we really only
 23938                                  ;	need to invalidate those sectors which intersect, but that's slower.)
 23939                                  
 23940 00003BA8 363A06[B00D]            	cmp	al,[ss:CurSC_DRIVE]	;Same drive?
 23941 00003BAD 752A                    	jne	short nosc		; -no, jump.
 23942                                  
 23943 00003BAF 50                      	push    ax
 23944 00003BB0 36A1[B10D]              	mov     ax,[ss:CurSC_SECTOR]
 23945 00003BB4 368B3E[B30D]            	mov     di,[ss:CurSC_SECTOR+2]	;DI:AX = SC start.
 23946                                  
 23947                                  	;Cmp32	si,cx,di,ax		;Extent end < SC start?
 23948                                  	;jbe	short sc5		; -yes, jump.
 23949                                  
 23950 00003BB9 39FE                    	cmp	si,di
 23951 00003BBB 7502                    	jne	short sc01
 23952 00003BBD 39C1                    	cmp	cx,ax
 23953                                  sc01: 
 23954 00003BBF 7617                    	jbe	short sc5
 23955                                  
 23956 00003BC1 360306[7700]            	add	ax,[ss:SC_CACHE_COUNT]
 23957 00003BC6 83D700                  	adc	di,0                    ;DI:AX = SC end + 1.
 23958                                  	
 23959                                  	;Cmp32	bx,dx,di,ax             ;Extent start > SC end?
 23960                                  	;jae	short sc5		; -yes, jump.
 23961                                  
 23962 00003BC9 39FB                    	cmp	bx,di
 23963 00003BCB 7502                    	jne	short sc02
 23964 00003BCD 39C2                    	cmp	dx,ax
 23965                                  sc02:
 23966 00003BCF 7307                    	jnb	short sc5
 23967                                  
 23968 00003BD1 36C706[B50D]0000        	mov	word [ss:SC_STATUS],0	;Extent intersects SC: invalidate SC.
 23969                                  sc5:	
 23970 00003BD8 58                      	pop     ax
 23971                                  
 23972                                  ;	Free any buffered sectors which are in Extent; they are being over-
 23973                                  ;	written.
 23974                                  
 23975                                  nosc:	
 23976 00003BD9 E85A1B                  	call	GETCURHEAD		;DS:DI -> first buffer in queue.
 23977                                  
 23978                                  _bufq:	
 23979                                  	;cmpo	al,[di+4]
 23980 00003BDC 3A4504                  	cmp     al,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_ID] ;Same drive?
 23981 00003BDF 7527                    	jne	short bufq5		; -no, jump.
 23982                                  
 23983                                  ;       Cmp32   bx,dx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 23984                                  ;       ja	short bufq5		;Jump if Extent start > buffer sector.
 23985                                  
 23986                                  	;cmp	bx,[di+8]
 23987 00003BE1 3B5D08                  	cmp	bx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]
 23988 00003BE4 7503                    	jne	short bufq04
 23989                                  	;cmp	dx,[di+6]
 23990 00003BE6 3B5506                  	cmp	dx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 23991                                  bufq04:
 23992 00003BE9 771D                    	ja	short bufq5
 23993                                  
 23994                                  ;       Cmp32   si,cx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 23995                                  ;       jbe	short bufq5		;Jump if Extent end < buffer sector.
 23996                                  
 23997                                  	;cmp	si,[di+8]
 23998 00003BEB 3B7508                  	cmp	si,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]
 23999 00003BEE 7503                    	jne	short bufq05
 24000                                  	;cmp	cx,[di+6]
 24001 00003BF0 3B4D06                  	cmp	cx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 24002                                  bufq05:
 24003 00003BF3 7613                    	jbe	short bufq5
 24004                                  
 24005                                  ;	Buffer's sector is in Extent, so free it; it is being over-written.
 24006                                  
 24007                                  	;test	byte [di+5],40h
 24008 00003BF5 F6450540                	test	byte [di+BUFFINFO.buf_flags],buf_dirty ;Buffer dirty?
 24009 00003BF9 7403                    	jz	short bufq4		; -no, jump.
 24010 00003BFB E8C21D                  	call	DEC_DIRTY_COUNT		; -yes, decrement dirty count.
 24011                                  bufq4:
 24012                                  	;mov	word [di+4],20FFh
 24013 00003BFE C74504FF20              	mov     word [di+BUFFINFO.buf_ID],((buf_visit<<8)|0FFh)
 24014                                  
 24015 00003C03 E8421B                  	call	SCANPLACE
 24016 00003C06 EB02                    	jmp     short bufq6
 24017                                  bufq5: 
 24018 00003C08 8B3D                    	mov     di,[di]
 24019                                  	;mov	di,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_next]
 24020                                  bufq6: 
 24021 00003C0A 363B3E[BB0E]            	cmp	di,[ss:FIRST_BUFF_ADDR]	;Scanned entire buffer queue?
 24022 00003C0F 75CB                    	jne	short _bufq		; --no, go do next buffer.
 24023                                  	
 24024                                  	;RestoreReg <cx,bx>
 24025 00003C11 59                      	pop	cx
 24026 00003C12 5B                      	pop	bx
 24027 00003C13 C3                      	retn
 24028                                  
 24029                                  ;EndProc DskWrtBufPurge
 24030                                  
 24031                                  ;Break   <DIV32 -- PERFORM 32 BIT DIVIDE>
 24032                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24033                                  ;
 24034                                  ; Procedure Name : DIV32
 24035                                  ;
 24036                                  ; Inputs:
 24037                                  ;       DX:AX = 32 bit dividend   BX= divisor
 24038                                  ; Function:
 24039                                  ;       Perform 32 bit division:  DX:AX/BX = CX:AX + DX (rem.)
 24040                                  ; Outputs:
 24041                                  ;       CX:AX = quotient , DX= remainder
 24042                                  ; Uses:
 24043                                  ;       All registers except AX,CX,DX preserved.
 24044                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24045                                  ;M039: DIV32 optimized for divisor of 512 (common sector size).
 24046                                  
 24047                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 24048                                  ; DOSCODE:7C94h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 24049                                  
 24050                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 24051                                  ; DOSCODE:7C5Ah (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS) 
 24052                                  
 24053                                  DIV32:
 24054 00003C14 81FB0002                	cmp	bx,512
 24055 00003C18 7515                    	jne	short div5
 24056                                  
 24057 00003C1A 89D1                    	mov	cx,dx
 24058 00003C1C 89C2                    	mov	dx,ax           ; CX:AX = Dividend
 24059 00003C1E 81E2FF01                	and	dx,(512-1)      ; DX = Remainder
 24060 00003C22 88E0                    	mov	al,ah
 24061 00003C24 88CC                    	mov	ah,cl
 24062 00003C26 88E9                    	mov	cl,ch
 24063 00003C28 30ED                    	xor	ch,ch
 24064 00003C2A D1E9                    	shr	cx,1
 24065 00003C2C D1D8                    	rcr	ax,1
 24066 00003C2E C3                      	retn
 24067                                  div5:	
 24068 00003C2F 89C1                    	mov	cx,ax
 24069 00003C31 89D0                    	mov	ax,dx
 24070 00003C33 31D2                    	xor	dx,dx
 24071 00003C35 F7F3                    	div	bx              ; 0:AX/BX
 24072 00003C37 91                      	xchg	cx,ax
 24073 00003C38 F7F3                    	div	bx              ; DX:AX/BX
 24074 00003C3A C3                      	retn
 24075                                  
 24076                                  ;Break   <SHR32 -- PERFORM 32 BIT SHIFT RIGHT>
 24077                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24078                                  ;
 24079                                  ; Procedure Name : SHR32
 24080                                  ;
 24081                                  ; Inputs:
 24082                                  ;	DX:AX = 32 bit sector number
 24083                                  ; Function:
 24084                                  ;       Perform 32 bit shift right
 24085                                  ; Outputs:
 24086                                  ;	AX = cluster number
 24087                                  ;	ZF = 1 if no error
 24088                                  ;	   = 0 if error (cluster number > 64k)
 24089                                  ; Uses:
 24090                                  ;       DX,CX
 24091                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24092                                  ; M017	- SHR32 rewritten for better performance
 24093                                  ; M039	- Additional optimization
 24094                                  
 24095                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 24096                                  ; DOSCODE:7CBBh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 24097                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 24098                                  ; DOSCODE:7C81h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS) 
 24099                                  
 24100                                  SHR32:
 24101                                  	;mov	cl,[es:bp+5]
 24102 00003C3B 268A4E05                	mov	cl,[ES:BP+DPB.CLUSTER_SHIFT]
 24103 00003C3F 30ED                    	xor	ch,ch	    ;ZF=1
 24104 00003C41 E306                    	jcxz	norota
 24105                                  
 24106                                  rotashft2:
 24107 00003C43 D1EA                    	shr	dx,1	    ;ZF reflects state of DX.
 24108 00003C45 D1D8                    	rcr	ax,1	    ;ZF not affected.
 24109 00003C47 E2FA                    	loop	rotashft2
 24110                                  norota:
 24111 00003C49 C3                      	retn
 24112

 24119                                  ;	TITLE	DIR - Directory and path cracking
 24120                                  ;	NAME	Dir
 24121                                  
 24122                                  ;Break	<FINDENTRY -- LOOK FOR AN ENTRY>
 24123                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24124                                  ;
 24125                                  ; Procedure Name : FINDENTRY,SEARCH
 24126                                  ;
 24127                                  ; Inputs:
 24128                                  ;	[THISDPB] set
 24129                                  ;	[SECCLUSPOS] = 0
 24130                                  ;	[DIRSEC] = Starting directory sector number
 24131                                  ;	[CLUSNUM] = Next cluster of directory
 24132                                  ;	[CLUSFAC] = Sectors/Cluster
 24133                                  ;	[NAME1] = Name to look for
 24134                                  ; Function:
 24135                                  ;	Find file name in disk directory.
 24136                                  ;	"?" matches any character.
 24137                                  ; Outputs:
 24138                                  ;	Carry set if name not found
 24139                                  ;	ELSE
 24140                                  ;	Zero set if attributes match (always except when creating)
 24141                                  ;	AH = Device ID (bit 7 set if not disk)
 24142                                  ;	[THISDPB] = Base of drive parameters
 24143                                  ;	DS = DOSGROUP
 24144                                  ;	ES = DOSGROUP
 24145                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:BX = Pointer into directory buffer
 24146                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:SI = Pointer to First Cluster field in directory entry
 24147                                  ;	[CURBUF] has directory record with match
 24148                                  ;	[NAME1] has file name
 24149                                  ;	[LASTENT] is entry number of the entry
 24150                                  ; All other registers destroyed.
 24151                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24152                                  
 24153                                  ;hkn; called from rename.asm and dir2.asm. DS must be already set up at
 24154                                  ;hkn; this point.
 24155                                  
 24156                                  SEARCH:
 24157                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)

 24313                                  ; Procedure Name : MetaCompare
 24314                                  ;
 24315                                  ; Inputs:
 24316                                  ;	DS:SI -> 11 character FCB style name NO '?'
 24317                                  ;	    Typically this is a directory entry. It MUST be in upper case
 24318                                  ;	ES:DI -> 11 character FCB style name with possible '?'
 24319                                  ;	    Typically this is a FCB or SFT. It MUST be in upper case
 24320                                  ; Function:
 24321                                  ;	Compare FCB style names allowing for ? match to any char
 24322                                  ; Outputs:
 24323                                  ;	Zero if match else NZ
 24324                                  ; Destroys CX,SI,DI all others preserved
 24325                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24326                                  
 24327                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)

 24452                                  ;
 24453                                  ; Procedure Name : GETENTRY
 24454                                  ;
 24455                                  ; Inputs:
 24456                                  ;	[LASTENT] has directory entry
 24457                                  ;	ES:BP points to drive parameters
 24458                                  ;	[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM],[CLUSFAC],[ENTLAST] set for DIR involved
 24459                                  ; Function:
 24460                                  ;	Locates directory entry in preparation for search
 24461                                  ;	GETENT provides entry for passing desired entry in AX
 24462                                  ; Outputs:
 24463                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:BX = Pointer to next directory entry in CURBUF
 24464                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:DX = Pointer to first byte after end of CURBUF
 24465                                  ;	[LASTENT] = New directory entry number
 24466                                  ;	[NXTCLUSNUM],[SECCLUSPOS] set via DIRREAD
 24467                                  ;	Carry set if error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 24468                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24469                                  
 24470                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 24471                                  GETENTRY:
 24472                                  	; 27/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 24473 00003D54 A1[4803]                	MOV	AX,[LASTENT]
 24474                                  
 24475                                  	;entry	GETENT
 24476                                  GETENT:
 24477 00003D57 A3[4803]                	MOV	[LASTENT],AX
 24478                                  ;
 24479                                  ; Convert the entry number in AX into a byte offset from the beginning of the
 24480                                  ; directory.
 24481                                  ;
 24482 00003D5A B105                    	mov	cl,5			; shift left by 5 = mult by 32
 24483 00003D5C D3C0                    	rol	ax,cl			; keep hight order bits
 24484 00003D5E 89C2                    	mov	dx,ax
 24485                                  	; 19/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 24486                                  	;and	ax,0FFE0h
 24487                                  	; 21/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 24488                                  	;and	ax,~(32-1)		; mask off high order bits
 24489                                  	; 16/12/2022
 24490 00003D60 24E0                    	and	al,0E0h ; ~31
 24491 00003D62 83E21F                  	and	dx,1Fh
 24492                                  	;and	dx,32-1			; mask off low order bits
 24493                                  ;
 24494                                  ; DX:AX contain the byte offset of the required directory entry from the
 24495                                  ; beginning of the directory. Convert this to a sector number. Round the
 24496                                  ; sector size down to a multiple of 32.
 24497                                  ;
 24498                                  	;mov	bx,[es:bp+2]
 24499 00003D65 268B5E02                	MOV	BX,[ES:BP+DPB.SECTOR_SIZE]
 24500 00003D69 80E3E0                  	and	bl,0E0h
 24501                                  	;AND	BL,255-31		; Must be multiple of 32
 24502 00003D6C F7F3                    	DIV	BX
 24503                                  	; 14/02/2024

 24506                                  				; Erdogan Tan - 14/02/2024

 24635                                  ;	TITLE	DIR2 - Directory and path cracking
 24636                                  ;	NAME	Dir2
 24637                                  
 24638                                  ;Break	<GETPATH -- PARSE A WFP>
 24639                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24640                                  ;
 24641                                  ; Procedure Name : GETPATH
 24642                                  ;
 24643                                  ; Inputs:
 24644                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:\" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 24645                                  ;		terminated; d:/ (note forward slash) indicates a real device).
 24646                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 24647                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 24648                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 24649                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 24650                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 24651                                  ;	[NoSetDir] set
 24652                                  ;	[THISDPB] set to DPB if disk otherwise garbage.
 24653                                  ; Function:
 24654                                  ;	Crack the path
 24655                                  ; Outputs:
 24656                                  ;	Sets EXTERR_LOCUS = errLOC_Disk if disk file
 24657                                  ;	Sets EXTERR_LOCUS = errLOC_Unk if char device
 24658                                  ;	ID1 field of [THISCDS] updated appropriately
 24659                                  ;	[ATTRIB] = [SATTRIB]
 24660                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 24661                                  ;	Carry set if bad path
 24662                                  ;	   SI Points to path element causing failure
 24663                                  ;	   Zero set
 24664                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC] are set up to
 24665                                  ;	      start a search on the last directory
 24666                                  ;	      CL is zero if there is a bad name in the path
 24667                                  ;	      CL is non-zero if the name was simply not found
 24668                                  ;		 [ENTFREE] may have free spot in directory
 24669                                  ;		 [NAME1] is the name.
 24670                                  ;		 CL = 81H if '*'s or '?' in NAME1, 80H otherwise
 24671                                  ;	   Zero reset
 24672                                  ;	      File in middle of path or bad name in path or attribute mismatch
 24673                                  ;		or path too long or malformed path
 24674                                  ;	ELSE
 24675                                  ;	   [CurBuf] = -1 if root directory
 24676                                  ;	   [CURBUF] contains directory record with match
 24677                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:BX Points into [CURBUF] to start of entry
 24678                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:SI Points into [CURBUF] to dir_first field for entry
 24679                                  ;	   AH = device ID
 24680                                  ;	      bit 7 of AH set if device SI and BX
 24681                                  ;	      will point DOSGROUP relative The firclus
 24682                                  ;	      field of the device entry contains the device pointer
 24683                                  ;	   [NAME1] Has name looked for
 24684                                  ;	   If last element is a directory zero is set and:
 24685                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[SECCLUSPOS],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC]
 24686                                  ;	      are set up to start a search on it.
 24687                                  ;	      unless [NoSetDir] is non zero in which case the return is
 24688                                  ;	      like that for a file (except for zero flag)
 24689                                  ;	   If last element is a file zero is reset
 24690                                  ;	      [DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM],[CLUSFAC],[NXTCLUSNUM],[SECCLUSPOS],
 24691                                  ;	      [LASTENT], [ENTLAST] are set to continue search of last
 24692                                  ;	      directory for furthur matches on NAME1 via the NEXTENT
 24693                                  ;	      entry point in FindEntry (or GETENT entry in GETENTRY in
 24694                                  ;	      which case [NXTCLUSNUM] and [SECCLUSPOS] need not be valid)
 24695                                  ; DS preserved, Others destroyed
 24696                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24697                                  
 24698                                  ;hkn; called from delete.asm, finfo.asm, mknode.asm and rename.asm.
 24699                                  ;hkn; DS already set up at this point.
 24700                                  
 24701                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 24702                                  GETPATH:

 24738 00003E0B C606[2303]01            	MOV	byte [EXTERR_LOCUS],errLOC_Unk ; In the particular case of
 24739                                  					; "finding" a char device
 24740                                  					; set LOCUS to Unknown. This makes
 24741                                  					; certain idiotic problems reported
 24742                                  					; by a certain 3 letter OEM go away.
 24743                                  
 24744                                  ; Take name in name1 and pack it back into where wfp_start points. This

 24802                                  	;mov	bx,[es:di+73]

 24951                                  ;Break	<ROOTPATH, FINDPATH -- PARSE A PATH>
 24952                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24953                                  ;
 24954                                  ; Procedure Name : ROOTPATH,FINDPATH
 24955                                  ;
 24956                                  ; Inputs:
 24957                                  ;	Same as FINDPATH but,
 24958                                  ;	SI Points to asciz string of path which is assumed to start at
 24959                                  ;		the root (no leading '/').
 24960                                  ; Function:
 24961                                  ;	Search from root for path
 24962                                  ; Outputs:
 24963                                  ;	Same as FINDPATH but:
 24964                                  ;	If root directory specified, [CURBUF] and [NAME1] are NOT set, and
 24965                                  ;	[NoSetDir] is ignored.
 24966                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24967                                  
 24968                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 24969                                  	; DOSCODE:7F47h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 24970                                  
 24971                                  ROOTPATH:
 24972 00003ECB E8F1FE                  	call	SETROOTSRCH
 24973                                  	; 24/09/2023
 24974 00003ECE 30E4                    	xor	ah,ah
 24975                                  	;CMP	BYTE [SI],0
 24976 00003ED0 3824                    	cmp	[si],ah ; 0
 24977 00003ED2 7507                    	JNZ	short FINDPATH
 24978                                  
 24979                                  ; Root dir specified
 24980 00003ED4 A0[6D05]                	MOV	AL,[SATTRIB]
 24981 00003ED7 A2[6B05]                	MOV	[ATTRIB],AL
 24982                                  	; 24/09/2023
 24983                                  	;XOR	AH,AH			; Sets "device ID" byte, sets zero
 24984                                  					; (dir), clears carry.
 24985 00003EDA C3                      	retn
 24986                                  
 24987                                  ; Inputs:
 24988                                  ;	[ATTRIB] Set to get through directories
 24989                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Set to find last element
 24990                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 24991                                  ;	SI Points to asciz string of path (no leading '/').
 24992                                  ;	[SECCLUSPOS] = 0
 24993                                  ;	[DIRSEC] = Phys sec # of first sector of directory
 24994                                  ;	[CLUSNUM] = Cluster # of next cluster
 24995                                  ;	[CLUSFAC] = Sectors per cluster
 24996                                  ;	[NoSetDir] set
 24997                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 24998                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 24999                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 25000                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 25001                                  ;	[CREATING] and [DELALL] set
 25002                                  ; Function:
 25003                                  ;	Parse path name
 25004                                  ; Outputs:
 25005                                  ;	ID1 field of [THISCDS] updated appropriately
 25006                                  ;	[ATTRIB] = [SATTRIB]
 25007                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 25008                                  ;	[THISDPB] = ES:BP
 25009                                  ;	Carry set if bad path
 25010                                  ;	   SI Points to path element causing failure
 25011                                  ;	   Zero set
 25012                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC] are set up to
 25013                                  ;	      start a search on the last directory
 25014                                  ;	      CL is zero if there is a bad name in the path
 25015                                  ;	      CL is non-zero if the name was simply not found
 25016                                  ;		 [ENTFREE] may have free spot in directory
 25017                                  ;		 [NAME1] is the name.
 25018                                  ;		 CL = 81H if '*'s or '?' in NAME1, 80H otherwise
 25019                                  ;	   Zero reset
 25020                                  ;	      File in middle of path or bad name in path
 25021                                  ;		or path too long or malformed path
 25022                                  ;	ELSE
 25023                                  ;	   [CURBUF] contains directory record with match
 25024                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:BX Points into [CURBUF] to start of entry
 25025                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:SI Points to fcb_FIRCLUS field for entry
 25026                                  ;	   [NAME1] Has name looked for
 25027                                  ;	   AH = device ID
 25028                                  ;	      bit 7 of AH set if device SI and BX
 25029                                  ;	      will point DOSGROUP relative The firclus
 25030                                  ;	      field of the device entry contains the device pointer
 25031                                  ;	   If last element is a directory zero is set and:
 25032                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[SECCLUSPOS],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC]
 25033                                  ;	      are set up to start a search on it,
 25034                                  ;	      unless [NoSetDir] is non zero in which case the return is
 25035                                  ;	      like that for a file (except for zero flag)
 25036                                  ;	   If last element is a file zero is reset
 25037                                  ;	      [DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM],[CLUSFAC],[NXTCLUSNUM],[SECCLUSPOS],
 25038                                  ;	      [LASTENT], [ENTLAST] are set to continue search of last
 25039                                  ;	      directory for furthur matches on NAME1 via the NEXTENT
 25040                                  ;	      entry point in FindEntry (or GETENT entry in GETENTRY in
 25041                                  ;	      which case [NXTCLUSNUM] and [SECCLUSPOS] need not be valid)
 25042                                  ; Destroys all other registers
 25043                                  
 25044                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 25045                                  	; DOSCODE:7F58h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 25046                                  
 25047                                  	; 15/02/2024 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS)
 25048                                  	; DOSCODE:7F93h (MSDOS 6.22, MSDOS.SYS)
 25049                                  
 25050                                      	;entry	FINDPATH
 25051                                  FINDPATH:
 25052 00003EDB 06                      	PUSH	ES			; Save ES:BP
 25053 00003EDC 56                      	PUSH	SI
 25054 00003EDD 89F7                    	MOV	DI,SI
 25055 00003EDF 8B0E[C205]              	MOV	CX,[DIRSTART]		; Get start clus of dir being searched
 25056 00003EE3 833E[B605]FF            	CMP	word [CURR_DIR_END],-1
 25057 00003EE8 740E                    	JZ	short NOIDS		; No current dir part
 25058 00003EEA 3B3E[B605]              	CMP	DI,[CURR_DIR_END]
 25059 00003EEE 7508                    	JNZ	short NOIDS		; Not to current dir end yet
 25060 00003EF0 C43E[A205]              	LES	DI,[THISCDS]
 25061                                  	;mov	[es:di+73],cx
 25062 00003EF4 26894D49                	MOV	[ES:DI+curdir.ID],CX	; Set current directory cluster
 25063                                  NOIDS:
 25064                                  
 25065                                  ; Parse the name off of DS:SI into NAME1. AL = 1 if there was a meta
 25066                                  ; character in the string. CX,DI may be destroyed.
 25067                                  ;
 25068                                  ;	invoke	NAMETRANS
 25069                                  ;	MOV	CL,AL
 25070                                  ;
 25071                                  ; The above is the slow method. The name has *already* been munged by
 25072                                  ; TransPath so no special casing needs to be done. All we do is try to copy
 25073                                  ; the name until ., \ or 0 is hit.
 25074                                  
 25075                                  	;MOV	AX,SS
 25076                                  	;MOV	ES,AX
 25077                                  	; 15/02/2024 - Retro DOS v4.2
 25078 00003EF8 16                      	push	ss
 25079 00003EF9 07                      	pop	es
 25080                                  
 25081                                  ;hkn; Name1 is in DOSDATA
 25082 00003EFA BF[4B05]                	MOV	DI,NAME1
 25083 00003EFD B82020                  	MOV	AX,'  ' ; 2020h
 25084 00003F00 AA                      	STOSB
 25085 00003F01 AB                      	STOSW
 25086 00003F02 AB                      	STOSW
 25087 00003F03 AB                      	STOSW
 25088 00003F04 AB                      	STOSW
 25089 00003F05 AB                      	STOSW
 25090                                  
 25091                                  ;hkn; Name1 is in DOSDATA
 25092 00003F06 BF[4B05]                	MOV	DI,NAME1

 25793                                  ;Break	<CheckThisDevice - Check for being a device>
 25794                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 25795                                  ;
 25796                                  ;   CheckThisDevice - Examine the area at DS:SI to see if there is a valid
 25797                                  ;   device specified. We will return carry if there is a device present. 
 25798                                  ;   The forms of devices we will recognize are:
 25799                                  ;
 25800                                  ;	[path]device
 25801                                  ;
 25802                                  ;   Note that the drive letter has *already* been removed. All other forms
 25803                                  ;   are not considered to be devices. If such a device is found we change
 25804                                  ;   the source pointer to point to the device component.
 25805                                  ;
 25806                                  ;   Inputs:	ES is DOSDATA
 25807                                  ;		DS:SI contains name

 25837 000041D6 7526                    	JNZ	short NotDevice
 25838 000041D8 AC                      	LODSB

 25840 000041DC 7520                    	JNZ	short NotDevice		; no. go for it.

 27431                                  ;
 27432                                  ; Procedure Name : MakeNode
 27433                                  ;
 27434                                  ; Inputs:
 27435                                  ;       AL - attribute to create
 27436                                  ;       AH = 0 if it is ok to truncate a file already by this name
 27437                                  ;	AH != 0 if truncation not allowed (prexisting file is an error)
 27438                                  ;               (AH ignored on dirs and devices)
 27439                                  ;
 27440                                  ;        NOTE: When making a DIR or volume ID, AH need not be set since
 27441                                  ;               a name already existant is ALWAYS an error in these cases.
 27442                                  ;
 27443                                  ;       [WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 27444                                  ;               terminated)
 27445                                  ;       [CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 27446                                  ;               ( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 27447                                  ;                Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 27448                                  ;       [THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 27449                                  ;       [THISSFT] Points to an empty SFT. EXCEPT sf_mode filled in.
 27450                                  ; Function:
 27451                                  ;       Make a new node
 27452                                  ; Outputs:
 27453                                  ;       Sets EXTERR_LOCUS = errLOC_Disk or errLOC_Unk via GetPathNoset
 27454                                  ;       CARRY SET IF ERROR
 27455                                  ;          AX = 1 A node by this name exists and is a directory
 27456                                  ;          AX = 2 A new node could not be created
 27457                                  ;          AX = 3 A node by this name exists and is a disk file
 27458                                  ;               (AH was NZ on input)
 27459                                  ;          AX = 4 Bad Path
 27460                                  ;               SI return from GetPath maintained
 27461                                  ;          AX = 5 Attribute mismatch
 27462                                  ;          AX = 6 Sharing Violation
 27463                                  ;               (INT 24 generated ALWAYS since create is always compat mode
 27464                                  ;          AX = 7 file not found for Extended Open (not exists and fails)
 27465                                  ;       ELSE
 27466                                  ;          AX = 0 Disk Node
 27467                                  ;          AX = 3 Device Node (error in some cases)
 27468                                  ;          [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSFAC],[CLUSNUM] set to directory
 27469                                  ;               containing new node.
 27470                                  ;          [CURBUF+2]:BX Points to entry
 27471                                  ;          [CURBUF+2]:SI Points to entry.dir_first
 27472                                  ;          [THISSFT] is filled in
 27473                                  ;               sf_mode = unchanged.
 27474                                  ;          Attribute byte in entry is input AL
 27475                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 27476                                  ;
 27477                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27478                                  
 27479                                  ; 19/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 27480                                  ; DOSCODE:8925h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 27481                                  
 27482                                  ; 22/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27483                                  ; DOSCODE:88EAh (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 27484                                  
 27485                                  ; 23/02/2024 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS)

 27668                                  
 27669                                  ; We have found an existing file. We have also entered it into the share set.
 27670                                  ; At this point we need to call newentry to correctly address the problem of
 27671                                  ; getting rid of old data (create an existing file) or creating a new
 27672                                  ; directory entry (create a new file). Unfortunately, this operation may
 27673                                  ; result in an INT 24 that the user doesn't return from, thus locking the file
 27674                                  ; irretrievably into the share set. The correct solution is for us to LEAVE
 27675                                  ; the share set now, do the operation and then reassert the share access.
 27676                                  ;
 27677                                  ; We are allowed to do this! There is no window! After all, we are in
 27678                                  ; critDisk here and for someone else to get in, they must enter critDisk also.
 27679                                  
 27680                                  	; 22/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27681                                  	; DOSCODE:89C8h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)

 27727                                  ;
 27728                                  ; Procedure Name : NEWENTRY
 27729                                  ;
 27730                                  ; Inputs:
 27731                                  ;	  [THISSFT] set
 27732                                  ;	  [THISDPB] set
 27733                                  ;	  [LASTENT] current last valid entry number in directory if no free
 27734                                  ;		  entries
 27735                                  ;	  [VOLID] set if a volume ID was found during search
 27736                                  ;	Attrib Contains attributes for new file
 27737                                  ;	  [DIRSTART] Points to first cluster of dir (0 means root)
 27738                                  ;	  CARRY FLAG INDICATES STATUS OF SEARCH FOR FILE
 27739                                  ;		  NC means file existed (device)
 27740                                  ;		  C  means file did not exist
 27741                                  ;	  AH = Device ID byte
 27742                                  ;	  If FILE
 27743                                  ;	  [CURBUF+2]:BX points to start of directory entry
 27744                                  ;	  [CURBUF+2]:SI points to dir_first of directory entry
 27745                                  ;	  If device
 27746                                  ;	  DS:BX points to start of "fake" directory entry
 27747                                  ;	  DS:SI points to dir_first of "fake" directory entry
 27748                                  ;		  (has DWORD pointer to device header)
 27749                                  ; Function:
 27750                                  ;	  Make a new directory entry
 27751                                  ;	  If an old one existed it is truncated first
 27752                                  ; Outputs:
 27753                                  ;	  Carry set if error
 27754                                  ;		  Can't grow dir, atts didn't match, attempt to make 2nd
 27755                                  ;		  vol ID, user FAILed to I 24
 27756                                  ;	  else
 27757                                  ;		  outputs of DOOPEN
 27758                                  ; DS, BX, SI preserved (meaning on SI BX, not value), others destroyed
 27759                                  ;
 27760                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27761                                  
 27762                                  	; 22/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27763                                  	; DOSCODE:89F9h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 27764

 28206                                  ; Procedure Name : CHECK_VIRT_OPEN
 28207                                  ;
 28208                                  ; CHECK_VIRT_OPEN checks to see if we had performed a "virtual open" (by
 28209                                  ; examining the flag [VIRTUAL_OPEN] to see if it is 1). If we did, then
 28210                                  ; it calls Dev_Close_SFT to decrement the ref. count. It also resets the
 28211                                  ; flag [VIRTUAL_OPEN].
 28212                                  ; No registers affected (including flags).
 28213                                  ; On input, [THISSFT] points to current SFT.
 28214                                  ;
 28215                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 28216                                  
 28217                                  CHECK_VIRT_OPEN:
 28218 00004AAC 50                      	PUSH	AX
 28219 00004AAD 9F                      	lahf			; preserve flags
 28220 00004AAE 803E[A20A]00            	CMP	byte [VIRTUAL_OPEN],0
 28221 00004AB3 7410                    	JZ	short ALL_CLOSED
 28222 00004AB5 C606[A20A]00            	mov	byte [VIRTUAL_OPEN],0 ; reset flag
 28223 00004ABA 06                      	push	es
 28224 00004ABB 57                      	push	di
 28225 00004ABC C43E[9E05]              	LES	DI,[THISSFT]
 28226 00004AC0 E8C9F9                  	call	DEV_CLOSE_SFT
 28227 00004AC3 5F                      	pop	di
 28228 00004AC4 07                      	pop	es
 28229

 28232 00004AC6 58                      	POP	AX
 28233 00004AC7 C3                      	retn

 28269                                  ; Procedure Name : FNDCLUS
 28270                                  ;
 28271                                  ; Inputs:

 28824                                  ; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 28825                                  ; DOSCODE:8DC2h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 28826                                  
 28827                                  ; 30/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 28828                                  ; IBMDOS.COM (MSDOS 3.3, 1987) - Offset 
 28829                                  
 28830                                  ;Break   <ALLOCATE -- Assign disk space>
 28831                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 28832                                  ;
 28833                                  ; Procedure Name : ALLOCATE - Allocate Disk Space
 28834                                  ;
 28835                                  ;   ALLOCATE is called to allocate disk clusters. The new clusters are
 28836                                  ;   FAT-chained onto the end of the existing file.
 28837                                  ;
 28838                                  ;   The DPB contains the cluster # of the last free cluster allocated
 28839                                  ;   (dpb_next_free). We start at this cluster and scan towards higher
 28840                                  ;   numbered clusters, looking for the necessary free blocks.
 28841                                  ;
 28842                                  ;   Once again, fancy terminology gets in the way of correct coding. When
 28843                                  ;   using next_free, start scanning AT THAT POINT and not the one following it.
 28844                                  ;   This fixes the boundary condition bug when only free = next_free = 2.
 28845                                  ;
 28846                                  ;       If we get to the end of the disk without satisfaction:
 28847                                  ;
 28848                                  ;           if (dpb_next_free == 2) then we've scanned the whole disk.
 28849                                  ;               return (insufficient_disk_space)
 28850                                  ;           ELSE
 28851                                  ;               dpb_next_free = 2; start scan over from the beginning.
 28852                                  ;
 28853                                  ;   Note that there is no multitasking interlock. There is no race when
 28854                                  ;   examining the entrys in an in-core FAT block since there will be no
 28855                                  ;   context switch. When UNPACK context switches while waiting for a FAT read
 28856                                  ;   we are done with any in-core FAT blocks, so again there is no race. The
 28857                                  ;   only special concern is that V2 and V3 MSDOS left the last allocated
 28858                                  ;   cluster as "00"; marking it EOF only when the entire alloc request was
 28859                                  ;   satisfied. We can't allow another activation to think this cluster is
 28860                                  ;   free, so we give it a special temporary mark to show that it is, indeed,
 28861                                  ;   allocated.
 28862                                  ;
 28863                                  ;   Note that when we run out of space this algorithem will scan from
 28864                                  ;   dpb_next_free to the end, then scan from cluster 2 through the end,
 28865                                  ;   redundantly scanning the later part of the disk. This only happens when
 28866                                  ;   we run out of space, so sue me.
 28867                                  ;
 28868                                  ;----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----;
 28869                                  ;            C  A  V  E  A  T     P  A  T  T  E  R  S  O  N                ;
 28870                                  ;                                                                          ;
 28871                                  ;   The use of FATBYT and RESTFATBYT is somewhat mysterious. Here is the
 28872                                  ;   explanation:
 28873                                  ;
 28874                                  ;   In the NUL file case (sf_firclus currently 0) ALLOCATE is called with
 28875                                  ;   entry BX = 0. What needs to be done in this case is to stuff the cluster
 28876                                  ;   number of the first cluster allocated in sf_firclus when the ALLOCATE is
 28877                                  ;   complete. THIS VALUE IS SAVED TEMPORARILY IN CLUSTER 0, HENCE THE CURRENT
 28878                                  ;   VALUE IN CLUSTER 0 MUST BE SAVED AND RESTORED. This is a side effect of
 28879                                  ;   the fact that PACK and UNPACK don't treat requests for clusters 0 and 1 as
 28880                                  ;   errors. This "stuff" is done by the call to PACK which is right before
 28881                                  ;   the
 28882                                  ;           LOOP   findfre         ; alloc more if needed
 28883                                  ;   instruction when the first cluster is allocated to the nul file. The
 28884                                  ;   value is recalled from cluster 0 and stored at sf_firclus at ads4:
 28885                                  ;
 28886                                  ;   This method is obviously useless (because it is non-reentrant) for
 28887                                  ;   multitasking, and will have to be changed. Storing the required value on
 28888                                  ;   the stack is recommended. Setting sf_firclus at the PACK of cluster 0
 28889                                  ;   (instead of actually doing the PACK) is BAD because it doesn't handle
 28890                                  ;   problems with INT 24 well.
 28891                                  ;
 28892                                  ;            C  A  V  E  A  T     P  A  T  T  E  R  S  O  N                ;
 28893                                  ;----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----;
 28894                                  ;                                                                          ;
 28895                                  ;       ENTRY   BX = Last cluster of file (0 if null file)
 28896                                  ;               CX = No. of clusters to allocate
 28897                                  ;               ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 28898                                  ;               [THISSFT] = Points to SFT
 28899                                  ;
 28900                                  ;       EXIT    'C' set if insufficient space
 28901                                  ;                 [FAILERR] can be tested to see the reason for failure
 28902                                  ;                 CX = max. no. of clusters that could be added to file
 28903                                  ;               'C' clear if space allocated
 28904                                  ;                 BX = First cluster allocated
 28905                                  ;                 FAT is fully updated
 28906                                  ;                 sf_FIRCLUS field of SFT set if file was null
 28907                                  ;
 28908                                  ;       USES    ALL but SI, BP
 28909                                  
 28910                                  ;callmagic  proc near
 28911                                  ;       push    ds                             ;push segment of routine 
 28912                                  ;       push    Offset MagicPatch              ;push offset for routine
 28913                                  ;       retf                                   ;simulate jmp far
 28914                                  ;                                              ;far return address is on
 28915                                  ;                                              ;stack, so far return from
 28916                                  ;                                              ;call will return this routine
 28917                                  ;callmagic  endp
 28918                                  
 28919                                  
 28920                                  ; 25/09/2023
 28921                                  %if 0

 28923                                  	push	ds
 28924                                  	push	MagicPatch
 28925                                  	retf	
 28926                                  %endif
 28927

 28936                                  ;FAT would allows allocation, but the free space for compressed
 28937                                  ;data would not.
 28938                                  ;

 28941                                  ;;; but we do know the segment and offset of the routine

 29230                                  ;Break	<GETEOF -- Find the end of a file>
 29231                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29232                                  ;
 29233                                  ; Procedure Name : GETEOF
 29234                                  ;
 29235                                  ; Inputs:

 29237                                  ;       BX = Cluster in a file

 29301                                  
 29302                                  	; 29/02/2024 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS)

 29304                                  MAKEFCB:
 29305                                  ;hkn; SS override
 29306                                  	;MOV	BYTE [SS:SpaceFlag],0
 29307 00004D82 30D2                    	XOR	DL,DL		; Flag--not ambiguous file name
 29308                                  	; 29/02/2024
 29309 00004D84 368816[4E03]            	mov	[ss:SpaceFlag],dl ; 0
 29310                                  	;test	al,2
 29311 00004D89 A802                    	test	AL,DRVBIT	; Use current drive field if default?
 29312 00004D8B 7503                    	JNZ	short DEFDRV
 29313                                  	;MOV	BYTE [ES:DI],0	; No - use default drive
 29314                                  	; 29/02/2024
 29315 00004D8D 268815                  	mov	[es:di],dl ; 0
 29316                                  DEFDRV:
 29317 00004D90 47                      	INC	DI
 29318 00004D91 B90800                  	MOV	CX,8
 29319                                  	;test	al,4
 29320 00004D94 A804                    	test	AL,NAMBIT	; Use current name fields as default?
 29321 00004D96 93                      	XCHG	AX,BX		; Save bits in BX
 29322 00004D97 B020                    	MOV	AL," "
 29323 00004D99 7404                    	JZ	short FILLB	; If not, go fill with blanks
 29324 00004D9B 01CF                    	ADD	DI,CX
 29325 00004D9D 31C9                    	XOR	CX,CX		; Don't fill any
 29326                                  FILLB:
 29327 00004D9F F3AA                    	REP	STOSB
 29328 00004DA1 B103                    	MOV	CL,3
 29329 00004DA3 F6C308                  	test	BL,EXTBIT	; Use current extension as default
 29330 00004DA6 7404                    	JZ	short FILLB2
 29331 00004DA8 01CF                    	ADD	DI,CX
 29332 00004DAA 31C9                    	XOR	CX,CX
 29333                                  FILLB2:
 29334 00004DAC F3AA                    	REP	STOSB
 29335 00004DAE 91                      	XCHG	AX,CX		; Put zero in AX
 29336 00004DAF AB                      	STOSW
 29337 00004DB0 AB                      	STOSW			; Initialize two words after to zero
 29338 00004DB1 83EF10                  	SUB	DI,16		; Point back at start
 29339                                  	;test	bl,1
 29340 00004DB4 F6C301                  	test	BL,SCANSEPARATOR; Scan off separators if not zero
 29341 00004DB7 7409                    	JZ	short SKPSPC
 29342 00004DB9 E88800                  	CALL	SCANB		; Peel off blanks and tabs
 29343 00004DBC E81E01                  	CALL	DELIM		; Is it a one-time-only delimiter?
 29344 00004DBF 7504                    	JNZ	short NOSCAN
 29345 00004DC1 46                      	INC	SI		; Skip over the delimiter
 29346                                  SKPSPC:
 29347 00004DC2 E87F00                  	CALL	SCANB		; Always kill preceding blanks and tabs
 29348                                  NOSCAN:
 29349 00004DC5 E8EC00                  	CALL	GETLET
 29350 00004DC8 761E                    	JBE	short NODRV	; Quit if termination character
 29351 00004DCA 803C3A                  	CMP	BYTE [SI],":"	; Check for potential drive specifier
 29352 00004DCD 7519                    	JNZ	short NODRV
 29353 00004DCF 46                      	INC	SI		; Skip over colon
 29354 00004DD0 2C40                    	SUB	AL,"@"          ; Convert drive letter to drive number (A=1)
 29355 00004DD2 760F                    	JBE	short BADDRV	; Drive letter out of range
 29356                                  
 29357 00004DD4 50                      	PUSH	AX
 29358 00004DD5 E8D71A                  	call	GetVisDrv
 29359 00004DD8 58                      	POP	AX
 29360 00004DD9 730A                    	JNC	short HAVDRV
 29361                                  
 29362                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 29363                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 29364                                  ;hkn; SS override
 29365 00004DDB 36803E[1006]1A          	CMP	byte [SS:DrvErr],error_not_DOS_disk ; 1Ah
 29366                                  					; if not FAT drive ;AN000;
 29367 00004DE1 7402                    	JZ	short HAVDRV		; assume ok	   ;AN000;
 29368                                  BADDRV:
 29369 00004DE3 B2FF                    	MOV	DL,-1
 29370                                  HAVDRV:
 29371 00004DE5 AA                      	STOSB			; Put drive specifier in first byte
 29372 00004DE6 46                      	INC	SI
 29373 00004DE7 4F                      	DEC	DI		; Counteract next two instructions
 29374                                  NODRV:
 29375 00004DE8 4E                      	DEC	SI		; Back up
 29376 00004DE9 47                      	INC	DI		; Skip drive byte
 29377                                  
 29378                                  	;entry	NORMSCAN
 29379                                  NORMSCAN:

 29381 00004DED E82200                  	CALL	GETWORD 	; Get 8-letter file name
 29382 00004DF0 803C2E                  	CMP	BYTE [SI],"."
 29383 00004DF3 7510                    	JNZ	short NODOT
 29384 00004DF5 46                      	INC	SI		; Skip over dot if present
 29385

 29387                                  	;mov	cx,3

 29389

 29395 00004DFE 7402                    	JZ	short VOLOK				;AN000;
 29396 00004E00 A4                      	MOVSB			; 2nd byte of DBCS	;AN000;

 29398                                  	;MOV	CX,2					;AN000;
 29399 00004E01 49                      	dec	cx  ; cx=2

 29472                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29473                                  ;
 29474                                  ; Procedure Name : NameTrans
 29475                                  ;
 29476                                  ; NameTrans is used by FindPath to scan off an element of a path. We must
 29477                                  ; allow spaces in pathnames
 29478                                  ;
 29479                                  ;   Inputs:	DS:SI points to start of path element
 29480                                  ;   Outputs:	Name1 has unpacked name, uppercased
 29481                                  ;		ES = DOSGroup
 29482                                  ;		DS:SI advanced after name
 29483                                  ;   Registers modified: DI,AX,DX,CX
 29484                                  ;
 29485                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29486                                  
 29487                                  	; 25/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 29488                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 29489                                  
 29490                                  	; 29/02/2024 - Retro DOS v4.1
 29491                                  
 29492                                  NameTrans:
 29493                                  ;hkn; SS override
 29494 00004E4C 36C606[4E03]01          	MOV	BYTE [SS:SpaceFlag],1
 29495 00004E52 16                      	push	ss
 29496 00004E53 07                      	pop	es
 29497                                  
 29498                                  ;hkn; NAME1 is in DOSDATA
 29499 00004E54 BF[4B05]                	MOV	DI,NAME1
 29500 00004E57 57                      	PUSH	DI
 29501                                  
 29502                                  ; 29/02/2024
 29503                                  %if 0
 29504                                  	MOV	AX,'  '	; 2020h
 29505                                  	MOV	CX,5
 29506                                  	STOSB
 29507                                  	REP	STOSW		; Fill "FCB" at NAME1 with spaces
 29508                                  	XOR	AL,AL		; Set stuff for NORMSCAN
 29509                                  	MOV	DL,AL
 29510                                  %else
 29511                                  	; 29/02/2024
 29512                                  	; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 29513 00004E58 B020                    	mov     al,20h ; ' '
 29514 00004E5A B90B00                  	mov     cx,11
 29515 00004E5D F3AA                    	rep stosb               ; Fill "FCB" at NAME1 with spaces
 29516 00004E5F 91                      	xchg    ax,cx
 29517 00004E60 99                      	cwd
 29518                                  %endif
 29519                                  
 29520 00004E61 AA                      	STOSB
 29521 00004E62 5F                      	POP	DI
 29522                                  
 29523 00004E63 E884FF                  	CALL	NORMSCAN
 29524                                  
 29525                                  ;hkn; SS override for NAME1
 29526 00004E66 36803E[4B05]E5          	CMP	byte [SS:NAME1],0E5H
 29527 00004E6C 75DD                    	jnz	short scanb_retn
 29528 00004E6E 36C606[4B05]05          	MOV	byte [SS:NAME1],5 ; Magic name translation
 29529 00004E74 C3                      	retn

 29539                                  ;hkn; Table	SEGMENT
 29540                                  ;	PUBLIC	CharType
 29541                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29542                                  
 29543                                  ; Character type table for file name scanning
 29544                                  ; Table provides a mapping of characters to validity bits.
 29545                                  ; Four bits are provided for each character. Values 7Dh and above
 29546                                  ; have all bits set, so that part of the table is chopped off, and
 29547                                  ; the translation routine is responsible for screening these values.
 29548                                  ; The bit values are defined in DOSSYM.INC
 29549                                  
 29550                                  ;	      ; ^A and NUL
 29551                                  ;CharType:
 29552                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29553                                  ;	      ; ^C and ^B
 29554                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29555                                  ;	      ; ^E and ^D
 29556                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29557                                  ;	      ; ^G and ^F
 29558                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29559                                  ;	      ; TAB and BS
 29560                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM+FSPCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29561                                  ;	      ; ^K and ^J
 29562                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29563                                  ;	      ; ^M and ^L
 29564                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29565                                  ;	      ; ^O and ^N
 29566                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29567                                  ;	      ; ^Q and ^P
 29568                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29569                                  ;	      ; ^S and ^R
 29570                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29571                                  ;	      ; ^U and ^T
 29572                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29573                                  ;	      ; ^W and ^V
 29574                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29575                                  ;	      ; ^Y and ^X
 29576                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29577                                  ;	      ; ESC and ^Z
 29578                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29579                                  ;	      ; ^] and ^;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29581                                  ;	      ; ^_ and ^^
 29582                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29583                                  ;	      ; ! and SPACE
 29584                                  ;	 db   LOW (NOT FCHK+FDELIM+FSPCHK)
 29585                                  ;	      ; # and "
 29586                                  ;	 db   LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK)
 29587                                  ;	      ; $ - )
 29588                                  ;	 db   3 dup (0FFh)
 29589                                  ;	      ; + and *
 29590                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM) SHL 4) OR 0Fh
 29591                                  ;	      ; - and '
 29592                                  ;	 db   NOT (FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM)
 29593                                  ;	      ; / and .
 29594                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29595                                  ;	      ; 0 - 9
 29596                                  ;	 db   5 dup (0FFh)
 29597                                  ;	      ; ; and :
 29598                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM) AND 0Fh
 29599                                  ;	      ; = and <
 29600                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM) AND 0Fh
 29601                                  ;	      ; ? and >
 29602                                  ;	 db   NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM
 29603                                  ;	      ; A - Z
 29604                                  ;	 db   13 dup (0FFh)
 29605                                  ;	      ; \ and [
 29606                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR 0Fh
 29607                                  ;	      ; ^ and ]
 29608                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 29609                                  ;	      ; _ - {
 29610                                  ;	 db   15 dup (0FFh)
 29611                                  ;	      ; } and |
 29612                                  ;	 db   NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM

 29895                                  ;
 29896                                  ;  GetCharType - return flag bits indicating character type
 29897                                  ;	Bits are defined in DOSSYM.INC. Uses lookup table
 29898                                  ;	defined above at label CharType.
 29899                                  ;
 29900                                  ;	Entry : AL = character to return type flags for
 29901                                  ;	Exit  : AL = type flags
 29902                                  ;	Uses  : AL, flags
 29903                                  ;
 29904                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29905                                  
 29906                                  	; 25/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 29907                                  
 29908                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 29909                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 29910                                  GetCharType:
 29911                                  	;cmp	al,7Eh
 29912 00004EED 3C7E                    	cmp	al,CharType_last 	; beyond end of table?
 29913 00004EEF 7316                    	jae	short gct_90		; return standard value
 29914                                  
 29915 00004EF1 53                      	push	bx
 29916 00004EF2 BB[754E]                	mov	bx,CharType		; load lookup table
 29917 00004EF5 D0E8                    	shr	al,1			; adjust for half-byte table entry size
 29918                                  	;xlat	cs:[bx] 		; get flags
 29919 00004EF7 2ED7                    	cs	xlat	
 29920 00004EF9 5B                      	pop	bx
 29921                                  
 29922                                  ; carry clear from previous shift means we want the low nibble.  Otherwise
 29923                                  ; we have to shift the flags down to the low nibble
 29924                                  
 29925 00004EFA 7308                    	jnc	short gct_80		; carry clear, no shift needed
 29926                                  
 29927 00004EFC D0E8                    	shr	al,1			; we want high nibble, shift it down
 29928 00004EFE D0E8                    	shr	al,1
 29929 00004F00 D0E8                    	shr	al,1
 29930 00004F02 D0E8                    	shr	al,1
 29931                                  gct_80:
 29932 00004F04 240F                    	and	al,0Fh			; clear the unused nibble
 29933 00004F06 C3                      	retn
 29934                                  gct_90:
 29935 00004F07 B00F                    	mov	al,0Fh			; set all flags
 29936 00004F09 C3                      	retn
