 30374                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30375                                  ;
 30376                                  ; Procedure Name : CNTHAND ( CTRLC_C HANDLER )
 30377                                  ;
 30378                                  ; "^C" and CR/LF is printed. Then the user registers are restored and the
 30379                                  ; user CTRL-C handler is executed. At this point the top of the stack has 1)
 30380                                  ; the interrupt return address should the user CTRL-C handler wish to allow
 30381                                  ; processing to continue; 2) the original interrupt return address to the code
 30382                                  ; that performed the function call in the first place. If the user CTRL-C
 30383                                  ; handler wishes to continue, it must leave all registers unchanged and RET
 30384                                  ; (not IRET) with carry CLEAR. If carry is SET then an terminate system call
 30385                                  ; is simulated.
 30386                                  ;
 30387                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------

 31024                                  ;** --------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31025                                  ;
 31026                                  ; reset_environment checks the DS value against the CurrentPDB. If they are
 31027                                  ; different, then an old-style return is performed. If they are the same,
 31028                                  ; then we release jfns and restore to parent. We still use the PDB at DS:0 as
 31029                                  ; the source of the terminate addresses.
 31030                                  ;
 31031                                  ; Some subtlety: We are about to issue a bunch of calls that *may* generate
 31032                                  ; INT 24s. We *cannot* allow the user to restart the abort process; we may
 31033                                  ; end up aborting the wrong process or turn a terminate/stay/resident into a
 31034                                  ; normal abort and leave interrupt handlers around. What we do is to set a
 31035                                  ; flag that will indicate that if any abort code is seen, we just continue the
 31036                                  ; operation. In essence, we dis-allow the abort response.
 31037                                  ;
 31038                                  ; output:   none.

 31271                                  ;	Revision history:
 31272                                  ;
 31273                                  ;	  AN000  version Jan. 1988
 31274                                  ;	   A001  PTM	      -- disk changed for look ahead buffers
 31275                                  ;
 31276                                  ;	M014 - if a request for pack\unpack cluster 0 is made we write\read
 31277                                  ;	       from CL0FATENTRY rather than disk.

 31280                                  
 31281                                  ;Break <IsEOF - check the quantity in BX for EOF>
 31282                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31283                                  ;
 31284                                  ; Procedure Name : IsEOF
 31285                                  ;
 31286                                  ; IsEOF - check the fat value in BX for eof.
 31287                                  ;
 31288                                  ;   Inputs:	ES:BP point to DPB
 31289                                  ;		BX has fat value
 31290                                  ;   Outputs:	JAE eof
 31291                                  ;   Registers modified: none
 31292                                  ;
 31293                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31294                                  
 31295                                  IsEOF:
 31296                                  	;cmp	word [es:bp+0Dh],0FF6h
 31297 0000538D 26817E0DF60F            	CMP	word [ES:BP+DPB.MAX_CLUSTER],4096-10 ; is this 16 bit fat?
 31298 00005393 730B                    	JAE	short EOF16			; yes, check for eof there
 31299                                  
 31300                                  ;J.K. 8/27/86
 31301                                  ;Modified to accept 0FF0h as an eof. This is to handle the diskfull case
 31302                                  ;of any media that has "F0"(Other) as a MediaByte.
 31303                                  ;Hopely, this does not create any side effect for those who may use any value
 31304                                  ;other than "FF8-FFF" as an EOF for their own file.
 31305                                  
 31306 00005395 81FBF00F                	cmp	bx,0FF0h
 31307 00005399 7404                    	je	short IsEOF_other
 31308                                  
 31309 0000539B 81FBF80F                	CMP	BX,0FF8h		; do the 12 bit compare
 31310                                  IsEOF_other:
 31311 0000539F C3                      	retn
 31312                                  EOF16:
 31313 000053A0 83FBF8                  	CMP	BX,0FFF8h		; 16 bit compare
 31314 000053A3 C3                      	retn
 31315                                  
 31316                                  ; DOSCODE:9511h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 31317                                  
 31318                                  ;Break	<UNPACK -- UNPACK FAT ENTRIES>
 31319                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31320                                  ;
 31321                                  ; Procedur Name : UNPACK
 31322                                  ;
 31323                                  ; Inputs:
 31324                                  ;	BX = Cluster number (may be full 16-bit quantity)
 31325                                  ;	ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 31326                                  ; Outputs:
 31327                                  ;	DI = Contents of FAT for given cluster (may be full 16-bit quantity)
 31328                                  ;	Zero set means DI=0 (free cluster)
 31329                                  ;	Carry set means error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 31330                                  ; SI Destroyed, No other registers affected. Fatal error if cluster too big.
 31331                                  ;
 31332                                  ; NOTE: if BX = 0 then DI = contents of CL0FATENTRY
 31333                                  ;
 31334                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31335                                  	
 31336                                  	; 25/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 31337                                  	; DOSCODE:94B5h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 31338                                  
 31339                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 31340                                  UNPACK:
 31341                                  	; MSDOS 6.0			; M014 - Start
 31342 000053A4 09DB                    	or	bx,bx			; Q: are we unpacking cluster 0
 31343 000053A6 7507                    	jnz	short up_cont		; N: proceed with normal unpack
 31344 000053A8 8B3E[8100]              	mov	di,[CL0FATENTRY]	; Y: return value in CL0FATENTRY
 31345 000053AC 09FF                    	or	di,di 			; return z if di=0
 31346 000053AE C3                      	retn				; done
 31347                                  up_cont:				; M014 - End
 31348                                  	; MSDOS 3.3 & MSDOS 6.0
 31349                                  	;cmp	bx,[es:bp+0Dh]
 31350 000053AF 263B5E0D                	CMP	BX,[ES:BP+DPB.MAX_CLUSTER]
 31351 000053B3 7726                    	JA	short HURTFAT
 31352 000053B5 E8D500                  	CALL	MAPCLUSTER
 31353 000053B8 721E                    	jc	short _DoContext
 31354 000053BA 8B3D                    	MOV	DI,[DI]
 31355 000053BC 750E                    	JNZ	short High12		; MZ if high 12 bits, go get 'em
 31356 000053BE 268B760D                	MOV	SI,[ES:BP+DPB.MAX_CLUSTER] ; MZ is this 16-bit fat?
 31357 000053C2 81FEF60F                	CMP	SI,4096-10
 31358 000053C6 720C                    	JB	short Unpack12		; MZ No, go 'AND' off bits
 31359 000053C8 09FF                    	OR	DI,DI			; MZ set zero condition code, clears carry
 31360 000053CA EB0C                    	JMP	SHORT _DoContext 	; MZ go do context
 31361                                  High12:
 31362 000053CC D1EF                    	SHR	DI,1
 31363 000053CE D1EF                    	SHR	DI,1
 31364 000053D0 D1EF                    	SHR	DI,1
 31365 000053D2 D1EF                    	SHR	DI,1
 31366                                  Unpack12:
 31367 000053D4 81E7FF0F                	AND	DI,0FFFh		; Clears carry
 31368                                  _DoContext:
 31369 000053D8 16                      	PUSH	SS
 31370 000053D9 1F                      	POP	DS
 31371 000053DA C3                      	retn
 31372                                  HURTFAT:
 31373                                  	;;mov	word [es:bp+1Eh],0FFFFh
 31374                                  	;mov	word [es:bp+1Fh],0FFFFh  ; MSDOS 6.0
 31375 000053DB 26C7461FFFFF            	MOV	word [ES:BP+DPB.FREE_CNT],-1 ; Err in FAT must force recomp of freespace
 31376 000053E1 50                      	PUSH	AX
 31377 000053E2 B488                    	MOV	AH,Allowed_FAIL+80h ; 88h
 31378                                  
 31379                                  ;hkn; SS override
 31380 000053E4 36C606[4B03]08          	MOV	byte [SS:ALLOWED],Allowed_FAIL ; 8
 31381                                  ;
 31382                                  ; Signal Bad FAT to INT int_fatal_abort handler. We have an invalid cluster.
 31383                                  ;
 31384 000053EA BFFF0F                  	MOV	DI,0FFFh		; In case INT int_fatal_abort returns (it shouldn't)
 31385 000053ED E8CCFD                  	call	FATAL
 31386 000053F0 3C03                    	CMP	AL,3
 31387 000053F2 F8                      	CLC
 31388 000053F3 7501                    	JNZ	short OKU_RET 		; Try to ignore bad FAT
 31389 000053F5 F9                      	STC				; User said FAIL
 31390                                  OKU_RET:
 31391 000053F6 58                      	POP	AX
 31392                                  hurtfat_retn:
 31393 000053F7 C3                      	retn
 31394                                  
 31395                                  ; DOSCODE:9565h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 31396                                  
 31397                                  ;Break	<PACK -- PACK FAT ENTRIES>
 31398                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31399                                  ;
 31400                                  ; Procedure Name : PACK
 31401                                  ;
 31402                                  ; Inputs:
 31403                                  ;	BX = Cluster number
 31404                                  ;	DX = Data
 31405                                  ;	ES:BP = Pointer to drive DPB
 31406                                  ; Outputs:
 31407                                  ;	The data is stored in the FAT at the given cluster.
 31408                                  ;	SI,DX,DI all destroyed
 31409                                  ;	Carry set means error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 31410                                  ;	No other registers affected
 31411                                  ;
 31412                                  ; NOTE: if BX = 0 then data in DX is stored in CL0FATENTRY.
 31413                                  ;
 31414                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31415                                  
 31416                                  	; 02/01/2024
 31417                                  	; 25/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 31418                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 31419                                  PACK:
 31420                                  	; MSDOS 6.0			; M014 - start
 31421 000053F8 09DB                    	or	bx,bx			; Q: are we packing cluster 0
 31422 000053FA 7505                    	jnz	short p_cont		; N: proceed with normal pack
 31423 000053FC 8916[8100]              	mov	[CL0FATENTRY],dx	; Y: place value in CL0FATENTRY
 31424 00005400 C3                      	retn				; done
 31425                                  p_cont:					; M014 - end
 31426                                  	; MSDOS 3.3 & MSDOS 6.0
 31427 00005401 E88900                  	CALL	MAPCLUSTER
 31428 00005404 72D2                    	JC	short _DoContext
 31429 00005406 8B35                    	MOV	SI,[DI]
 31430 00005408 740B                    	JZ	short ALIGNED 		; byte (not nibble) aligned
 31431 0000540A 51                      	PUSH	CX			; move data to upper 12 bits
 31432 0000540B B104                    	MOV	CL,4
 31433 0000540D D3E2                    	SHL	DX,CL
 31434 0000540F 59                      	POP	CX
 31435 00005410 83E60F                  	AND	SI,0FH			; leave in original low 4 bits
 31436 00005413 EB13                    	JMP	SHORT PACKIN
 31437                                  ALIGNED:
 31438                                  	;cmp	word [es:bp+0Dh],0FF6h
 31439 00005415 26817E0DF60F            	CMP	word [ES:BP+DPB.MAX_CLUSTER],4096-10 ; MZ 16 bit fats?
 31440 0000541B 7309                    	JAE	short Pack16		; MZ yes, go clobber original data
 31441 0000541D 81E600F0                	AND	SI,0F000h		; MZ leave in upper 4 bits of original
 31442                                  	;AND	DX,0FFFh		; MZ store only 12 bits
 31443                                  	; 01/07/2024
 31444 00005421 80E60F                  	and	dh,0Fh
 31445 00005424 EB02                    	JMP	SHORT PACKIN		; MZ go store
 31446                                  Pack16:
 31447 00005426 31F6                    	XOR	SI,SI			; MZ no original data
 31448                                  PACKIN:
 31449 00005428 09D6                    	OR	SI,DX
 31450 0000542A 8935                    	MOV	[DI],SI
 31451                                  
 31452                                  ;hkn; SS override
 31453 0000542C 36C536[E205]            	LDS	SI,[SS:CURBUF]
 31454                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 31455 00005431 F6440540                	TEST	byte [SI+BUFFINFO.buf_flags],buf_dirty  
 31456                                  					;LB. if already dirty		  ;AN000;
 31457 00005435 7507                    	JNZ	short yesdirty11	;LB.  don't increment dirty count ;AN000;
 31458                                  	; 10/06/2019
 31459 00005437 E88005                  	call	INC_DIRTY_COUNT		;LB.				  ;AN000;
 31460                                  	
 31461                                  	;or	byte [si+5],40h
 31462 0000543A 804C0540                	OR	byte [SI+BUFFINFO.buf_flags],buf_dirty  
 31463                                  yesdirty11:				;LB.				;AN000;
 31464                                  ;hkn; SS override
 31465 0000543E 36803E[7805]00          	CMP	BYTE [SS:CLUSSPLIT],0	; 15/08/2018
 31466                                  ;hkn; SS is DOSDATA
 31467 00005444 16                      	push	ss
 31468 00005445 1F                      	pop	ds
 31469 00005446 74AF                    	jz	short hurtfat_retn	; Carry clear
 31470 00005448 50                      	PUSH	AX
 31471 00005449 53                      	PUSH	BX
 31472 0000544A 51                      	PUSH	CX
 31473 0000544B A1[8E05]                	MOV	AX,[CLUSSAVE]
 31474 0000544E 8E1E[E405]              	MOV	DS,[CURBUF+2]
 31475                                  	;;add	si,16 ; MSDOS 3.3
 31476                                  	;add	si,20 ; MSDOS 6.0
 31477 00005452 83C614                  	ADD	SI,BUFINSIZ
 31478 00005455 8824                    	MOV	[SI],AH
 31479                                  ;hkn; SS is DOSDATA
 31480                                  	;Context DS
 31481 00005457 16                      	push	ss
 31482 00005458 1F                      	pop	ds
 31483                                  	
 31484 00005459 50                      	PUSH	AX
 31485

 31487 0000545A 8B16[9205]              	MOV	DX,[CLUSSEC+2]		;F.C. >32mb			;AN000;
 31488 0000545E 8916[0706]              	MOV	[HIGH_SECTOR],DX	;F.C. >32mb			;AN000;
 31489

 31491 00005462 8B16[9005]              	MOV	DX,[CLUSSEC]
 31492

 31494                                  	;XOR	AL,AL     ; *

 31531                                  ; 31/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 31532                                  
 31533                                  ;Break	<MAPCLUSTER - BUFFER A FAT SECTOR>
 31534                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31535                                  ;
 31536                                  ; Procedure Name : MAPCLUSTER
 31537                                  ;
 31538                                  ; Inputs:
 31539                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 31540                                  ;	BX Is cluster number
 31541                                  ; Function:
 31542                                  ;	Get a pointer to the cluster
 31543                                  ; Outputs:
 31544                                  ;	DS:DI Points to contents of FAT for given cluster
 31545                                  ;	DS:SI Points to start of buffer
 31546                                  ;	Zero Not set if cluster data is in high 12 bits of word
 31547                                  ;	Zero set if cluster data is in low 12 or 16 bits
 31548                                  ;	Carry set if failed.
 31549                                  ; SI is destroyed.
 31550                                  ;
 31551                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31552                                  
 31553                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 31554                                  	; DOSCODE:9601h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 31555                                  	; 27/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 31556                                  	; DOSCODE:95A5h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 31557                                  
 31558                                  MAPCLUSTER:
 31559                                  	; IBMDOS.COM (MSDOS 3.3, 1987) - Offset 5A15h
 31560 0000548D C606[7805]00            	MOV	BYTE [CLUSSPLIT],0
 31561                                  	;SAVE	<AX,BX,CX,DX>
 31562 00005492 50                      	push	ax
 31563 00005493 53                      	push	bx
 31564 00005494 51                      	push	cx
 31565 00005495 52                      	push	dx
 31566 00005496 89D8                    	MOV	AX,BX			; AX = BX
 31567 00005498 26817E0DF60F            	CMP	word [ES:BP+DPB.MAX_CLUSTER],4096-10  ; MZ 16 bit fat?
 31568 0000549E 7302                    	JAE	short Map16		; MZ yes, do 16 bit algorithm
 31569 000054A0 D1E8                    	SHR	AX,1			; AX = BX/2
 31570                                  Map16:	
 31571                                  	; MSDOS 6.0			; MZ skip prev => AX=2*BX
 31572 000054A2 31FF                    	XOR	DI,DI ; *		; >32mb fat ;AN000;
 31573                                  	; MSDOS 3.3 (& MSDOS 6.0)
 31574 000054A4 01D8                    	ADD	AX,BX			; AX = 1.5*fat = byte offset in fat
 31575 000054A6 11FF                    	ADC	DI,DI ; * MSDOS 6.0	; >32mb fat ;DI is zero before op;AN000;
 31576 000054A8 268B4E02                	MOV	CX,[ES:BP+DPB.SECTOR_SIZE]
 31577                                  
 31578                                  ;IF FastDiv
 31579                                  ;
 31580                                  ; Gross hack: 99% of all disks have 512 bytes per sector. We test for this
 31581                                  ; case and apply a really fast algorithm to get the desired results
 31582                                  ;
 31583                                  ; Divide method takes 157+4*4=173 (MOV and DIV)
 31584                                  ; Fast method takes 39+20*4=119
 31585                                  ;
 31586                                  ; This saves a bunch.
 31587                                  
 31588 000054AC 81F90002                	CMP	CX,512			; 4  Is this 512 byte sector?
 31589 000054B0 7510                    	jne	short _DoDiv		; 4  for no jump
 31590 000054B2 89C2                    	MOV	DX,AX			; 2  get set for remainder
 31591 000054B4 81E2FF01                	AND	DX,512-1		; 4  Form remainder
 31592 000054B8 88E0                    	MOV	AL,AH			; 2  Quotient in formation in AL
 31593                                  	; MDOS 3.3
 31594                                  	;shr	al,1	
 31595                                  	; MDOS 6.0
 31596 000054BA D1EF                    	shr	di,1			; 2
 31597 000054BC D0D8                    	rcr	al,1			; 2
 31598                                  	; MDOS 3.3 (& MSDOS 6.0)
 31599 000054BE 30E4                    	xor	ah,ah			; 3
 31600 000054C0 EB04                    	jmp	short DivDone		; 16
 31601                                  _DoDiv:
 31602                                  ;ENDIF
 31603                                  	; MSDOS 3.3
 31604                                  	;xor	dx,dx
 31605                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 31606 000054C2 89FA                    	mov	dx,di			; 2
 31607                                  	; MSDOS 3.3 (& MSDOS 6.0)	
 31608 000054C4 F7F1                    	DIV	CX			; 155 AX is FAT sector # DX is sector index

 31711                                  ; Procedure Name : FATREAD_SFT
 31712                                  ;
 31713                                  ; Inputs:
 31714                                  ;	ES:DI points to an SFT for the drive of intrest (local only,
 31715                                  ;		giving a NET SFT will produce system crashing results).
 31716                                  ;	DS DOSDATA
 31717                                  ; Function:
 31718                                  ;	Can be used by an SFT routine (like CLOSE) to invalidate buffers
 31719                                  ;	if disk changed.
 31720                                  ;	In other respects, same as FATREAD_CDS.
 31721                                  ;	(note ES:DI destroyed!)
 31722                                  ; Outputs:
 31723                                  ;	Carry set if error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 31724                                  ; NOTE: This routine may cause FATREAD_CDS to "miss" a disk change
 31725                                  ;	as far as invalidating curdir_ID is concerned.
 31726                                  ;	Since getting a true disk changed on this call is a screw up
 31727                                  ;	anyway, that's the way it goes.
 31728                                  ;

 32639                                  
 32640                                  ;**	GetBuffr - Get a non-FAT Sector into a Buffer
 32641                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32642                                  ;	GetBuffr does normal ( non-FAT ) sector buffering
 32643                                  ;	It gets the specified local sector into one of the I/O buffers
 32644                                  ;	and shuffles the queue
 32645                                  ; 
 32646                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = 0 means sector must be pre-read
 32647                                  ;		       ELSE no pre-read
 32648                                  ;		(DX) = Desired physical sector number	      (LOW)
 32649                                  ;		HIGH_SECTOR = Desired physical sector number (HIGH)
 32650                                  ;		(ES:BP) = Pointer to drive parameters
 32651                                  ;		ALLOWED set in case of INT 24
 32652                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error (user FAIL response to INT24)
 32653                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 32654                                  ;		CURBUF Points to the Buffer for the sector
 32655                                  ;		    the buffer type bits OF buf_flags = 0, caller must set it
 32656                                  ;	USES	AX, BX, CX, SI, DI, Flags
 32657                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32658                                  
 32659                                  ;**	GetBuffrb - Get a FAT Sector into a Buffer
 32660                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32661                                  ;	GetBuffrb reads a sector from the FAT file system's FAT table.
 32662                                  ;	It gets the specified sector into one of the I/O buffers
 32663                                  ;	and shuffles the queue. We need a special entry point so that
 32664                                  ;	we can read the alternate FAT sector if the first read fails, also
 32665                                  ;	so we can mark the buffer as a FAT sector.
 32666                                  ; 
 32667                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = 0 means sector must be pre-read
 32668                                  ;		       ELSE no pre-read
 32669                                  ;		(DX) = Desired physical sector number	     (LOW)
 32670                                  ;		(SI) != 0
 32671                                  ;		HIGH_SECTOR = Desired physical sector number (HIGH)
 32672                                  ;		(ES:BP) = Pointer to drive parameters
 32673                                  ;		ALLOWED set in case of INT 24
 32674                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error (user FAIL response to INT24)
 32675                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 32676                                  ;		CUR ddBUF Points to the Buffer for the sector
 32677                                  ;		    the buffer type bits OF buf_flags = 0, caller must set it
 32678                                  ;	USES	AX, BX, CX, SI, DI, Flags

 33429                                  
 33430                                  ;	TITLE	MSPROC - process maintenance
 33431                                  ;	NAME	MSPROC
 33432                                  
 33433                                  ; =========================================================================
 33434                                  ;**	Process related system calls and low level routines for DOS 2.X.
 33435                                  ;	I/O specs are defined in DISPATCH.
 33436                                  ;
 33437                                  ;	$WAIT
 33438                                  ;	$EXEC
 33439                                  ;	$Keep_process
 33440                                  ;	Stay_resident
 33441                                  ;	$EXIT
 33442                                  ;	$ABORT
 33443                                  ;	abort_inner
 33444                                  ;
 33445                                  ;	Modification history:
 33446                                  ;
 33447                                  ;		Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 33448                                  ;		AN000	version 4.0 jan. 1988
 33449                                  ;		A007	PTM 3957 - fake vesrion for IBMCACHE.COM
 33450                                  ;		A008	PTM 4070 - fake version for MS WINDOWS
 33451                                  ;
 33452                                  ;		M000	added support for loading programs into UMBs 7/9/90
 33453                                  ;
 33454                                  ;		M004 - MS PASCAL 3.2 support. Please see under tag M003 in 
 33455                                  ;		       dossym.inc. 7/30/90
 33456                                  ;		M005 - Support for EXE programs with out STACK segment and 
 33457                                  ;		       with resident size < 64K - 256 bytes. A 256 byte 
 33458                                  ;		       stack is provided at the end of the program. Note that
 33459                                  ;		       only SP is changed.
 33460                                  ;		M020 - Fix for Rational bug for details see exepatch.asm
 33461                                  ;
 33462                                  ;		M028 - 4b04 implementation
 33463                                  ;
 33464                                  ;		M029 - Support for EXEs without stack rewritten. If EXE is
 33465                                  ;			in memory block >= 64K, sp = 0. If memory block
 33466                                  ;			obtained is <64K, point sp at the end of the memory
 33467                                  ;			block. For EXEs smaller than 64K, 256 bytes are still
 33468                                  ;			added for a stack segment which may be needed if it
 33469                                  ;			is loaded in low memory situations.
 33470                                  ;
 33471                                  ;		M030 - Fixing bug in EXEPACPATCH & changing 4b04 to 4b05
 33472                                  ;
 33473                                  ;		M040 - Bug #3052. The environment sizing code would flag a
 33474                                  ;			a bad environment if it reached 32767 bytes. Changed
 33475                                  ;			to allow 32768 bytes of environment.
 33476                                  ;
 33477                                  ;		M047 - Release the allocated UMB when we failed to load a 
 33478                                  ;		       COM file high. Also ensure that if the biggest block
 33479                                  ;		       into which we load the com file is less than 64K then
 33480                                  ;		       we provide atleast 256 bytes of stack to the user.
 33481                                  ;
 33482                                  ;		M050 - Made Lie table search CASE insensitive
 33483                                  ;
 33484                                  ;		M060 - Removed special version table from the kernal and
 33485                                  ;                      put it in a device drive which puts the address

 33536                                  ; =========================================================================
 33537                                  ;BREAK <$exec - load/go a program>
 33538                                  ;	EXEC.ASM - EXEC System Call
 33539                                  ;
 33540                                  ;
 33541                                  ; Assembler usage:
 33542                                  ;	    lds     DX, Name
 33543                                  ;	    les     BX, Blk
 33544                                  ;	    mov     AH, Exec
 33545                                  ;	    mov     AL, FUNC
 33546                                  ;	    int     INT_COMMAND
 33547                                  ;
 33548                                  ;	AL  Function
 33549                                  ;	--  --------
 33550                                  ;	 0  Load and execute the program.
 33551                                  ;	 1  Load, create the program header but do not
 33552                                  ;	    begin execution.
 33553                                  ;	 3  Load overlay. No header created.
 33554                                  ;
 33555                                  ;	    AL = 0 -> load/execute program
 33556                                  ;
 33557                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 33558                                  ;	    | WORD segment address of	|
 33559                                  ;	    | environment.		|
 33560                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 33561                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to ASCIZ	|
 33562                                  ;	    | command line at 80h	|
 33563                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 33564                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to default	|
 33565                                  ;	    | FCB to be passed at 5Ch	|
 33566                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 33567                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to default	|
 33568                                  ;	    | FCB to be passed at 6Ch	|
 33569                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 33570                                  ;
 33571                                  ;	    AL = 1 -> load program
 33572                                  ;
 33573                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 33574                                  ;	    | WORD segment address of	|
 33575                                  ;	    | environment.		|
 33576                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 33577                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to ASCIZ	|
 33578                                  ;	    | command line at 80h	|
 33579                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 33580                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to default	|
 33581                                  ;	    | FCB to be passed at 5Ch	|
 33582                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 33583                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to default	|
 33584                                  ;	    | FCB to be passed at 6Ch	|
 33585                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 33586                                  ;	    | DWORD returned value of	|
 33587                                  ;	    | CS:IP			|
 33588                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 33589                                  ;	    | DWORD returned value of	|
 33590                                  ;	    | SS:IP			|
 33591                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 33592                                  ;
 33593                                  ;	    AL = 3 -> load overlay
 33594                                  ;
 33595                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 33596                                  ;	    | WORD segment address where|
 33597                                  ;	    | file will be loaded.	|
 33598                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 33599                                  ;	    | WORD relocation factor to |
 33600                                  ;	    | be applied to the image.	|
 33601                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 33602                                  ;
 33603                                  ; Returns:
 33604                                  ;	    AX = error_invalid_function
 33605                                  ;	       = error_bad_format
 33606                                  ;	       = error_bad_environment
 33607                                  ;	       = error_not_enough_memory
 33608                                  ;	       = error_file_not_found

 35327                                  ;BREAK <$ABORT -- Terminate a process>
 35328                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35329                                  ; Inputs:
 35330                                  ;	user_CS:00 must point to valid program header block
 35331                                  ; Function:
 35332                                  ;	Restore terminate and Cntrl-C addresses, flush buffers and transfer
 35333                                  ;	to the terminate address
 35334                                  ; Returns:
 35335                                  ;	TO THE TERMINATE ADDRESS
 35336                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35337                                  
 35338                                  _$ABORT:
 35339 0000604E 30C0                    	xor	AL,AL
 35340                                  	;mov	byte [SS:EXIT_TYPE],0

 35343

 35345                                  	; is retrieved from exit_type. Also, the PDB at user_CS needs
 35346                                  	; to be correct as the one that is terminating.
 35347                                  
 35348                                  abort_inner:

 35555                                  ;**	Arena_Next - Find Next item in Arena
 35556                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35557                                  ;	ENTRY	DS - pointer to block head
 35558                                  ;		(di) = 0
 35559                                  ;	EXIT	AX,ES - pointers to next head
 35560                                  ;		'C' set iff arena damaged
 35561                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 35563                                  arena_next:
 35564 000060B2 8CD8                            MOV     AX,DS                   ; AX <- current block
 35565 000060B4 03060300                        ADD     AX,[ARENA.SIZE]		; AX <- AX + current block length
 35566 000060B8 40                              INC     AX                      ; remember that header!
 35567                                  
 35568                                  ;       fall into check_signature and return
 35569                                  ;
 35570                                  ;       CALL    check_signature         ; ES <- AX, carry set if error
 35571                                  ;       RETN

 35573                                  ;**	Check_Signature - Check Memory Block Signature
 35574                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35575                                  ;	ENTRY	(AX) = address of block header

 35602                                  ;**	Coalesce - Combine free blocks ahead with current block
 35603                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35604                                  ;	Coalesce adds the block following the argument to the argument block,
 35605                                  ;	iff it's free.  Coalesce is usually used to join free blocks, but
 35606                                  ;	some callers (such as $setblock) use it to join a free block to it's
 35607                                  ;	preceeding allocated block.
 35608                                  ;
 35609                                  ;	ENTRY	(ds) = pointer to the head of a free block
 35610                                  ;		(di) = 0
 35611                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if OK
 35612                                  ;		  (ds) unchanged, this block updated
 35613                                  ;		  (ax) = address of next block, IFF not at end
 35614                                  ;		'C' set if arena trashed
 35615                                  ;	USES	(cx)
 35616                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35617                                          
 35618                                  Coalesce:
 35619                                  	;cmp	byte [di],5Ah ; 'Z'
 35620 000060C9 803D5A                  	CMP     BYTE [DI],arena_signature_end
 35621                                                                          ; IF current signature = END THEN
 35622                                          ;retz				;   GOTO ok
 35623 000060CC 74FA                            jz	short COALESCE_RETN
 35624 000060CE E8E1FF                  	CALL    arena_next              ; ES, AX <- next block, Carry set if error
 35625                                          ;retc				; IF no error THEN GOTO check
 35626 000060D1 72F5                    	jc	short COALESCE_RETN
 35627                                  
 35628                                  coalesce_check:
 35629                                  	;cmp	[es:1],di
 35630 000060D3 26393E0100                      CMP     [ES:ARENA.OWNER],DI
 35631                                          ;retnz				; IF next block isnt free THEN return
 35632 000060D8 75EE                            JNZ	SHORT COALESCE_RETN
 35633                                  	;mov	cx,[ES:3]
 35634 000060DA 268B0E0300              	MOV     CX,[ES:ARENA.SIZE]	; CX <- next block size
 35635 000060DF 41                              INC     CX                      ; CX <- CX + 1 (for header size)
 35636                                          ;ADD	[3],CX
 35637 000060E0 010E0300                	ADD     [ARENA.SIZE],CX		; current size <- current size + CX
 35638 000060E4 268A0D                          MOV     CL,[ES:DI]              ; move up signature
 35639 000060E7 880D                            MOV     [DI],CL
 35640 000060E9 EBDE                            JMP     SHORT Coalesce		; try again

 35642                                  ; 04/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 35643                                  ; IBMDOS.COM (MSDOS 3.3, 1987) - Offset 641Fh
 35644                                  
 35645                                  ;	BREAK  <$Alloc - allocate space in memory>
 35646                                  
 35647                                  ; MSDOS 6.0
 35648                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35649                                  ;**	$Alloc - Allocate Memory Space
 35650                                  ;
 35651                                  ;	$Alloc services the INT21 that allocates memory space to a program.
 35652                                  ;	Alloc returns a pointer to a free block of memory that
 35653                                  ;	has the requested size in paragraphs.
 35654                                  ;
 35655                                  ;	If the allocation strategy is HIGH_FIRST or HIGH_ONLY memory is 
 35656                                  ;	scanned from umb_head if not from arena_head. If the strategy is
 35657                                  ; 	HIGH_FIRST the scan is continued from arena_head if a block of 
 35658                                  ;	appropriate size is not found in the UMBs. If the strategy is 
 35659                                  ;	HIGH_FIRST+HIGH_ONLY only the UMBs are scanned for memory.
 35660                                  ;
 35661                                  ;	In either case if bit 0 of UmbFlag is not initialized then the scan
 35662                                  ;	starts from arena_head.
 35663                                  ;
 35664                                  ;	Assembler usage:
 35665                                  ;           MOV     BX,size
 35666                                  ;           MOV     AH,Alloc
 35667                                  ;           INT     21h
 35668                                  ;
 35669                                  ;	BUGBUG - a lot can be done to improve performance. We can set marks
 35670                                  ;	so that we start searching the arena at it's first non-trivial free
 35671                                  ;	block, we can peephole the code, etc. (We can move some subr calls
 35672                                  ;	inline, etc.) I assume that this is called rarely and that the arena
 35673                                  ;	doesn't have too many memory objects in it beyond the first free one.
 35674                                  ;	verify that this is true; if so, this can stay as is
 35675                                  ;
 35676                                  ;	ENTRY	(bx) = requested size, in bytes
 35677                                  ;		(DS) = (ES) = DOSGROUP
 35678                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if memory allocated
 35679                                  ;		  (ax:0) = address of requested memory
 35680                                  ;		'C' set if request failed
 35681                                  ;		  (AX) = error_not_enough_memory
 35682                                  ;		    (bx) = max size we could have allocated
 35683                                  ;		  (ax) = error_arena_trashed
 35684                                  ;	USES	All
 35685                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35686                                  
 35687                                  ; MSDOS 2.11 (& MSDOS 3.3)
 35688                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35689                                  ;SUBTTL $Alloc - allocate space in memory
 35690                                  ;
 35691                                  ;   Assembler usage:
 35692                                  ;           MOV     BX,size
 35693                                  ;           MOV     AH,Alloc
 35694                                  ;           INT     21h
 35695                                  ;         AX:0 is pointer to allocated memory
 35696                                  ;         BX is max size if not enough memory
 35697                                  ;
 35698                                  ;   Description:
 35699                                  ;           Alloc returns  a  pointer  to  a  free  block of
 35700                                  ;       memory that has the requested  size  in  paragraphs.
 35701                                  ;
 35702                                  ;   Error return:
 35703                                  ;           AX = error_not_enough_memory
 35704                                  ;              = error_arena_trashed
 35705                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35706                                  
 35707                                  ; DOSCODE:A28Eh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)

 36045                                  ;	BREAK $SETBLOCK - change size of an allocated block (if possible)
 36046                                  
 36047                                  ; MSDOS 6.0
 36048                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36049                                  ;**	$SETBLOCK - Change size of an Allocated Block
 36050                                  ;
 36051                                  ;	Setblock changes the size of an allocated block. First, we coalesce
 36052                                  ;	any following free space onto this block; then we try to trim the
 36053                                  ;	block down to the size requested.
 36054                                  ;
 36055                                  ;	Note that if the guy wants to grow the block but that growth fails,
 36056                                  ;	we still go ahead and coalesce any trailing free blocks onto it.
 36057                                  ;	Thus the maximum-size-possible value that we return has already
 36058                                  ;	been allocated! This is a bug, dare we fix it? BUGBUG
 36059                                  ;
 36060                                  ;	NOTE - $SETBLOCK is in bed with $ALLOC and jumps into $ALLOC to
 36061                                  ;		finish it's work. For this reason we build the allocsf
 36062                                  ;		structure on the frame, to make us compatible with $ALLOCs
 36063                                  ;		code.
 36064                                  ;
 36065                                  ;	ENTRY	(es) = segment of old block
 36066                                  ;		(bx) = newsize
 36067                                  ;		(ah) = SETBLOCK
 36068                                  ;
 36069                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if OK
 36070                                  ;		'C' set if error
 36071                                  ;		  (ax) = error_invalid_block
 36072                                  ;		       = error_arena_trashed
 36073                                  ;		       = error_not_enough_memory
 36074                                  ;		       = error_invalid_function
 36075                                  ;		  (bx) = maximum size possible, iff (ax) = error_not_enough_memory
 36076                                  ;	USES	???? BUGBUG
 36077                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36078                                  
 36079                                  ; MSDOS 2.11 (& MSDOS 3.3)
 36080                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36081                                  ;SUBTTL $SETBLOCK - change size of an allocated block (if possible)
 36082                                  ;
 36083                                  ;   Assembler usage:
 36084                                  ;           MOV     ES,block
 36085                                  ;           MOV     BX,newsize
 36086                                  ;           MOV     AH,setblock
 36087                                  ;           INT     21h
 36088                                  ;         if setblock fails for growing, BX will have the maximum
 36089                                  ;         size possible
 36090                                  ;   Error return:
 36091                                  ;           AX = error_invalid_block
 36092                                  ;              = error_arena_trashed
 36093                                  ;              = error_not_enough_memory
 36094                                  ;              = error_invalid_function
 36095                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36096                                  
 36097                                  _$SETBLOCK:        
 36098                                  	; 04/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 36099                                  	;EnterCrit   critMem

 36191                                  ;	BREAK $AllocOper - get/set allocation mechanism
 36192                                  
 36193                                  ; MSDOS 6.0
 36194                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36195                                  ;**	$AllocOper - Get/Set Allocation Mechanism
 36196                                  ;
 36197                                  ;	Assembler usage:
 36198                                  ;           MOV     AH,AllocOper
 36199                                  ;           MOV     BX,method
 36200                                  ;           MOV     AL,func
 36201                                  ;           INT     21h
 36202                                  ;
 36203                                  ;	ENTRY	
 36204                                  ;		(al) = 0
 36205                                  ;		  Get allocation Strategy in (ax)
 36206                                  ;
 36207                                  ;		(al) = 1, (bx) = method = zw0000xy
 36208                                  ;		  Set allocation strategy.
 36209                                  ;		   w  = 1  => HIGH_ONLY
 36210                                  ;		   z  = 1  => HIGH_FIRST
 36211                                  ;		   xy = 00 => FIRST_FIT
 36212                                  ;		      = 01 => BEST_FIT
 36213                                  ;		      = 10 => LAST_FIT
 36214                                  ;
 36215                                  ;		(al) = 2
 36216                                  ;		  Get UMB link state in (al)
 36217                                  ;
 36218                                  ;		(al) = 3
 36219                                  ;		  Set UMB link state
 36220                                  ;		   (bx) = 0 => Unlink UMBs
 36221                                  ;		   (bx) = 1 => Link UMBs
 36222                                  ;
 36223                                  ;
 36224                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if OK
 36225                                  ;
 36226                                  ;		 if (al) = 0
 36227                                  ;		  (ax) = existing method
 36228                                  ;		 if (al) = 1
 36229                                  ;		  Sets allocation strategy
 36230                                  ;		 if (al) = 2
 36231                                  ;		  (al) = 0 => UMBs not linked
 36232                                  ;		  (al) = 1 => UMBs linked in
 36233                                  ;		 if (al) = 3
 36234                                  ;		  Links/Unlinks the UMBs into DOS chain
 36235                                  ;
 36236                                  ;		'C' set if error
 36237                                  ;		  AX = error_invalid_function
 36238                                  ;
 36239                                  ;	Rev. M000 - added support for HIGH_FIRST in (al) = 1. 7/9/90
 36240                                  ; 	Rev. M003 - added functions (al) = 2 and (al) = 3. 7/18/90
 36241                                  ;	Rev. M009 - (al) = 3 will return 'invalid function' in ax if
 36242                                  ;		    umbhead has'nt been initialized by sysinit and 'trashed
 36243                                  ;		    arena' if an arena sig is damaged.
 36244                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36245                                  
 36246                                  ; MSDOS 2.11 (& MSDOS 3.3)
 36247                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 36451                                  ; Procedure Name : GetLastArena		-  M003
 36452                                  ;
 36453                                  ; Inputs	 : cx = umb_head
 36454                                  ;
 36455                                  ;
 36456                                  ; Outputs	 : If UMBs are linked
 36457                                  ;			ES = umb_head
 36458                                  ;			DS = arena before umb_head
 36459                                  ;		   else
 36460                                  ;			DS = last arena
 36461                                  ;			ES = next arena. will be umb_head if NC.
 36462                                  ;
 36463                                  ;		   CY if error
 36464                                  ;
 36465                                  ; Uses		 : DS, ES, DI, BX
 36466                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36467                                  
 36468                                  ; 14/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 36469                                  ; DOSCODE:A4D6h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 36470

 36484

 36497                                  					;    umb_head

 36958                                  ;	BREAK	<pJFNFromHandle - return pointer to JFN table entry>
 36959                                  
 36960                                  ;**	pJFNFromHandle - Translate Handle to Pointer to JFN
 36961                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36962                                  ;	pJFNFromHandle takes a file handle and turns that into a pointer to
 36963                                  ;	the JFN entry (i.e., to a byte holding the internal file handle #)
 36964                                  ;
 36965                                  ;	NOTE:
 36966                                  ;	  This routine is called from $CREATE_PROCESS_DATA_BLOCK which is called
 36967                                  ;	  at DOSINIT time with SS NOT DOSGROUP
 36968                                  ;
 36969                                  ;	ENTRY	(bx) = handle
 36970                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if ok
 36971                                  ;		  (es:di) = address of JFN value
 36972                                  ;		'C' set if error
 36973                                  ;		  (ax) = error code
 36974                                  ;	USES	AX, DI, ES, Flags
 36975                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36976                                  
 36977                                  	; 02/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 36978                                  
 36979                                  pJFNFromHandle:
 36980                                  	; 05/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 36981                                  	;getdseg <es>			; es -> dosdata
 36982 0000649F 2E8E06[0700]            	mov	es,[cs:DosDSeg]
 36983                                  	
 36984                                  	;MOV	ES,[cs:CurrentPDB]	; get user process data block
 36985 000064A4 268E06[3003]            	mov	es,[es:CurrentPDB]
 36986                                  
 36987                                  	;cmp	bx,[ES:32h]
 36988 000064A9 263B1E3200              	CMP	BX,[ES:PDB.JFN_Length]	; is handle greater than allocated
 36989 000064AE 7204                    	JB	short pjfn10		; no, get offset
 36990                                  ReturnCarry_inv_hndl: ; 05/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 36991                                  	;mov	al,6
 36992 000064B0 B006                    	MOV     AL,error_invalid_handle ; appropriate error
 36993                                  ReturnCarry:
 36994 000064B2 F9                      	STC                             ; signal error
 36995 000064B3 C3                      	retn				; go back
 36996                                  pjfn10: 
 36997                                  	;les	di,[es:34h]
 36998 000064B4 26C43E3400              	LES	DI,[ES:PDB.JFN_Pointer]	; get pointer to beginning of table
 36999 000064B9 01DF                    	ADD	DI,BX			; add in offset, clear 'C'
 37000                                  	;clc

 37004                                  ;BREAK <SFFromHandle - return pointer (or error) to SF entry from handle>
 37005                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37006                                  ;
 37007                                  ; Procedure Name : SFFromHandle
 37008                                  ;
 37009                                  ; SFFromHandle - Given a handle, get JFN and then index into SF table
 37010                                  ;
 37011                                  ;   Input:      BX has handle
 37012                                  ;   Output:     Carry Set
 37013                                  ;                   AX has error code
 37014                                  ;               Carry Reset
 37015                                  ;                   ES:DI has pointer to SF entry
 37016                                  ;   Registers modified: If error, AX,ES, else ES:DI
 37017                                  ; NOTE:
 37018                                  ;   This routine is called from $CREATE_PROCESS_DATA_BLOCK which is called
 37019                                  ;       at DOSINIT time with SS NOT DOSGROUP
 37020                                  ;
 37021                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37022                                  
 37023                                  	; 02/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 37024                                  
 37025                                  SFFromHandle:
 37026 000064BC E8E0FF                  	CALL	pJFNFromHandle		; get jfn pointer

 37028 000064BF 72FA                    	jc	short pJFNFromHandle_error
 37029 000064C1 26803DFF                	CMP     BYTE [ES:DI],-1		; unused handle
 37030                                  	;JNZ	short GetSF		; nope, suck out SF
 37031                                  	;;mov	al,6
 37032                                  	;MOV	AL,error_invalid_handle ; appropriate error
 37033                                  	;jmp	short ReturnCarry	; signal it
 37034                                  	; 17/12/2022
 37035                                  	; 02/12/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 37036 000064C5 74E9                    	jz	short ReturnCarry_inv_hndl ; Retro DOS v3.0 modification
 37037                                  	;JNZ	short GetSF		; nope, suck out SF
 37038                                  	;;mov	al,6
 37039                                  	;MOV	AL,error_invalid_handle ; appropriate error
 37040                                  	;jmp	short ReturnCarry	; signal it
 37041                                  GetSF:
 37042 000064C7 53                      	push	bx			; save handle
 37043 000064C8 268A1D                  	MOV     BL,[ES:DI]		; get SFN

 37045 000064CD E80200                  	CALL    SFFromSFN               ; get real sf spot

 37047 000064D1 C3                      	retn                        	; say goodbye

 37049                                  ;BREAK <SFFromSFN - index into SF table for SFN>
 37050                                  
 37051                                  ;**	SFFromSFN - Get an SF Table entry from an SFN
 37052                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37053                                  ;	SFFromSfn uses an SFN to index an entry into the SF table. This
 37054                                  ;	is more than just a simple index instruction because the SF table
 37055                                  ;	can be made up of multiple pieces chained together. We follow the
 37056                                  ;	chain to the right piece and then do the index operation.
 37057                                  ;
 37058                                  ;   NOTE:
 37059                                  ;	This routine is called from SFFromHandle which is called
 37060                                  ;       at DOSINIT time with SS NOT DOSGROUP
 37061                                  ;
 37062                                  ;	ENTRY	BX has SF index
 37063                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if OK
 37064                                  ;		  ES:DI points to SF entry
 37065                                  ;		'C' set if index too large
 37066                                  ;	USES	BX, DI, ES
 37067                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37068                                  
 37069                                  	; 02/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 37070                                  
 37071                                  SFFromSFN:
 37072                                  	; 05/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 37073                                  	;getdseg <es>			; es -> dosdata
 37074 000064D2 2E8E06[0700]            	mov	es,[cs:DosDSeg]
 37075                                  
 37076                                  	;LES	DI,[CS:SFT_ADDR]	; (es:di) = start of SFT table
 37077 000064D7 26C43E[2A00]            	les	di,[es:SFT_ADDR]
 37078                                  sfsfn5:	
 37079                                  	;cmp	bx,[es:di+4]
 37080 000064DC 263B5D04                	CMP	BX,[ES:DI+SFT.SFCount]	; is handle in this table?
 37081 000064E0 720E                    	JB	short sfsfn7		; yes, go grab it
 37082                                  	;sub	bx,[es:di+4]
 37083 000064E2 262B5D04                	SUB     BX,[ES:DI+SFT.SFCount]
 37084 000064E6 26C43D                  	les	di,[es:di] ; 14/08/2018
 37085                                  	;LES	DI,[ES:DI+SFT.SFLink]	; get next table segment
 37086 000064E9 83FFFF                  	CMP     DI,-1                   ; end of tables?
 37087 000064EC 75EE                    	JNZ	short sfsfn5		; no, try again
 37088 000064EE F9                      	STC
 37089 000064EF C3                      	retn				; return with error, not found
 37090                                  sfsfn7:
 37091 000064F0 50                      	push	ax
 37092                                  	;mov	ax,53 ; MSDOS 3.3
 37093                                  	;mov	ax,59 ; MSDOS 6.0
 37094                                  	;MOV	AX,SF_ENTRY.size	; put it in a nice place
 37095                                  	
 37096                                  	; 17/12/2022
 37097 000064F1 B03B                    	mov	al,SF_ENTRY.size ; 28/05/2019
 37098                                  	; 07/12/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 37099                                  	;mov	ax,SF_ENTRY.size ; 59
 37100                                  	
 37101 000064F3 F6E3                    	MUL	BL			; (ax) = offset into this SF block
 37102 000064F5 01C7                    	ADD	DI,AX			; add base of SF block
 37103 000064F7 58                      	pop	ax
 37104                                  	;add	di,6
 37105 000064F8 83C706                  	ADD	DI,SFT.SFTable		; offset into structure, 'C' cleared
 37106 000064FB C3                      	retn				; return with 'C' clear

 37110                                  ;**	JFNFree - Find a Free JFN Slot
 37111                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37112                                  ;	JFNFree scansthrough the JFN table and returnsa pointer to a free slot
 37113                                  ;
 37114                                  ;	ENTRY	(ss) = DOSDATA
 37115                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if OK
 37116                                  ;		  (bx) = new handle
 37117                                  ;		  (es:di) = pointer to JFN slot
 37118                                  ;		'C' set if error
 37119                                  ;		  (al) = error code
 37120                                  ;	USES	bx, di, es, flags
 37121                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37122                                  
 37123                                  JFNFree:
 37124 000064FC 31DB                    	XOR	BX,BX			; (bx) = initial JFN to try
 37125                                  jfnf1:	
 37126 000064FE E89EFF                  	CALL	pJFNFromHandle		; get the appropriate handle
 37127 00006501 7209                    	JC	short jfnf5		; no more handles
 37128 00006503 26803DFF                	CMP     BYTE [ES:DI],-1		; free?
 37129 00006507 7405                    	je	short jfnfx		; yes, carry is clear
 37130 00006509 43                      	INC     BX                      ; no, next handle
 37131 0000650A EBF2                    	JMP	short jfnf1		; and try again
 37132                                  
 37133                                  	; Error. 'C' set
 37134                                  jfnf5:	
 37135                                  	;mov	al,4
 37136 0000650C B004                    	MOV	AL,error_too_many_open_files
 37137                                  jfnfx:	
 37138 0000650E C3                      	retn				; bye
 37139                                  
 37140                                  ;	BREAK <SFNFree - Allocate a free SFN>
 37141                                  
 37142                                  ;**	SFNFree - Allocate a Free SFN/SFT
 37143                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37144                                  ;	SFNFree scans through the sf table looking for a free entry
 37145                                  ;	If it finds one it partially allocates it by setting SFT_REF_COUNT = -1
 37146                                  ;
 37147                                  ;	The problem is that we want to mark the SFT busy so that other threads
 37148                                  ;	can't allocate the SFT before we're finished marking it up.  However,
 37149                                  ;	we can't just mark it busy because we may get blown out of our open
 37150                                  ;	by INT24 and leave the thing orphaned.	To solve this we mark it
 37151                                  ;	"allocation in progress" by setting SFT_REF_COUNT = -1.  If we see
 37152                                  ;	an SFT with this value we look to see if it belongs to this user
 37153                                  ;	and process.  If it does belong to us then it must be an orphan
 37154                                  ;	and we reclaim it.
 37155                                  ;
 37156                                  ;	BUGBUG - improve the performance. I guess it's smaller to call SFFromSFN
 37157                                  ;		over and over, but we could at least set a high water mark...
 37158                                  ;		cause an N^2 loop calling slow SFFromSFN is real slow, too slow
 37159                                  ;		even though this is not a frequently called routine - jgl
 37160                                  ;
 37161                                  ;	ENTRY	(ss) = DOSDATA
 37162                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if no error
 37163                                  ;		  (bx) = SFN
 37164                                  ;		  (es:di) = pointer to SFT
 37165                                  ;		  es:[di].SFT_REF_COUNT = -1
 37166                                  ;		'C' set if error
 37167                                  ;		  (al) = error code
 37168                                  ;	USES	bx, di, es, Flags
 37169                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37170                                  
 37171                                  	; 02/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 37172                                  	; DOSCODE:A682h (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 37173                                  
 37174                                  SFNFree:
 37175                                  	; 12/08/2018
 37176                                  	; 05/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 37177                                  	;
 37178                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 37179 0000650F 50                      	push	ax
 37180 00006510 31DB                    	xor	bx,bx			; (bx) = SFN to consider
 37181                                  sfnf5:	
 37182 00006512 53                      	push	bx
 37183 00006513 E8BCFF                  	call	SFFromSFN		; get the potential handle
 37184 00006516 5B                      	pop	bx
 37185 00006517 723A                    	jc	short sfnf95		; no more free SFNs
 37186 00006519 26833D00                	cmp	word [ES:DI],0
 37187                                  	;cmp	word [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_Ref_Count],0 ; free?
 37188 0000651D 741D                    	je	short sfnf20			; yep, got one
 37189                                  	
 37190                                  	;cmp	word [es:di],0FFFFh ; -1
 37191 0000651F 26833DFF                	cmp	word [ES:DI],sf_busy
 37192                                  	;cmp	word [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count],sf_busy
 37193 00006523 7403                    	je	short sfnf10		; special busy mark
 37194                                  sfnf7:	
 37195 00006525 43                      	inc	bx			; try the next one
 37196 00006526 EBEA                    	jmp	short sfnf5
 37197                                  
 37198                                  ;	The SFT has the special "busy" mark; if it belongs to us then
 37199                                  ;	it was abandoned during a earlier call and we can use it.
 37200                                  ;
 37201                                  ;	(bx)	= SFN
 37202                                  ;	(es:di) = pointer to SFT
 37203                                  ;	(TOS)	= caller's (ax)
 37204                                  
 37205                                  sfnf10:	
 37206 00006528 36A1[3E03]              	mov	ax,[SS:USER_ID]
 37207                                  	;cmp	[es:di+2Fh],ax
 37208 0000652C 2639452F                	cmp	[ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_UID],ax
 37209 00006530 75F3                    	jnz	short sfnf7		; not ours
 37210 00006532 36A1[3C03]              	mov	ax,[SS:PROC_ID]
 37211                                  	;cmp	[es:di+31h],ax
 37212 00006536 26394531                	cmp	[ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_PID],ax
 37213 0000653A 75E9                    	jnz	short sfnf7		; can't use this one, try the next
 37214                                  
 37215                                  ;	We have an SFT to allocate
 37216                                  ;
 37217                                  ;	(bx)	= SFN
 37218                                  ;	(es:di) = pointer to SFT
 37219                                  ;	(TOS)	= caller's (ax)
 37220                                  
 37221                                  sfnf20:
 37222                                  	; cf = 0 ;; Retro DOS v3.0
 37223                                  
 37224                                  	;mov	word [es:di],0FFFFh
 37225 0000653C 26C705FFFF              	mov	word [ES:DI],sf_busy
 37226                                  					; make sure that this is allocated
 37227                                  	;mov	word [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count],sf_busy
 37228                                  
 37229 00006541 36A1[3E03]              	mov	ax,[SS:USER_ID]
 37230                                  	;mov	[es:di+2Fh],ax
 37231 00006545 2689452F                	mov	[ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_UID],ax
 37232 00006549 36A1[3C03]              	mov	ax,[SS:PROC_ID]
 37233                                  	;mov	[es:di+31h],ax
 37234 0000654D 26894531                	mov	[ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_PID],ax
 37235                                  sfnf21: ;; Retro DOS v3.0
 37236                                  	; 02/12/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 37237                                  	;pop	ax
 37238                                  	;;clc
 37239                                  	;retn				; return with no error
 37240                                  	; 17/12/2022
 37241 00006551 58                      	pop	ax
 37242                                  	;clc
 37243 00006552 C3                      	retn
 37244                                  
 37245                                  ;**	Error - no more free SFNs
 37246                                  ;
 37247                                  ;	'C' set

 37249

 37251 00006553 58                      	pop	ax

 37254                                  %if 0
