 37268                                  
 37269                                  ; DOSCODE:A72Bh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 37270                                  
 37271                                  ;	BREAK <$Close - return a handle to the system>
 37272                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37273                                  ;
 37274                                  ;**	$Close - Close a file Handle
 37275                                  ;
 37276                                  ;	BUGBUG - close gets called a LOT with invalid handles - sizzle that
 37277                                  ;		path
 37278                                  ;
 37279                                  ;	Assembler usage:
 37280                                  ;	    MOV     BX, handle
 37281                                  ;	    MOV     AH, Close
 37282                                  ;	    INT     int_command
 37283                                  ;
 37284                                  ;	ENTRY	(bx) = handle
 37285                                  ;	EXIT	<normal INT21 return convention>
 37286                                  ;	USES	all
 37287                                  ;
 37288                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37289                                  
 37290                                  ; 02/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 37291                                  ; DOSCODE:A6CBh (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 37292                                  
 37293                                  _$CLOSE:
 37294                                  ;	Grab the SFT pointer from the JFN.
 37295                                  
 37296 00006556 E84802                  	call	CheckOwner		; get system file entry
 37297 00006559 722B                    	jc	short CloseError	; error return
 37298 0000655B 16                      	push	ss
 37299 0000655C 1F                      	pop	ds			; For DOS_CLOSE
 37300 0000655D 893E[9E05]              	MOV	[THISSFT],DI		; save offset of pointer
 37301 00006561 8C06[A005]              	MOV	[THISSFT+2],ES		; save segment value
 37302                                  
 37303                                  ; DS:SI point to JFN table entry.
 37304                                  ; ES:DI point to SFT
 37305                                  ;
 37306                                  ; We now examine the user's JFN entry; If the file was a 70-mode file (network
 37307                                  ; FCB, we examine the ref count on the SFT; if it was 1, we free the JFN.

 37778                                  	MOV	DS,AX			; in seg register

 37783                                  	retn

 38149                                  ;Break	<CheckOwner - verify ownership of handles from server>
 38150                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38151                                  ;   CheckOwner - Due to the ability of the server to close file handles for a
 38152                                  ;   process without the process knowing it (delete/rename of open files, for
 38153                                  ;   example), it is possible for the redirector to issue a call to a handle
 38154                                  ;   that it soes not rightfully own. We check here to make sure that the
 38155                                  ;   issuing process is the owner of the SFT. At the same time, we do a
 38156                                  ;   SFFromHandle to really make sure that the SFT is good.
 38157                                  ;
 38158                                  ;	ENTRY	BX has the handle
 38159                                  ;		User_ID is the current user
 38160                                  ;	EXIT	Carry Clear => ES:DI points to SFT
 38161                                  ;		Carry Set => AX has error code
 38162                                  ;	USES	none
 38163                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38164                                  
 38165                                  	; 02/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 38166                                  	; 21/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 38167                                  CheckOwner:
 38168                                  	; 13/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 38169                                  
 38170 000067A1 E818FD                  	call	SFFromHandle
 38171 000067A4 721B                    	jc	short co_ret_label	; retc
 38172                                  
 38173 000067A6 50                      	push	ax
 38174                                  
 38175                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 38176

 38178                                  ;SR; are shared across multiple VMs in win386.

 38182 000067AF 31C0                    	xor	ax,ax			;set the zero flag

 38184                                  
 38185                                  no_win386:

 38187                                  	;cmp	ax,[es:di+47]

 38189

 38191 000067BB 58                      	pop	ax

 38213                                  ;	TITLE	MACRO - Pathname and macro related internal routines
 38214                                  ;	NAME	MACRO
 38215                                  
 38216                                  ;	Microsoft Confidential
 38217                                  ;	Copyright (C) Microsoft Corporation 1991
 38218                                  ;	All Rights Reserved.
 38219                                  
 38220                                  ;**	MACRO.ASM
 38221                                  ;
 38222                                  ;	$AssignOper
 38223                                  ;	FIND_DPB
 38224                                  ;	InitCDS
 38225                                  ;	$UserOper
 38226                                  ;	GetVisDrv
 38227                                  ;	GetThisDrv
 38228                                  ;	GetCDSFromDrv
 38229                                  ;
 38230                                  ;   Revision history:
 38231                                  ;
 38232                                  ;	Created: MZ 4 April 1983
 38233                                  ;		 MZ 18 April 1983   Make TransFCB handle extended FCBs
 38234                                  ;		 AR 2 June 1983     Define/Delete macro for NET redir.
 38235                                  ;		 MZ 3 Nov 83	    Fix InitCDS to reset length to 2
 38236                                  ;		 MZ 4 Nov 83	    Fix NetAssign to use STRLEN only
 38237                                  ;		 MZ 18 Nov 83	    Rewrite string processing for subtree
 38238                                  ;				    aliasing.
 38239                                  ;
 38240                                  ;   MSDOS performs several types of name translation. First, we maintain for
 38241                                  ;   each valid drive letter the text of the current directory on that drive.
 38242                                  ;   For invalid drive letters, there is no current directory so we pretend to
 38243                                  ;   be at the root. A current directory is either the raw local directory
 38244                                  ;   (consisting of drive:\path) or a local network directory (consisting of
 38245                                  ;   \\machine\path. There is a limit on the point to which a .. is allowed.
 38246                                  ;
 38247                                  ;   Given a path, MSDOS will transform this into a real from-the-root path
 38248                                  ;   without . or .. entries. Any component that is > 8.3 is truncated to
 38249                                  ;   this and all * are expanded into ?'s.
 38250                                  ;
 38251                                  ;   The second part of name translation involves subtree aliasing. A list of
 38252                                  ;   subtree pairs is maintained by the external utility SUBST. The results of
 38253                                  ;   the previous 'canonicalization' are then examined to see if any of the
 38254                                  ;   subtree pairs is a prefix of the user path. If so, then this prefix is
 38255                                  ;   replaced with the other subtree in the pair.
 38256                                  ;
 38257                                  ;   A third part involves mapping this "real" path into a "physical" path.  A
 38258                                  ;   list of drive/subtree pairs are maintained by the external utility JOIN.
 38259                                  ;   The output of the previous translation is examined to see if any of the
 38260                                  ;   subtrees in this list are a prefix of the string. If so, then the prefix
 38261                                  ;   is replaced by the appropriate drive letter. In this manner, we can
 38262                                  ;   'mount' one device under another.
 38263                                  ;
 38264                                  ;   The final form of name translation involves the mapping of a user's
 38265                                  ;   logical drive number into the internal physical drive. This is
 38266                                  ;   accomplished by converting the drive number into letter:CON, performing
 38267                                  ;   the above translation and then converting the character back into a drive
 38268                                  ;   number.
 38269                                  ;
 38270                                  ;   There are two main entry points: TransPath and TransFCB. TransPath will
 38271                                  ;   take a path and form the real text of the pathname with all . and ..
 38272                                  ;   removed. TransFCB will translate an FCB into a path and then invoke
 38273                                  ;   TransPath.
 38274                                  ;
 38275                                  ;	A000	version 4.00  Jan. 1988
 38276                                  
 38277                                  ;Installed = TRUE
 38278                                  
 38279                                  ;	I_need	ThisCDS,DWORD		; pointer to CDS used
 38280                                  ;	I_need	CDSAddr,DWORD		; pointer to CDS table
 38281                                  ;	I_need	CDSCount,BYTE		; number of CDS entries
 38282                                  ;	I_need	CurDrv,BYTE		; current macro assignment (old
 38283                                  ;					; current drive)
 38284                                  ;	I_need	NUMIO,BYTE		; Number of physical drives
 38285                                  ;	I_need	fSharing,BYTE		; TRUE => no redirection allowed
 38286                                  ;	I_need	DummyCDS,80h		; buffer for dummy cds
 38287                                  ;	I_need	DIFFNAM,BYTE		; flag for MyName being set
 38288                                  ;	I_need	MYNAME,16		; machine name
 38289                                  ;	I_need	MYNUM,WORD		; machine number
 38290                                  ;	I_need	DPBHEAD,DWORD		; beginning of DPB chain

 38868                                  ;BREAK <TransPath - copy a path, do string sub and put in current dir>
 38869                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38870                                  ;
 38871                                  ;   TransPath - copy a path from DS:SI to ES:DI, performing component string
 38872                                  ;       substitution, insertion of current directory and fixing . and ..
 38873                                  ;       entries. Perform splicing. Allow input string to match splice
 38874                                  ;       exactly.
 38875                                  ;
 38876                                  ;   TransPathSet - Same as above except No splicing is performed if input path
 38877                                  ;       matches splice.
 38878                                  ;
 38879                                  ;   TransPathNoSet - No splicing/local using is performed at all.
 38880                                  ;
 38881                                  ;   The following anomalous behaviour is required:
 38882                                  ;
 38883                                  ;       Drive letters on devices are ignored. (set up DummyCDS)
 38884                                  ;       Paths on devices are ignored. (truncate to 0-length)
 38885                                  ;       Raw net I/O sets ThisCDS => NULL.
 38886                                  ;       fSharing => dummyCDS and no subst/splice. Only canonicalize.
 38887                                  ;
 38888                                  ;   Other behaviour:
 38889                                  ;
 38890                                  ;       ThisCDS set up.
 38891                                  ;       FatRead done on local CDS.
 38892                                  ;       ValidateCDS done on local CDS.
 38893                                  ;
 38894                                  ;   Brief flowchart:
 38895                                  ;
 38896                                  ;       if fSharing then
 38897                                  ;           set up DummyCDS (ThisCDS)
 38898                                  ;           canonicalize (sets cMeta)
 38899                                  ;           splice
 38900                                  ;           fatRead
 38901                                  ;           return
 38902                                  ;       if \\ or d:\\ lead then
 38903                                  ;           set up null CDS (ThisCDS)
 38904                                  ;           canonicalize (sets cMeta)
 38905                                  ;           return
 38906                                  ;       if device then
 38907                                  ;           set up dummyCDS (ThisCDS)
 38908                                  ;           canonicalize (sets cMeta)
 38909                                  ;           return
 38910                                  ;       if file then
 38911                                  ;           getCDS (sets (ThisCDS) from name)
 38912                                  ;           validateCDS (may reset current dir)
 38913                                  ;           Copy current dir
 38914                                  ;           canonicalize (set cMeta)
 38915                                  ;           splice
 38916                                  ;           generate correct CDS (ThisCDS)
 38917                                  ;           if local then
 38918                                  ;               fatread
 38919                                  ;           return
 38920                                  ;
 38921                                  ;   Inputs:     DS:SI - point to ASCIZ string path
 38922                                  ;               DI - point to buffer in DOSDATA
 38923                                  ;   Outputs:    Carry Set - invalid path specification: too many .., bad
 38924                                  ;                   syntax, etc. or user FAILed to I 24.
 38925                                  ;               WFP_Start - points to beginning of buffer
 38926                                  ;               Curr_Dir_End - points to end of current dir in path
 38927                                  ;               DS - DOSDATA
 38928                                  ;   Registers modified: most
 38929                                  ;
 38930                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38931                                  
 38932                                  ; 22/05/2019
 38933                                  ; 13/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 38934                                  ; DOSCODE:AB99h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 38935                                  
 38936                                  ; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 38937                                  ; DOSCODE:AB39h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)

 40406                                  ;**	BinToAscii - convert a number to a string.
 40407                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 40408                                  ;	BinToAscii converts a 16 bit number into a 4 ascii characters.
 40409                                  ;	This routine is used to generate temp file names so we don't spend
 40410                                  ;	the time and code needed for a true hex number, we just use
 40411                                  ;	A thorugh O.
 40412                                  ;
 40413                                  ;	ENTRY	(ax) = value
 40414                                  ;		(es:di) = destination
 40415                                  ;	EXIT	(es:di) updated by 4
 40416                                  ;	USES	cx, di, flags
 40417                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 40418                                  
 40419                                  ; MSDOS 3.3
 40420                                  ;BinToAscii:
 40421                                  ;	mov     cx,4
 40422                                  ;bta5:
 40423                                  ;	push    cx
 40424                                  ;	mov     cl,4
 40425                                  ;	rol     ax,cl
 40426                                  ;	push    ax
 40427                                  ;	and     al,0Fh
 40428                                  ;	add     al,'0'
 40429                                  ;	cmp     al,'9'
 40430                                  ;	jbe     short bta6
 40431                                  ;	add     al,7
 40432                                  ;bta6: 
 40433                                  ;	stosb
 40434                                  ;	pop     ax
 40435                                  ;	pop     cx
 40436                                  ;	loop    bta5
 40437                                  ;	retn
 40438                                  
 40439                                  ; 15/03/2024
 40440                                  ; MSDOS 5.0-6.22 & Windows ME
 40441                                  ; (MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:0B0D9h)
 40442                                  ; (Windows ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:0ABA4h)
 40443                                  %if 1
 40444                                  
 40445                                  ; MSDOS 6.0
 40446                                  BinToAscii:
 40447 00006ECF B90404                  	mov	cx,404h			; (ch) = digit counter, (cl) = shift cnt
 40448                                  bta5:	
 40449 00006ED2 D3C0                    	ROL	AX,CL			; move leftmost nibble into rightmost
 40450 00006ED4 50                      	push	ax			; preserve remainder of digits
 40451 00006ED5 240F                    	AND	AL,0Fh			; grab low nibble
 40452 00006ED7 0441                    	ADD	AL,'A'			; turn into ascii
 40453 00006ED9 AA                      	STOSB				; drop in the character
 40454 00006EDA 58                      	pop	ax			; (ax) = shifted number
 40455 00006EDB FECD                    	dec	ch
 40456 00006EDD 75F3                    	jnz	short bta5		; process 4 digits
 40457 00006EDF C3                      	retn
 40458                                  %else

 40461                                  
 40462                                  BinToAscii:

 40477                                  ;Break	<$CreateTempFile - create a unique name>
 40478                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 40479                                  ;   $CreateTemp - given a directory, create a unique name in that directory.
 40480                                  ;	Method used is to get the current time, convert to a name and attempt
 40481                                  ;	a create new. Repeat until create new succeeds.
 40482                                  ;
 40483                                  ;   Inputs:	DS:DX point to a null terminated directory name.
 40484                                  ;		CX  contains default attributes

 40489                                  
 40490                                  	; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)

 40493                                  	;Enter

 40504 00006EE6 F7C1D8FF                	test	CX,~attr_changeable
 40505 00006EEA 7405                    	JZ	short OKatts		; Ok if no non-changeable bits set
 40506                                  
 40507                                  ; We need this "hook" here to detect these cases (like user sets one both of
 40508                                  ; vol_id and dir bits) because of the structure of the or $CreateNewFile loop
 40509                                  ; below. The code loops on error_access_denied, but if one of the non
 40510                                  ; changeable attributes is specified, the loop COULD be infinite or WILL be
 40511                                  ; infinite because CreateNewFile will fail with access_denied always. Thus we
 40512                                  ; need to detect these cases before getting to the loop.

 41368                                  ;Break <ShareEnter - attempt to enter a node into the sharing set>
 41369                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41370                                  ;   ShareEnter - perform a retried entry of a nodde into the sharing set. If
 41371                                  ;   the max number of retries is exceeded, we notify the user via int 24.
 41372                                  ;
 41373                                  ;   Inputs:     ThisSFT points to the SFT
 41374                                  ;               WFP_Start points to the WFP
 41375                                  ;   Outputs:    Carry clear => successful entry
 41376                                  ;               Carry set => failed system call
 41377                                  ;   Registers modified: all
 41378                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41379

 41391 0000717D 59                      	pop	cx

 41394 00007183 E2EA                    	loop    attempt                 ; go back for another attempt
 41395 00007185 E8BEFF                  	call    SHARE_VIOLATION         ; signal the problem to the user

 41397                                  done:

 41399 0000718B C3                      	retn

 41572                                  ;
 41573                                  ; procedure : Rational386Patch
 41574                                  ;
 41575                                  ; Older versions of the Rational DOS Extender have several bugs which trash
 41576                                  ; 386 registers (usually just the high word of 32 bit registers) during
 41577                                  ; interrupt processing. Lotus 123 3.1+ is a popular application that uses a
 41578                                  ; version of the Rational extender with the 32 bit register trashing bugs.
 41579                                  ;
 41580                                  ; This routine applies patches to the Rational DOS Extender to work around
 41581                                  ; most of the register trashing bugs.
 41582                                  ;
 41583                                  ; Note that there are additional register trashing bugs not fixed by these
 41584                                  ; patches. In particular, the high word of ESP and the FS and GS registers
 41585                                  ; may be modified on interrupts.
 41586                                  ;
 41587                                  ; There are two different Rational DOS Extender patchs in this module.
 41588                                  ; Rational386Patch is to correct 386 register trashing bugs on 386 or later
 41589                                  ; processors. This patch code is executed when MS-DOS is running on a 386
 41590                                  ; or later processor, regardless of whether MS-DOS is running in the HMA
 41591                                  ; or not.
 41592                                  ;
 41593                                  ; The other Rational patch routine (RationalPatch, below) fixes a register
 41594                                  ; trashing problem on 286 processors, and is only executed if MS-DOS is
 41595                                  ; running in the HMA.
 41596                                  ;
 41597                                  ; This patch detection and replacement is based on an example supplied by
 41598                                  ; Ben Williams at Rational.
 41599                                  ;
 41600                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41601                                  
 41602                                  ; 22/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0

 41885                                  Rational386Patch:
 41886                                  	; Do a few quick checks to see if this looks like a Rational
 41887                                  	; Extended application. Hopefully this will quickly weed out
 41888                                  	; most non Rational apps.
 41889                                  
 41890                                  	cmp	word [es:0],395		; version number goes here - versions
 41891                                  	jae	short rp3QuickOut	;   3.95+ don't need patching
 41892                                  
 41893                                  	cmp	word [es:0Ch],20h	; always has this value here
 41894                                  	jne	short rp3QuickOut
 41895                                  
 41896                                  	push	ax
 41897                                  
 41898                                  	mov	ax,18h 			; extender has 18h at
 41899                                  	cmp	[es:24],ax		;   offsets 24, 28, & 36
 41900                                  	jne	short rp3QO_ax
 41901                                  	cmp	[es:28],ax
 41902                                  	jne	short rp3QO_ax
 41903                                  	cmp	[es:36],ax
 41904                                  	je	short rp3Maybe
 41905                                  rp3QO_ax:
 41906                                  	pop	ax
 41907                                  rp3QuickOut:
 41908                                  	retn
 41909                                  
 41910                                  ; It might be the rational extender, do more extensive checking
 41911                                  
 41912                                  rp3Maybe:
 41913                                  	cld
 41914                                  	push	bx			; note ax pushed above
 41915                                  	push	cx
 41916                                  	push	dx
 41917                                  	push	si
 41918                                  	push	di
 41919                                  	push	es
 41920                                  	push	ds			; we use all of them
 41921                                  	push	bp
 41922                                  	sub	sp,StackVars.size  ; 6	; make space for stack variables
 41923                                  	mov	bp,sp
 41924                                  
 41925                                  	push	cs
 41926                                  	pop	ds
 41927                                  
 41928                                  	mov	ax,[es:0]		; save version #
 41929                                  	;mov	[bp+StackVars.sv_wVersion],ax
 41930                                  	mov	[bp],ax	
 41931                                  					; check that binary version # matches
 41932                                  	call	VerifyVersion		;   ascii string
 41933                                  	jne	short rp3Exit_j

 41935                                  ; Looks like this is it, find where to put the patch code.  The
 41936                                  ; patch will be located on top of Rational code specific to 80286

 42020                                  						;   area pointer

 42053                                  						;   main-line code

 42056                                  ; after the code in the patch area

 42152                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42153                                  ;
 42154                                  ; FindBadCode
 42155                                  ;
 42156                                  ; Searches Rational code segment looking for a pair of find strings (all
 42157                                  ; patches have at least two find strings).
 42158                                  ;
 42159                                  ; Entry:
 42160                                  ;	ES    = code segment to search
 42161                                  ;	DS:BX = search pair structure for this search
 42162                                  ;	[bp].sv_cbCodeSeg = length of code seg to search
 42163                                  ;
 42164                                  ; Exit:
 42165                                  ;	CY flag clear if both strings found, and
 42166                                  ;	SI    = offset in ES of 1st string
 42167                                  ;	DI    = offset in ES of 2nd string
 42168                                  ;	CY set if either string not found, or strings too far apart
 42169                                  ;
 42170                                  ; Used:
 42171                                  ;	CX
 42172                                  ;
 42173                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42174                                  
 42175                                  ;struc SearchPair
 42176                                  ; .sp_off1: resw 1	; offset of 1st search string
 42177                                  ; .sp_len1: resw 1	; length of 1st search string
 42178                                  ; .sp_off2: resw 1	; 2nd string
 42179                                  ; .sp_len2: resw 1	; 2nd string
 42180                                  ; .sp_diff: resw 1	; max difference between offsets
 42181                                  ; .size:
 42182                                  ;endstruc
 42183                                  
 42184                                  FindBadCode:
 42185                                  	;mov	cx,[bp+2]
 42186                                  	mov	cx,[bp+StackVars.sv_cbCodeSeg]	; search length
 42187                                  
 42188                                  	mov	si,[bx]	; mov si,[bx+0]
 42189                                  	;mov	si,[bx+Searchpair.sp_off1] ; ds:si -> search string
 42190                                  
 42191                                  	;mov	dx,[bx+2]
 42192                                  	mov	dx,[bx+SearchPair.sp_len1] ; dx = search len
 42193                                  	call	ScanCodeSeq
 42194                                  	jnz	short fbc_error		; done if 1st not found
 42195                                  
 42196                                  	push	di			; save 1st string offset
 42197                                  
 42198                                  	;mov	si,[bx+4]
 42199                                  	mov	si,[bx+SearchPair.sp_off2]
 42200                                  	;mov	dx,[bx+6]
 42201                                  	mov	dx,[bx+SearchPair.sp_len2]
 42202                                  	call	ScanCodeSeq_di		; don't change flags after this!
 42203                                  
 42204                                  	pop	si			; restore 1st string offset
 42205                                  	jnz	short fbc_error
 42206                                  
 42207                                  	mov	ax,di			; sanity check that
 42208                                  	sub	ax,si			;   si < di && di - si <= allowed diff
 42209                                  	;jc	short fbc_error
 42210                                  	; 04/02/2026
 42211                                  	jc	short fbc_err
 42212                                  	;cmp	ax,[bx+8]
 42213                                  	cmp	ax,[bx+SearchPair.sp_diff]
 42214                                  	ja	short fbc_error
 42215                                  
 42216                                  	clc
 42217                                  	retn
 42218                                  
 42219                                  fbc_error:
 42220                                  	stc
 42221                                  fbc_err:
 42222                                  	retn
 42223                                  
 42224                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42225                                  ;
 42226                                  ; GenPatch
 42227                                  ;
 42228                                  ; Generate a patch sequence. 1) insert a jump at the buggy code location
 42229                                  ; (jumps to the patch code area), 2) copy the selected patch code to the
 42230                                  ; patch area, 3) insert a jump from the patch area back to the main-line
 42231                                  ; code.
 42232                                  ;
 42233                                  ; Entry:
 42234                                  ;	ES:DI = start of buggy code to be patched
 42235                                  ;	DX    = length of buggy code to be patched
 42236                                  ;	DS:SI = replacement patch code
 42237                                  ;	CX    = length of replacement patch code
 42238                                  ;	[bp].sv_pPatch = offset in ES of where to copy patch code
 42239                                  ;
 42240                                  ; Exit:
 42241                                  ;	DI, [bp].sv_pPatch = byte after generated patch code
 42242                                  ;
 42243                                  ; Used:
 42244                                  ;	AX, BX, SI, Flags
 42245                                  ;
 42246                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42247                                  
 42248                                  GenPatch:
 42249                                  	push	di			;save offset of buggy code
 42250                                  
 42251                                  	;mov	bx,[bp+4]
 42252                                  	mov	bx,[bp+StackVars.sv_pPatch]
 42253                                  					;jump from buggy code to patch area
 42254                                  	call	GenJump
 42255                                  
 42256                                  	call	CopyPatch		;copy replacement code to patch area
 42257                                  
 42258                                  	pop	bx			;offset of buggy code + buggy code
 42259                                  	add	bx,dx			;  length = return from patch offset
 42260                                  
 42261                                  	call	GenJump 		;jump from patch area back to main-
 42262                                  	;mov	[bp+4],di
 42263                                  	mov	[bp+StackVars.sv_pPatch],di
 42264                                  					;  line code, update patch pointer
 42265                                  	retn
 42266                                  
 42267                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42268                                  ;
 42269                                  ; CopyPatch
 42270                                  ;
 42271                                  ; Copies patch code to patch location.
 42272                                  ;
 42273                                  ; Entry:
 42274                                  ;	DS:SI = patch code to be copied
 42275                                  ;	ES    = segment of code to patch
 42276                                  ;	CX    = length of code to copy
 42277                                  ;	[bp].sv_pPatch = offset in ES of where to copy patch code
 42278                                  ;
 42279                                  ; Exit:
 42280                                  ;	DI, [bp].sv_pPatch = byte after copied patch code
 42281                                  ;
 42282                                  ; Used:
 42283                                  ;	SI, Flags
 42284                                  ;
 42285                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42286                                  
 42287                                  CopyPatch:
 42288                                  	push	cx
 42289                                  	;mov	di,[bp+4]
 42290                                  	mov	di,[bp+StackVars.sv_pPatch] ;patch pointer is the dest offset
 42291                                  	cld
 42292                                  	rep movsb
 42293                                  	pop	cx
 42294                                  	;mov	[bp+4],di
 42295                                  	mov	[bp+StackVars.sv_pPatch],di ;update net pointer location
 42296                                  	retn
 42297                                  
 42298                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42299                                  ;
 42300                                  ; GenJump
 42301                                  ;
 42302                                  ; Generates a rel16 JMP instruction at location 'from' to location 'to'.
 42303                                  ;
 42304                                  ; Entry:
 42305                                  ;	ES:DI = from location (where to put jmp instruction)
 42306                                  ;	BX    = to location (where to jump to)
 42307                                  ;
 42308                                  ; Exit:
 42309                                  ;	DI = byte after generated jump
 42310                                  ;
 42311                                  ; Used:
 42312                                  ;	AX
 42313                                  ;
 42314                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42315                                  
 42316                                  GenJump:
 42317                                  	mov	al,0E9h		; jmp rel16 opcode
 42318                                  	stosb
 42319                                  
 42320                                  	mov	ax,bx		; calc offset to 'to' location
 42321                                  	sub	ax,di
 42322                                  	sub	ax,2
 42323                                  
 42324                                  	stosw			; output offset
 42325                                  
 42326                                  	retn
 42327                                  
 42328                                  ; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 42329                                  ; (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 42330                                  
 42331                                  ; DOSCODE:B6D8h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 42332                                  ; 21/03/2024 - Retro DOS v4.2
 42333                                  ; DOSCODE:B6BEh (MSDOS 6.22, MSDOS.SYS)
 42334                                  
 42335                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42336                                  ;
 42337                                  ; ScanCodeSeq
 42338                                  ;
 42339                                  ; Looks for a pattern pointed to by DS:SI & len DX in ES:200 to ES:200+CX-1
 42340                                  ;
 42341                                  ; returns in ES:DI the start of the pattern if Zero flag is set
 42342                                  ;
 42343                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42344                                  
 42345                                  ScanCodeSeq:
 42346                                  	mov	di,200h
 42347                                  ScanCodeSeq_di:
 42348                                  	push	cx
 42349                                  	sub	cx,dx
 42350                                  	inc	cx
 42351                                  scsagain:
 42352                                  	push	si
 42353                                  	push	di
 42354                                  	push	cx
 42355                                  	mov	cx,dx
 42356                                  	rep	cmpsb
 42357                                  	pop	cx
 42358                                  	pop	di
 42359                                  	pop	si
 42360                                  	je	short scsfound
 42361                                  	inc	di
 42362                                  	loop	scsagain
 42363                                  scsfound:
 42364                                  	pop	cx
 42365                                  vvexit:		; 18/12/2022
 42366                                  	retn

 42368                                  ; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 42369                                  ; (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 42370                                  
 42371                                  ; DOSCODE:B6F0h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 42372                                  ; 21/03/2024 - Retro DOS v4.2
 42373                                  ; DOSCODE:B6D6h (MSDOS 6.22, MSDOS.SYS)
 42374                                  	
 42375                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42376                                  ;
 42377                                  ; VerifyVersion
 42378                                  ;
 42379                                  ; Checks whether the binary version from ES:0 matches the ASCII version
 42380                                  ; from ES:2A.
 42381                                  ;
 42382                                  ;       Entry: AX = binary version number 
 42383                                  ;       Exit : Z flag set if version numbers match
 42384                                  ;
 42385                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42386                                  
 42387                                  VerifyVersion:
 42388                                  	mov	si,[es:2Ah]		; offset of version number
 42389                                  					;  in ascii
 42390                                  	mov	bl,10
 42391                                  	add	si,3			; point to last digit
 42392                                  
 42393                                  	call	VVDigit
 42394                                  	jne	short vvexit
 42395                                  	call	VVDigit
 42396                                  	jne	short vvexit
 42397                                  	cmp	byte [es:si],'.'
 42398                                  	jne	short vvexit
 42399                                  	dec	si
 42400                                  	;call	VVDigit
 42401                                  	; 18/12/2022
 42402                                  	;jmp	short VVDigit
 42403                                  ;vvexit:
 42404                                  	;retn
 42405                                  VVDigit:
 42406                                  	div	bl
 42407                                  	add	ah,'0'
 42408                                  	dec	si
 42409                                  	cmp	[es:si+1],ah
 42410                                  	mov	ah,0			; do not xor or sub we need Z
 42411                                  	retn
 42412                                  
 42413                                  %endif

 42683                                  ;
 42684                                  ; Inputs	 	: DS 			-> DOSDATA
 42685                                  ;			  ES:0 			-> read in image
 42686                                  ;			  ax:cx = start cs:ip of program

 42688                                  ;
 42689                                  ;	1. If ES <= 0fffh
 42690                                  ;	   2. if exepack signature ('RB') found
 42691                                  ;	      3. if common code to patch compares (for 3 diff. versions)
 42692                                  ;	       	 4. if rest of the code & checksum compares
 42693                                  ;	  	    5. overlay buggy code with code in 
 42694                                  ;		       doscode:str1.
 42695                                  ;		 6. endif

 42697                                  ;	   8. endif

 43035                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 43036                                  ;
 43037                                  ; procedure : RationalPatch
 43038                                  ;
 43039                                  ; A routine (in Ration DOS extender) which is invoked at hardware interrupts
 43040                                  ; clobbers CX register on 286 machines. (123 release 3 uses Rational DOS
 43041                                  ; extender). This routine identifies Buggy Rational EXEs and fixes the bug.
 43042                                  ;
 43043                                  ; THE BUG is in the following code sequence:
 43044                                  ;
 43045                                  ;8b 0e 10 00	mov	cx, ds:[10h]		; delay count
 43046                                  ;90		even				; word align
 43047                                  ;e2 fe		loop	$			; wait		CLOBBERS CX
 43048                                  ;e8 xx xx	call	set_A20			; enable A20
 43049                                  ;
 43050                                  ; This patch routine replaces the mov & the loop with a far call into a
 43051                                  ; routine in DOS data segment which is in low memory (because A20 line
 43052                                  ; is off). The routine (RatBugCode) in DOS data saves & restores CX around
 43053                                  ; a mov & loop.
 43054                                  ;
 43055                                  ; Identification of Buggy Rational EXE
 43056                                  ; ====================================
 43057                                  ;
 43058                                  ; (ALL OFFSETS ARE IN THE PROGRAM SECTION - EXCLUDING THE EXE HEADER)
 43059                                  ;
 43060                                  ; OFFSET				Contains
 43061                                  ; ------				--------
 43062                                  ; 0000h			100 times Version number in binary
 43063                                  ;			bug exists in version 3.48 thru 3.83 (both inclusive)
 43064                                  ;
 43065                                  ; 000ah			the WORDS : 0000h, 0020h, 0000h, 0040h, 0001h
 43066                                  ;
 43067                                  ; 002ah			offset where version number is stored in ASCII
 43068                                  ;				e.g. '3.48A'
 43069                                  ;
 43070                                  ; 0030h			offset of copyright string. Copyright strings either
 43071                                  ;			start with "DOS/16M Copyright...." or
 43072                                  ;			"Copyright.....". The string contains
 43073                                  ;			"Rational Systems, Inc."
 43074                                  ;
 43075                                  ; 0020h			word : Paragraph offset of the buggy code segment
 43076                                  ;				from the program image
 43077                                  ; 0016h			word : size of buggy code segment
 43078                                  ;
 43079                                  ;	Buggy code is definite to start after offset 200h in its segment
 43080                                  ;
 43081                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 43082                                  
 43083                                  ; 23/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 43084                                  ; DOSCODE:B976h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 43085                                  
 43086                                  ; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 43087                                  ; DOSCODE:B654h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 43088                                  
 43089                                  RScanPattern1:
 43090                                  	db	0, 0, 20h, 0, 0, 0, 40h, 0, 1, 0
 43091                                  
 43092                                  RLen1 equ $ - RScanPattern1
 43093                                  
 43094                                  RScanPattern2:
 43095                                  	db	8Bh, 0Eh, 10h, 00h, 90h, 0E2h, 0FEh, 0E8h
 43096                                  
 43097                                  RLen2 equ $ - RScanPattern2
 43098                                  
 43099                                  RScanPattern3:
 43100                                  	db	8Bh, 0Eh, 10h, 00h, 0E2h, 0FEh, 0E8h
 43101                                  
 43102                                  RLen3 equ $ - RScanPattern2
 43103

 43105                                  ; DOSCODE:B66Dh (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 43106                                  
 43107                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 43108                                  ;
 43109                                  ; INPUT : ES = segment where program got loaded
 43110                                  ;
 43111                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 43128                                  	;;;
 43129                                  %endif
 43130                                  	push	es
 43131                                  	push	ds			; we use all of them
 43132                                  	mov	di,0Ah			; look for pat1 at offset 0Ah
 43133                                  	push	cs

 43136                                  	mov	si,RScanPattern1
 43137                                  	;mov	cx,10
 43138                                  	mov	cx,RLen1
 43139                                  	rep	cmpsb			; do we have the pattern ?
 43140                                  	jne	short rpexit
 43141                                  	mov	ax,[es:0]
 43142                                  	cmp	ax,348			; is it a buggy version ?
 43143                                  	jb	short rpexit
 43144                                  	cmp	ax,383			; is it a buggy version ?

 43152                                  					;  at offset 200h)

 43174                                  	stosw
 43175                                  	mov	ax,ss
 43176                                  	stosw
 43177                                  	mov	cx,dx

 43179                                  	mov	al,90h
 43180                                  	rep	stosb
 43181                                  rpexit:
 43182                                  	pop	ds
 43183                                  	pop	es
 43184                                  
 43185                                  ; 21/03/2024
 43186                                  %if 0

 43190                                  	pop	cx
 43191                                  	pop	bx

 43194                                  	; 21/03/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 43195                                  	;;;
 43196                                  	popa
 43197                                  	;;;
 43198                                  %endif
 43199                                  	retn

 44285                                  ; Procedure Name : seg_reinit
 44286                                  ;
 44287                                  ; Inputs	 : ES has final dos code location
 44288                                  ;		   AX = 0 / 1
 44289                                  ;
 44290                                  ; Outputs	 : Patch in the sharer and other tables with seg in ES
 44291                                  ;		   if AX =0
 44292                                  ;		      if first entry
 44293                                  ;			 patch segment & offset of vectors with stub
 44294                                  ;			 and stub with segment in ES
 44295                                  ;		      else
 44296                                  ;			 patch stub with segment in ES
 44297                                  ;
 44298                                  ;		   else if AX = 1
 44299                                  ;			patch segment of vectors with segment in ES	
 44300                                  ;
 44301                                  ; NOTE		 : This routine can be called at most twice!
 44302                                  ;
 44303                                  ; Regs Mod.	 : es, ax, di, cx, bx
 44304                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 44305                                  
 44306 000077B0 00                      num_entry: db	0		; keeps track of the # of times this routine
 44307                                  				; has been called. (0 or 1)

 44309                                  	; 04/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (ref: MSDOS 5.0)
 44310                                  	; MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:0BAB7h
 44311                                  	; 25/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0 (ref: MSDOS 6.21)
 44312                                  	; MSDOS 6.21 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:0BDA5h

 44320                                  					; other tables with seg in ES.

 44423                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 44424                                  ;
 44425                                  ; Procedure Name : WhatCPUType
 44426                                  ;
 44427                                  ; Inputs	 : none
 44428                                  ;
 44429                                  ; Outputs	 : AL = 0 if CPU <  286
 44430                                  ;		      = 1 if CPU == 286
 44431                                  ;		      = 2 if CPU >= 386
 44432                                  ;
 44433                                  ; Regs. Mod.	 : AX
 44434                                  ;
 44435                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 44436                                  
 44437                                  WhatCPUType:
 44438                                  	; 25/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 44439                                  	;get_cpu_type	; done with a MACRO which can't be generated > once
 44440                                  
 44441                                  	;CPUTYPE.INC (MSDOS 6.0, 1991)
 44442                                  
 44443                                  ; Note: this must be a macro, and not a subroutine in the BIOS since
 44444                                  ; 	it is called from both CODE and SYSINITSEG.
 44445                                  ;
 44446                                  ;------GET_CPU_TYPE-----------------------------------May, 88 by M.Williamson
 44447                                  ;  Returns: AX = 0 if 8086 or 8088
 44448                                  ;              = 1 if 80286
 44449                                  ;              = 2 if 80386
 44450                                  
 44451                                  	; 04/11/2022
 44452                                  	; MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:0BB03h
 44453                                  
 44454                                  Get_CPU_Type:	;macro
 44455                                  	pushf
 44456                                  	push	bx			; preserve bx
 44457                                  	xor	bx,bx			; init bx to zero
 44458                                  
 44459                                  	xor	ax,ax			; 0000 into AX
 44460                                  	push	ax			; put it on the stack...
 44461                                  	popf				; ...then shove it into the flags
 44462                                  	pushf				; get it back out of the flags...
 44463                                  	pop	ax			; ...and into ax
 44464                                  	and	ax,0F000h		; mask off high four bits
 44465                                  	cmp	ax,0F000h		; was it all 1's?
 44466                                  	je	short cpu_8086		; aye; it's an 8086 or 8088
 44467                                  
 44468                                  	mov	ax,0F000h		; now try to set the high four bits..
 44469                                  	push	ax
 44470                                  	popf
 44471                                  	pushf
 44472                                  	pop	ax			; ...and see what happens
 44473                                  	and	ax,0F000h		; any high bits set ?
 44474                                  	jz	short cpu_286		; nay; it's an 80286
 44475                                  
 44476                                  cpu_386:				; bx starts as zero
 44477                                  	inc	bx			; inc twice if 386
 44478                                  cpu_286:				; just inc once if 286
 44479                                  	inc	bx
 44480                                  cpu_8086:				; don't inc at all if 086
 44481                                  	mov	ax,bx			; put CPU type value in ax
 44482                                  	pop	bx			; restore original bx
 44483                                  	popf
 44484                                  	
 44485                                  	;endm
 44486                                  
 44487                                  	; 04/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 44488                                  	retn	; 19/09/2023
 44489                                  
 44490                                  ; 19/09/2023
 44491                                  ;	; 04/11/2022
 44492                                  ;	; MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:0BB27h
 44493                                  ;	cmp	al,1
 44494                                  ;	jne	short sr_done 		; we need Rational Patch only
 44495                                  ;					;  on 286 systems
 44496                                  ;	mov	word [RationalPatchPtr],RationalPatch
 44497                                  
 44498                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 44499                                  %endif	; 28/12/2022
 44500

 44870                                  ;
 44871                                  ;	Description:
 44872                                  ;		This routine patches in 2 nops at the offsets specified in 
 44873                                  ;	patch_table. This basically enables the low mem stub to start 
 44874                                  ;	making XMS calls.
 44875                                  ;
 44876                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 44877                                  
 44878                                  	; 04/11/2022
 44879                                  	; (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 44880                                  	; DOSCODE:0BC50h
 44881                                  
 44882                                  patch_table:	; label	byte
 44883                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i0patch
 44884                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i20patch
 44885                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i21patch
 44886                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i25patch
 44887                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i26patch
 44888                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i27patch
 44889                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:i2fpatch
 44890                                  	;dw	offset dosdata:cpmpatch
 44891 000078F5 [8A10]                  	dw	i0patch
 44892 000078F7 [9410]                  	dw	i20patch
 44893 000078F9 [9E10]                  	dw	i21patch
 44894 000078FB [A810]                  	dw	i25patch
 44895 000078FD [B210]                  	dw	i26patch
 44896 000078FF [BC10]                  	dw	i27patch
 44897 00007901 [C610]                  	dw	i2fpatch
 44898 00007903 [D010]                  	dw	cpmpatch
 44899                                  
 44900                                  patch_table_size equ ($-patch_table)/2
 44901                                  
 44902                                  patch_in_nops:
 44903 00007905 50                      	push	ax
 44904 00007906 56                      	push	si
 44905 00007907 BE[F578]                	mov	si,patch_table
 44906 0000790A B89090                  	mov	ax,9090h ; nop, nop
 44907                                  	; 17/12/2022
 44908                                  	; cx = 0
 44909                                  	;mov	cx,8
 44910                                  	;mov	cx,patch_table_size ; 8
 44911 0000790D B108                    	mov	cl,patch_table_size ; 8
 44912                                  pin_loop:
 44913 0000790F 2E8B3C                  	mov	di,[cs:si]
 44914 00007912 AB                      	stosw
 44915                                  	;add	si,2
 44916                                  	; 17/12/2022
 44917 00007913 46                      	inc	si
 44918 00007914 46                      	inc	si
 44919 00007915 E2F8                    	loop	pin_loop
 44920 00007917 5E                      	pop	si
 44921 00007918 58                      	pop	ax
 44922 00007919 C3                      	retn

 45124                                  ;; INT 21,52 - Get Pointer to DOS "INVARS" (Undocumented)
 45125                                  ;;
 45126                                  ;;	AH = 52h
 45127                                  ;;
 45128                                  ;;	on return:
 45129                                  ;;	ES:BX = pointer to DOS "invars", a table of pointers used by DOS.
 45130                                  ;;		Known "invars" fields follow (varies with DOS version):
 45131                                  ;;
 45132                                  ;;	Offset Size		 Description
 45133                                  ;;
 45134                                  ;;	 -12   word   sharing retry count (DOS 3.1-3.3)
 45135                                  ;;	 -10   word   sharing retry delay  (DOS 3.1-3.3)
 45136                                  ;;	  -8   dword  pointer to current disk buffer (DOS 3.x)
 45137                                  ;;	  -4   word   pointer in DOS code segment of unread CON input;
 45138                                  ;;		      0 indicates no unread input (DOS 3.x)
 45139                                  ;;	  -2   word   segment of first Memory Control Block (MCB)
 45140                                  ;;	  00   dword  pointer to first DRIVE PARAMETER TABLE (A:) in chain
 45141                                  ;;	  04   dword  pointer to DOS System File Table (SFT)
 45142                                  ;;	  08   dword  pointer to $CLOCK device driver
 45143                                  ;;	  0C   dword  pointer to CON device driver
 45144                                  ;;	  10   byte   number of logical drives in system
 45145                                  ;;	  11   word   maximum bytes/block of any block device
 45146                                  ;;	  13   dword  pointer to DOS cache buffer header
 45147                                  ;;	  17 18bytes  NUL device header, first 4 bytes of device header
 45148                                  ;;		      point to the next device in device chain

 45364                                  ;Break <Initialized data and data used at DOS initialization>
 45365                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 45366                                  
 45367                                  ; We need to identify the parts of the data area that are relevant to tasks
 45368                                  ; and those that are relevant to the system as a whole.  Under 3.0, the system
 45369                                  ; data will be gathered with the system code.  The process data under 2.x will
 45370                                  ; be available for swapping and under 3.0 it will be allocated per-process.
 45371                                  ;
 45372                                  ; The data that is system data will be identified by [SYSTEM] in the comments
 45373                                  ; describing that data item.
 45374                                  
 45375                                  ;DOSDATA SEGMENT WORD PUBLIC 'DATA'
 45376                                  
 45377                                  ;
 45378                                  ; Table of routines for assignable devices
 45379                                  ;
 45380                                  ; MSDOS allows assignment if the following standard devices:
 45381                                  ;   stdin  (usually CON input)
 45382                                  ;   stdout (usually CON output)
 45383                                  ;   auxin  (usually AUX input)
 45384                                  ;   auxout (usually AUX output)
 45385                                  ;   stdlpt (usually PRN output)
 45386                                  ;
 45387                                  ; SPECIAL NOTE:
 45388                                  ;   Status of a file is a strange idea. We choose to handle it in this manner:
 45389                                  ;   If we're not at end-of-file, then we always say that we have a character.
 45390                                  ;   Otherwise, we return ^Z as the character and set the ZERO flag. In this
 45391                                  ;   manner we can support program written under the old DOS (they use ^Z as EOF
 45392                                  ;   on devices) and programs written under the new DOS (they use the ZERO flag
 45393                                  ;   as EOF).
 45394                                  
 45395                                  ; Default SFTs for boot up
 45396                                  
 45397                                  		;PUBLIC	SFTABL
 45398                                  
 45399                                  SFTABL:	   ; LABEL   DWORD		; [SYSTEM] file table
 45400 000000CC FFFF                    		DW -1			; [SYSTEM] link to next table
 45401 000000CE FFFF                    		DW -1			; [SYSTEM] link seg to next table
 45402 000000D0 0500                    		DW sf_default_number	; [SYSTEM] Number of entries in table
 45403                                  		;times 295 db 0 ; MSDOS 6.0
 45404 000000D2 00<rep 127h>            		times (sf_default_number*sf_entry_size) db 0
 45405                                  
 45406                                  ; the next two variables relate to the position of the logical stdout/stdin
 45407                                  ; cursor. They are only meaningful when stdin/stdout are assigned to the
 45408                                  ; console.
 45409                                  		; DOSDATA:01F9h (MSDOS 6.21)
 45410 000001F9 00                      CARPOS:		db 0			; [SYSTEM] cursor position in stdin
 45411 000001FA 00                      STARTPOS:	db 0			; [SYSTEM] position of cursor at beginning
 45412                                  					;	   of buffered input call
 45413 000001FB 00<rep 80h>             INBUF:		times 128 db 0		; [SYSTEM] general device input buffer
 45414 0000027B 00<rep 83h>             CONBUF:		times 131 db 0		; [SYSTEM] The rest of INBUF and console buffer
 45415                                  		; DOSDATA:02FEh (MSDOS 6.21)
 45416 000002FE 00                      PFLAG:		db 0			; [SYSTEM] printer echoing flag
 45417 000002FF 00                      VERFLG:		db 0			; [SYSTEM] Initialize with verify off
 45418 00000300 03                      CHARCO:		db 00000011b		; [SYSTEM] Allows statchks every 4 chars...
 45419                                  switch_character:
 45420 00000301 2F                      chSwitch:	db '/'			; UNUSED - obsolete datum, can be reused
 45421 00000302 00                      AllocMethod:	db 0			; [SYSTEM] how to alloc first(best)last
 45422 00000303 00                      fShare:		db 0			; [SYSTEM] TRUE => sharing installed
 45423 00000304 01                      DIFFNAM:	db 1			; [SYSTEM] Indicates when MYNAME has changed
 45424 00000305 20<rep 10h>             MYNAME:		times 16 db 20h		; [SYSTEM] My network name

 45626                                  ; Retro DOS v4.0 NOTE: (by Erdogan Tan, 25/04/2019)
 45627                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------
 45628                                  ; This data section which was named as uninitialized data
 45629                                  ; (as overlayed by initialization code) but follows 
 45630                                  ; initialized data section from DOSDATA:03B6h address
 45631                                  ; (in otherwords, the method is different than MSDOS 3.3,
 45632                                  ; and there is not overlaying..)
 45633                                  ; **********************************************************
 45634                                  ; Reference: MSDOS 6.21 kernel DOSDATA section (4970 bytes)
 45635                                  ; follows DOSCODE section in the kernel file (MSDOS.SYS) 
 45636                                  ; (it is located at offset 0BF70h, file offset 0BF70h-3DE0h) 
 45637                                  ; but starts from offset 0 (ORG 0) and ends at offset 1370h.
 45638                                  ; TIMEBUF is at offset 03B6h.
 45639                                  ; **********************************************************	
 45640                                  
 45641                                  ;Break <Uninitialized data overlayed by initialization code>
 45642                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 45643                                  ;DOSDATA    SEGMENT WORD PUBLIC 'DATA'
 45644                                  ; Init code overlaps with data area below
 45645                                  
 45646                                  ; 	ORG     0
 45647                                  
 45648                                  MSDAT001S:	; label byte
 45649                                  
 45650                                  ; DOSDATA:03B6h	; MSDOS 6.21 (MSDOS.SYS, file offset 0BF70h-3DE0h+3B6h)
 45651                                  TIMEBUF: ;	times 6 db 0
 45652 000003B6 0000<rep 3h>            	times 3 dw	0		; Time read from clock device
 45653 000003BC 0000                    DEVIOBUF:	dw	0		; Buffer for I/O under file assignment
 45654

 45656

 45660                                  RENBUF:	
 45661 0000043E 00<rep 80h>             	times	128 db	0		; buffer for rename destination
 45662

 46097                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 46098                                  ;
 46099                                  ;CASE MAPPER ROUTINE FOR 80H-FFH character range, DOS 3.3
 46100                                  ;     ENTRY: AL = Character to map
 46101                                  ;     EXIT:  AL = The converted character
 46102                                  ; Alters no registers except AL and flags.
 46103                                  ; The routine should do nothing to chars below 80H.
 46104                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 46105                                  ; Example:
 46106                                  
 46107                                  MAP_CASE:
 46108                                  ;Procedure MAP_CASE,FAR
 46109                                  
 46110 00000CF5 3C80                    	CMP	AL,80h
 46111 00000CF7 7301                    	JAE	short Map1	;Map no chars below 80H ever
 46112 00000CF9 CB                      	RETF
 46113                                  Map1:
 46114 00000CFA 2C80                    	SUB	AL,80h		;Turn into index value
 46115 00000CFC 1E                      	PUSH	DS
 46116 00000CFD 53                      	PUSH	BX
 46117 00000CFE BB[AF0A]                	MOV	BX,UCASE_TAB+2
 46118                                  FINISH:
 46119 00000D01 0E                      	PUSH	CS		;Move to DS
 46120 00000D02 1F                      	POP	DS
 46121 00000D03 D7                      	XLAT			;Get upper case character
 46122 00000D04 5B                      	POP	BX
 46123 00000D05 1F                      	POP	DS
 46124                                  L_RET:
 46125 00000D06 CB                      	RETF
 46126                                  
 46127                                  ;EndProc MAP_CASE

 46705                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------
 46706                                  ; Patch for Sidekick
 46707                                  ;
 46708                                  ; A documented method for finding the offset of the Errormode flag in the
 46709                                  ; dos swappable data area if for the app to scan in the dos segment (data)
 46710                                  ; for the following sequence of instructions.
 46711                                  ;
 46712                                  ; Ref: Part C, Article 11, pg 356 of MSDOS Encyclopedia
 46713                                  ;

 46715                                  ;

 46720 0000104C 36FF365803              	db	036h, 0FFh, 036h, 058h, 03h	 ; push ss:[NearWord]
 46721 00001051 CD28                    	db	0CDh, 028h			 ; int  28h

 46795                                  ; LOW MEM STUB:
 46796                                  ;
 46797                                  ; The low mem stub contains the entry points into DOS for all interrupts
 46798                                  ; handled by DOS. This stub is installed if the user specifies that the
 46799                                  ; DOS load in HIMEM. Each entry point does this.
 46800                                  ;
 46801                                  ; 	1. if jmp to 8 has been patched out
 46802                                  ;	   2. if A20 OFF
 46803                                  ;	      3. Enable A20
 46804                                  ;	   4. else 
 46805                                  ;	      5. just go to dos entry
 46806                                  ;	   6. endif
 46807                                  ;	7. else
 46808                                  ;	   8. just go to dos entry
 46809                                  ;	9. endif
 46810                                  ;
 46811                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 46812
